001.title: Chapter 1 · An Accident

blocks.label: 章
lines: 第一章 一场意外
Dìyīzhāng yìcháng yìwài
Chapter 1: An Accident
王梅推着电瓶车，走在乡下的小路上。
Wáng Méi tuī zhe diànpíngchē, zǒu zài xiāngxià de xiǎo lùshàng.
Wang Mei was pushing her electric scooter along a small country road.
头顶上的太阳像一颗发了狂的火球。
Tóudǐng shàng de tàiyáng xiàng yìkē fāle kuáng de huǒqiú.
The sun overhead was like a fireball gone mad.
毒辣的阳光炙烤着地面。
Dúlà de yángguāng zhìkǎo zhe dìmiàn.
The scorching sunlight baked the ground.
村里的路刚整修没有多久，路上的沥青还黑得发亮。
Cūnlǐ de lù gāng zhěngxiū méiyǒu duōjiǔ, lùshàng de lìqīng hái hēidé fāliàng.
The village road had been repaired not long ago, and the asphalt was still shiny black.
在持续的高温天气里，马路好像要冒出黑油来，粘住王梅的鞋底。
Zài chíxù de gāowēn tiānqì lǐ, mǎlù hǎoxiàng yào mào chū hēiyóu lái, zhānzhù Wáng Méi de xiédǐ.
In the endless heat, the road seemed about to ooze black oil and stick to the soles of Wang Mei's shoes.
王梅的电瓶车可能是坏了，或者是没电了。
Wáng Méi de diànpíngchē kěnéng shì huài le, huòzhě shì méidiàn le.
Her scooter had either broken down or run out of battery.
这一上午，王梅已经去了五个学生家，向每个学生家长面对面做了宣传，
Zhè yíshàngwǔ, Wáng Méi yǐjīng qù le wǔgè xuéshēng jiā, xiàng měigè xuéshēngjiāzhǎng miànduìmiàn zuò le xuānchuán,
That morning Wang Mei had already visited five students' homes and spoken face to face with each family,
让他们看好自己的小孩，暑假期间千万不能去河里游泳。
Ràng tāmen kànhǎo zìjǐ de xiǎohái, shǔjià qījiān qiānwàn bùnéng qù hélǐ yóuyǒng.
telling them to keep an eye on their children: during the summer holidays they must never swim in the river.
从第五个学生家里出来，时间已经接近中午。
Cóng dìwǔgè xuéshēng jiālǐ chūlái, shíjiān yǐjīng jiējìn zhōngwǔ.
By the time she left the fifth student's home, it was nearly noon.
学生家长热情地留王梅在家吃饭，王梅拒绝了。
Xuéshēngjiāzhǎng rèqíng dìliú Wáng Méi zàijiā chīfàn, Wáng Méi jùjué le.
The parents warmly invited her to stay for lunch, but she declined.
她想要在午饭时间赶到江阳家。
Tā xiǎngyào zài wǔfànshíjiān gǎndào Jiāng Yáng jiā.
She wanted to reach Jiang Yang's home by lunchtime.
那个时候，江阳的爷爷奶奶应该在家。
Nàge shíhòu, Jiāng Yáng de yéyénǎinǎi yīnggāi zàijiā.
At that time his grandparents should be at home.
如果不在家，她就带江阳去吃午饭。
Rúguǒ bú zàijiā, tā jiù dài Jiāng Yáng qù chī wǔfàn.
If they weren't, she would take Jiang Yang out for lunch.
江阳是她班上的学生，是个留守儿童。
Jiāng Yáng shì tā bānshàng de xuéshēng, shì gè liúshǒu értóng.
Jiang Yang was a student in her class, a "left-behind child".
留守儿童在王梅工作的学校里是很常见的。
Liúshǒu értóng zài Wáng Méi gōngzuò de xuéxiào lǐ shì hěn chángjiàn de.
Left-behind children were very common at the school where Wang Mei worked.
这一现象主要是由于中国大量农村劳动力向城市转移所致。
Zhèyí xiànxiàng zhǔyào shì yóuyú zhōngguó dàliàng nóngcūn láodònglì xiàng chéngshì zhuǎnyí suǒzhì.
This is mainly caused by huge numbers of rural workers in China moving to the cities.
农村的年轻人去大城市打工赚钱。
Nóngcūn de niánqīngrén qù dàchéngshì dǎgōng zhuànqián.
Young people from the countryside go to big cities to work and earn money.
大城市的房租和其他消费品都很贵，他们没能力把自己的孩子们也带去，
Dàchéngshì de fángzū hé qítā xiāofèipǐn dōu hěn guì, tāmen méi nénglì bǎ zìjǐ de háizi men yě dài qù,
Rent and everything else is expensive in big cities, so they can't afford to take their children with them,
或者就算有能力，也没时间照顾小孩。
Huòzhě jiùsuàn yǒu nénglì, yě méi shíjiān zhàogù xiǎohái.
or even if they can, they have no time to look after them.
所以就把孩子们留在老家，让祖父母或者其他亲属帮忙照顾。
Suǒyǐ jiù bǎ háizi men liúzài lǎojiā, ràng zǔfùmǔ huòzhě qítā qīnshǔ bāngmáng zhàogù.
So they leave the children in their hometown and let grandparents or other relatives look after them.
每年只有在重要的节日，比如春节或者中秋时，他们才会回到老家，全家团聚。
Měinián zhǐyǒu zài zhòngyào de jiérì, bǐrú chūnjié huòzhě zhōngqiū shí, tāmen cái huì huídào lǎojiā, quánjiā tuánjù.
Only for important festivals each year, like Spring Festival or Mid-Autumn, do they go home and the whole family is together.
也有的父母会在孩子们放寒暑假的时候，把孩子们接到他们工作的城市，共享天伦之乐。
Yě yǒu de fùmǔ huì zài háizi men fàng hánshǔjià de shíhòu, bǎ háizi men jiēdào tāmen gōngzuò de chéngshì, gòngxiǎng tiānlúnzhīlè.
Some parents fetch their children to the city where they work during the winter and summer holidays, to enjoy family life together.
江阳的情况更特殊一些。
Jiāng Yáng de qíngkuàng gèng tèshū yìxiē.
Jiang Yang's situation was more unusual.
江阳的父母务工去了广州后，离婚又分别再婚了，
Jiāng Yáng de fùmǔ wùgōng qù le guǎngzhōu hòu, líhūn yòu fēnbié zàihūn le,
After his parents went to work in Guangzhou, they divorced and each remarried,
不愿意把江阳带到新的家庭里去。
Bú yuànyì bǎ Jiāng Yáng dàidào xīn de jiātíng lǐ qù.
and neither wanted to take Jiang Yang into their new family.
所以江阳就被留给了爷爷奶奶。
Suǒyǐ Jiāng Yáng jiù bèi liúgěi le yéyénǎinǎi.
So Jiang Yang was left with his grandparents.
爷爷奶奶都是农民，从早到晚在田里忙活。
Yéyénǎinǎi dōu shì nóngmín, cóngzǎodàowǎn zài tiánlǐ mánghuó.
His grandparents were farmers, busy in the fields from morning till night.
江阳在家饿了，就吃冷水泡米饭。
Jiāng Yáng zàijiā è le, jiù chī lěng shuǐpào mǐfàn.
When Jiang Yang got hungry at home, he ate rice soaked in cold water.
江阳十五岁，正是长身体的时候，食量也越来越大。
Jiāng Yáng shíwǔsuì, zhèngshì zhǎng shēntǐ de shíhòu, shíliàng yě yuèláiyuè dà.
He was fifteen, just at the age of growing fast, and ate more and more.
平时在学校上课，学校食堂能管饱，还会发牛奶喝。
Píngshí zài xuéxiào shàngkè, xuéxiàoshítáng néng guǎnbǎo, háihuìfā niúnǎi hē.
During term the school canteen filled him up and even handed out milk.
但是一到寒暑假，他就经常饿得两眼发花。
Dànshì yídào hánshǔjià, tā jiù jīngcháng èdé liǎngyǎn fāhuā.
But as soon as the holidays came, he was often so hungry his eyes blurred.
好在班主任王梅偶尔会去看他，带他去吃东西。
Hǎo zài bānzhǔrèn Wáng Méi ǒu'ěr huì qù kàn tā, dài tā qù chī dōngxī.
Luckily his class teacher, Wang Mei, sometimes visited him and took him out to eat.
王梅背上的汗浸湿了她整件衬衫。
Wáng Méi bèishàng de hàn jìnshī le tā zhěngjiàn chènshān.
The sweat on Wang Mei's back had soaked her whole shirt.
周围一丝风都没有。
Zhōuwéi yìsī fēng dōu méiyǒu.
There wasn't a breath of wind.
路边的田野好像被晒晕了，里面的农作物一动不动。
Lùbiān de tiányě hǎoxiàng bèi shài yūn le, lǐmiàn de nóngzuòwù yídòngbúdòng.
The fields by the road seemed dazed by the sun; the crops didn't move at all.
只有蛙声和尖锐的蝉鸣在宣告着生机。
Zhǐyǒu wāshēng hé jiānruì de chánmíng zài xuāngào zhe shēngjī.
Only the croaking of frogs and the shrill cicadas showed that anything was alive.
过了这片田野，王梅又走到了她非常熟悉的地方。
Guò le zhèpiàn tiányě, Wáng Méi yòu zǒu dào le tā fēicháng shúxī de dìfāng.
Past these fields, Wang Mei came again to a place she knew very well.
这二十五年来，她甚至来过上千次的河边。
Zhè èrshíwǔnián lái, tā shènzhì lái guò shàng qiāncì de hébiān.
In these twenty-five years she had been to this riverbank perhaps a thousand times.
这盛夏的午后，乡村的河边似乎是唯一散发着凉意的地方。
Zhè shèngxià de wǔhòu, xiāngcūn de hébiān sìhū shì wéiyí sànfà zhe liángyì de dìfāng.
On this midsummer afternoon, the village riverbank seemed the only place giving off any coolness.
王梅决定休息五分钟。
Wáng Méi juédìng xiūxī wǔfēnzhōng.
Wang Mei decided to rest for five minutes.
她走到河边的大树下，坐了下来。
Tā zǒu dào hébiān de dàshùxià, zuò le xiàlái.
She walked to the big tree by the river and sat down.
远处的河水在烈日下泛着刺眼的白光。
Yuǎnchù de héshuǐ zài lièrì xiàfàn zhe cìyǎn de báiguāng.
In the distance, the river glittered with a dazzling white light under the blazing sun.
王梅望着那白光，神情有些恍惚，仿佛回到了二十五年前的那个夏天。
Wáng Méi wàng zhe nà báiguāng, shénqíng yǒuxiē huǎnghū, fǎngfú huídào le èrshíwǔnián qián de nàge xiàtiān.
Gazing at that light, Wang Mei grew absent-minded, as if she were back in that summer twenty-five years ago.
二十五年前，王梅三十岁，正意气风发，事业和家庭双丰收。
Èrshíwǔnián qián, Wáng Méi sānshísuì, zhèng yìqìfēngfā, shìyè hé jiātíng shuāngfēngshōu.
Twenty-five years earlier Wang Mei was thirty, full of energy, successful both in her career and at home.
事业上，她在市里最好的小学工作，是火箭班的班主任，
Shìyè shàng, tā zài shìlǐ zuìhǎo de xiǎoxué gōngzuò, shì huǒjiàn bān de bānzhǔrèn,
In her career, she worked at the best primary school in the city and taught the top "rocket" class,
还被评为全省十佳优秀教师。
Hái bèi píngwèi quánshěng shíjiā yōuxiùjiàoshī.
and had been named one of the province's ten best teachers.
家庭方面，她和丈夫关系和谐。
Jiātíng fāngmiàn, tā hé zhàngfū guānxì héxié.
At home, she and her husband got on well.
他们的儿子吴天天也进入王梅的学校上学，正在读小学一年级。
Tāmen de érzi Wú Tiāntiān yě jìnrù Wáng Méi de xuéxiào shàngxué, zhèngzài dú xiǎoxué yìniánjí.
Their son, Wu Tiantian, also went to Wang Mei's school and was in the first year.
王梅至今还记得很清楚，那年是2000年，千禧年。
Wáng Méi zhìjīn hái jìde hěn qīngchǔ, nànián shì 2000 nián, qiānxǐnián.
Wang Mei still remembers it clearly: that year was 2000, the millennium.
整个社会都充满了兴奋和憧憬。
Zhěnggè shèhuì dōu chōngmǎn le xīngfèn hé chōngjǐng.
The whole of society was full of excitement and hope.
王梅的同事从一年前开始就在积极备孕，想要生一个千禧宝宝。
Wáng Méi de tóngshì cóng yìnián qián kāishǐ jiù zài jījí bèiyùn, xiǎngyào shēng yígèqiān xǐ bǎobǎo.
A colleague of Wang Mei's had been trying for a baby since the year before, hoping for a millennium baby.
她的预产期在2000年的6月，是暑假前的最后一个月。
Tā de yùchǎnqī zài 2000 nián de 6 yuè, shì shǔjià qián de zuìhòu yígèyuè.
Her due date was June 2000, the last month before the summer holidays.
由于她去休了产假，同事们需要顶替她的工作，王梅也变得更忙了，经常需要加班。
Yóuyú tā qù xiū le chǎnjià, tóngshì men xūyào dǐngtì tā de gōngzuò, Wáng Méi yě biàndé gèngmáng le, jīngcháng xūyào jiābān.
Because she went on maternity leave, her colleagues had to cover her work; Wang Mei got busier and often worked late.
她的儿子就在办公室里写作业，等着妈妈工作结束后一起回家。
Tā de érzi jiù zài bàngōngshì lǐ xiě zuòyè, děng zhe māmā gōngzuò jiéshù hòu yìqǐ huíjiā.
Her son did his homework in the office, waiting to go home with his mother when she finished.
6月的一个周五，王梅难得地没有加班。
6 yuè de yígè zhōuwǔ, Wáng Méi nándé de méiyǒu jiābān.
One Friday in June, for once, Wang Mei didn't work late.
应儿子的要求，她准备带他去市里的外国餐厅——肯德基。
Yīng érzi de yāoqiú, tā zhǔnbèi dài tā qù shìlǐ de wàiguó cāntīng "" Kěndéjī.
At her son's request, she was going to take him to the foreign restaurant in the city: KFC.
他们刚走到校门口，王梅班上的一个女学生跑了过来，慌张地说：
Tāmen gāng zǒu dào xiàoménkǒu, Wáng Méi bānshàng de yígè nǚ xuéshēng pǎo le guòlái, huāngzhāng dìshuō:
They had just reached the school gate when a girl from Wang Mei's class ran up and said in a panic:
“老师，不好了，你快去看看，咱们班同学出车祸了！”
"Lǎoshī, bùhǎo le, nǐ kuài qù kànkàn, zánmen bān tóngxué chūchēhuò le!"
"Teacher, something terrible has happened! Come quickly, someone in our class has been in a car accident!"
“什么？在哪儿？”
"Shénme? Zài nǎ'ér?"
"What? Where?"
王梅往前跑了几步，突然想起旁边的儿子，又折返回来，对吴天天说：
Wáng Méi wǎngqián pǎo le jǐbù, tūrán xiǎngqǐ pángbiān de érzi, yòu zhéfǎn huílái, duì Wú Tiāntiān shuō:
Wang Mei ran a few steps, suddenly remembered her son beside her, turned back and said to Wu Tiantian:
“你自己先回家。把钥匙拿好，别弄丢了。回家饿了就吃点蛋糕。妈妈明天再带你去吃肯德基。”
"Nǐ zìjǐ xiān huíjiā. Bǎ yàoshi ná hǎo, biénòng diū le. Huíjiā è le jiù chī diǎn dàngāo. Māmā míngtiān zài dàinǐqù chī Kěndéjī."
"Go home by yourself first. Hold on to the key, don't lose it. If you're hungry, eat some cake. Mum will take you to KFC tomorrow."
王梅班上的一个男同学在过马路的时候，被一辆小轿车撞飞。
Wáng Méi bānshàng de yígè nántóngxué zài guò mǎlù de shíhòu, bèi yíliàng xiǎojiàochē zhuàngfēi.
A boy from Wang Mei's class had been hit by a car while crossing the road and thrown into the air.
落到地上后，又被一辆摩托车碾压了头部。
Luòdào dìshàng hòu, yòu bèi yíliàng mótuōchē niǎnyā le tóubù.
After he landed, a motorbike ran over his head.
事故现场非常血腥。
Shìgùxiànchǎng fēicháng xuèxīng.
The scene of the accident was very bloody.
更糟糕的是，几个同学都目睹了这个场景。
Gèng zāogāo de shì, jǐgè tóngxué dōu mùdǔ le zhège chǎngjǐng.
Worse still, several classmates saw it happen.
王梅赶到时，已经有人拨打了报警电话，急救人员也赶到了现场。
Wáng Méi gǎndào shí, yǐjīng yǒurén bōdǎ le bàojǐng diànhuà, jíjiù rényuán yě gǎndào le xiànchǎng.
When Wang Mei arrived, someone had already called the police, and the paramedics had arrived too.
学生的父亲就在旁边的一家理发店里工作。
Xuéshēng de fùqīn jiù zài pángbiān de yìjiā lǐfàdiàn lǐ gōngzuò.
The boy's father worked in a barber's shop right next to it.
看着倒地不醒的儿子，他一口气没喘过来，晕了过去，也被抬上了救护车。
Kànzhe dǎodì bùxǐng de érzi, tā yìkǒuqì méichuǎn guòlái, yūn le guòqù, yě bèi tái shàng le jiùhùchē.
Seeing his son lying unconscious, he couldn't catch his breath, fainted, and was also carried onto the ambulance.
王梅跟着一起去了医院。
Wáng Méi gēnzhe yìqǐ qù le yīyuàn.
Wang Mei went with them to the hospital.
到达医院后，男学生被医生宣告了死亡。
Dàodá yīyuàn hòu, nán xuéshēng bèi yīshēng xuāngào le sǐwáng.
At the hospital the doctors declared the boy dead.
男学生的父亲被送去了抢救室。
Nán xuéshēng de fùqīn bèi sòng qù le qiǎngjiùshì.
His father was taken to the emergency room.
王梅在医院门口的电话亭里给同事家打电话，
Wáng Méi zài yīyuàn ménkǒu de diànhuàtíng lǐ gěi tóngshì jiā dǎdiànhuà,
Wang Mei phoned a colleague's home from the phone booth at the hospital entrance,
让同事回办公室里去找王梅的通讯录，那里有学生母亲的BB机号码。
Ràng tóngshì huí bàngōngshì lǐ qù zhǎo Wáng Méi de tōngxùnlù, nàlǐ yǒu xuéshēng mǔqīn de BB jī hàomǎ.
asking her to go back to the office and find Wang Mei's address book, which had the mother's pager number.
随后，王梅联系上了学生的母亲。
Suíhòu, Wáng Méi liánxì shàng le xuéshēng de mǔqīn.
After that, Wang Mei got hold of the boy's mother.
等学生的母亲和家人赶到医院后，王梅才离开。
Děng xuéshēng de mǔqīn hé jiārén gǎndào yīyuàn hòu, Wáng Méi cái líkāi.
Only after the mother and the family reached the hospital did Wang Mei leave.
从医院出来后，她坐上了出租车。
Cóng yīyuàn chūlái hòu, tā zuò shàng le chūzūchē.
Leaving the hospital, she got into a taxi.
路上，她的脑海里不停地浮现车祸现场的惨状。
Lùshàng, tā de nǎohǎi lǐ bùtíng de fúxiàn chēhuò xiànchǎng de cǎnzhuàng.
On the way, the terrible scene of the accident kept coming back to her mind.
可怜的孩子。
Kělián de háizi.
The poor child.
他学习很好，已经被市里的重点中学录取，还有一个月就小学毕业。
Tā xuéxí hěn hǎo, yǐjīng bèi shìlǐ de zhòngdiǎnzhōngxué lùqǔ, háiyǒu yígèyuè jiù xiǎoxué bìyè.
He was a good student, already accepted by the city's top secondary school, just a month from finishing primary school.
然而，他的人生就这么戛然而止。
Rán'ér, tā de rénshēng jiù zhème jiárán'érzhǐ.
And yet his life had come to an abrupt end.
很难想象他的父母会受到多大的打击。

Shénme shì "liúshǒu értóng"?
What is a "left-behind child"?
ans: 父母去大城市打工，孩子留在老家，由爷爷奶奶或者亲戚照顾。
Fùmǔ qù dàchéngshì dǎgōng, háizi liúzài lǎojiā, yóu yéyénǎinǎi huòzhě qīnqī zhàogù.
The parents work in a big city, and the child stays in the hometown, looked after by grandparents or relatives.

q: 为什么王梅那天没有带儿子去吃肯德基？
Wèishénme Wáng Méi nàtiān méiyǒu dài érzi qù chī Kěndéjī?
Why didn't Wang Mei take her son to KFC that day?
ans: 因为她班上的一个学生出了车祸，她要马上去看。
Yīnwèi tā bānshàng de yígè xuéshēng chū le chēhuò, tā yào mǎshàng qù kàn.
Because a student in her class had a car accident and she had to go at once.

q: 半夜十二点，王梅在做什么？
Bànyè shí'èrdiǎn, Wáng Méi zài zuò shénme?
What was Wang Mei doing at midnight?
ans: 她坐在电话旁边等消息，一夜没有睡觉。
Tā zuòzài diànhuà pángbiān děng xiāoxī, yíyè méiyǒu shuìjiào.
She sat by the phone waiting for news and didn't sleep all night.

002.title: Chapter 2 · The Guardian

blocks.label: 章
lines: 第二章 守护人
Dì'èrzhāng shǒuhùrén
Chapter 2: The Guardian
暴雨下了好几个小时，快到天亮时才结束。
Bàoyǔ xià le hǎojǐgè xiǎoshí, kuàidào tiānliàng shícái jiéshù.
The storm went on for hours and only stopped just before dawn.
眼看东方露出了鱼肚白，天色渐亮，王梅的担忧也越来越大。
Yǎnkàn dōngfāng lùchū le yúdùbái, tiānsè jiànliàng, Wáng Méi de dānyōu yě yuèláiyuè dà.
As the eastern sky turned pale and it grew light, Wang Mei's fear grew and grew.
天天失踪了一个晚上，实在是凶多吉少。
Tiāntiān shīzōng le yígè wǎnshàng, shízài shì xiōngduōjíshǎo.
Tiantian had been missing all night; things looked very bad.
星期六早上七点多，几个警察敲响了王梅家的门。
Xīngqīliù zǎoshàng qīdiǎn duō, jǐgè jǐngchá qiāoxiǎng le Wáng Méi jiā de mén.
Just after seven on Saturday morning, several policemen knocked on Wang Mei's door.
看着王梅期待的眼神，他们只是摇了摇头。
Kànzhe Wáng Méi qīdài de yǎnshén, tāmen zhǐshì yáo le yáotóu.
Seeing the hope in her eyes, they just shook their heads.
警察来王梅和陈江家调查，想看看孩子们有没有离家出走的可能性。
Jǐngchá lái Wáng Méi hé Chén Jiāng jiā diàochá, xiǎng kànkàn háizi men yǒuméiyǒu líjiāchūzǒu de kěnéngxìng.
The police came to Wang Mei's and Chen Jiang's homes to see whether the boys might have run away.
虽然王梅坚称不可能，但还是同意警察进屋调查。
Suīrán Wáng Méi jiānchēng bù kěnéng, dàn háishì tóngyì jǐngchá jìnwū diàochá.
Wang Mei insisted it was impossible, but still let the police in to look.
他们看了吴天天的房间、他的书包、他写的日记，都没找到任何奇怪的地方。
Tāmen kàn le Wú Tiāntiān de fángjiān, tā de shūbāo, tā xiě de rìjì, dōu méi zhǎodào rènhé qíguài de dìfāng.
They looked at Wu Tiantian's room, his school bag and his diary, and found nothing strange.
王梅的丈夫吴建国冲进家门时，警察们正在询问她的去向。
Wáng Méi de zhàngfū Wú Jiànguó chōng jìn jiāmén shí, jǐngchá men zhèngzài xúnwèn tā de qùxiàng.
When Wang Mei's husband, Wu Jianguo, rushed in, the police were questioning her about where she had been.
看见吴建国进门，他们又对他进行了盘问。
Kànjiàn Wú Jiànguó jìnmén, tāmen yòu duì tā jìnxíng le pánwèn.
Seeing Wu Jianguo come in, they questioned him too.
吴建国气愤地说：
Wú Jiànguó qìfèn dìshuō:
Wu Jianguo said angrily:
“你们这是在浪费时间！你们应该派出警力出去寻找，为什么在这里盘问我们？难道我们做父母的，还能把小孩卖了不成？”
"Nǐmen zhè shì zài làngfèishíjiān! Nǐmen yīnggāi pàichū jǐnglì chūqù xúnzhǎo, wèishénme zài zhèlǐ pánwèn wǒmen? Nándào wǒmen zuò fùmǔ de, hái néng bǎ xiǎohái mài le bùchéng?"
"You're wasting time! You should be sending officers out to search. Why are you interrogating us here? Do you think we parents would sell our own child?"
“你不要生气。外面的搜查还在继续。此外，一切的可能性我们都需要调查。
"Nǐ búyào shēngqì. Wàimiàn de sōuchá hái zài jìxù. Cǐwài, yíqiè de kěnéngxìng wǒmen dōu xūyào diàochá.
"Don't be angry. The search outside is still going on. Besides, we have to look into every possibility.
吴先生，你是个生意人。商场如战场，你有没有可能结下了仇家？”
Wúxiānshēng, nǐ shì gè shēngyìrén. Shāngchǎng rú zhànchǎng, nǐ yǒuméiyǒu kěnéng jiéxià le chóujiā? "
Mr Wu, you're a businessman. Business is like a battlefield. Could you have made enemies?"
警察平静的声音让吴建国一下子泄了气。
Jǐngchá píngjìng de shēngyīn ràng Wú Jiànguó yíxiàzi xiè le qì.
The policeman's calm voice took the fight out of Wu Jianguo at once.
他摇摇头，回答说：“没有的。我做的也不是什么大买卖，能有什么仇家呢？”
Tā yáoyáotóu, huídá shuō: "méiyǒu de. Wǒ zuò de yě búshì shénme dà mǎimài, néng yǒu shénme chóujiā ne?"
He shook his head and answered, "No. My business isn't anything big. What enemies could I have?"
在五楼调查陈江一家的年轻警察突然冲了进来，大声说：“李队，有线索了！”
Zài wǔlóu diàochá Chén Jiāng yìjiā de niánqīng jǐngchá tūrán chōng le jìnlái, dàshēng shuō: "Lǐ duì, yǒu xiànsuǒ le!"
The young policeman who had been questioning Chen Jiang's family on the fifth floor suddenly burst in and shouted, "Captain Li, we have a lead!"
屋里的人全都猛地站了起来。
Wūlǐ de rén quándōu měngdì zhàn le qǐlái.
Everyone in the room leapt to their feet.
那个姓李的队长做了一个噤声的手势，想要走出去再说。
Nàge xìnglǐ de duìzhǎng zuò le yígè jìnshēng de shǒushì, xiǎngyào zǒu chūqù zàishuō.
The captain, whose name was Li, signalled for silence and wanted to go outside to talk.
吴建国眼疾手快，抓住了李队，哀求道：
Wú Jiànguó yǎnjíshǒukuài, zhuāzhù le Lǐ duì, āiqiú dào:
Wu Jianguo was quick: he grabbed Captain Li and begged,
“什么线索，让我们一起听吧。你刚刚不是都排除了我们的嫌疑了吗？”
"Shénme xiànsuǒ, ràng wǒmen yìqǐ tīng ba. Nǐ gānggāng búshì dōu páichú le wǒmen de xiányí le ma?"
"Whatever the lead is, let us hear it too. Haven't you just cleared us of suspicion?"
王梅也着急地说：“是啊，我们也能帮忙一起想啊。还有谁能比我们更了解我儿子呢？”
Wáng Méi yě zháojí dìshuō: "shì a, wǒmen yě néng bāngmáng yìqǐ xiǎng a. Háiyǒu shuí néngbǐ wǒmen gèng liǎojiě wǒ érzi ne?"
Wang Mei said anxiously too, "Yes, we can help think. Who knows our son better than we do?"
李队看了一眼王梅，思索了两秒钟，说：“那好吧，王老师。”
Lǐ duì kàn le yìyǎn Wáng Méi, sīsuǒ le liǎngmiǎozhōng, shuō: "nàhǎo ba, wánglǎoshī."
Captain Li glanced at Wang Mei, thought for two seconds and said, "All right, Teacher Wang."
然后他做了一个手势，让那警察继续说下去。
Ránhòu tā zuò le yígè shǒushì, ràng nà jǐngchá jìxù shuō xiàqù.
Then he gestured to the policeman to go on.
“陈江父亲表示，他平时钓鱼用的鱼竿和捞网不见了。”
"Chén Jiāng fùqīn biǎoshì, tā píngshí diàoyú yòng de yúgān hé lāo wǎng bújiàn le."
"Chen Jiang's father says the fishing rod and landing net he usually uses are missing."
“去河边了！最近的河边离这里多远？”李队问。
"Qù hébiān le! Zuìjìn de hébiān lí zhèlǐ duōyuǎn?" Lǐ duì wèn.
"They went to the river! How far is the nearest riverbank from here?" Captain Li asked.
“坐公交车四十分钟左右。陈江父亲说，他上个周末带陈江去过。”
"Zuò gōngjiāochē sìshífēnzhōng zuǒyòu. Chén Jiāng fùqīn shuō, tā shàng gè zhōumò dài Chén Jiāng qùguò."
"About forty minutes by bus. Chen Jiang's father says he took Chen Jiang there last weekend."
“好。通知各个搜查分队，调查方向调整了，让他们停止拐卖方向的调查。
"Hǎo. Tōngzhī gègè sōuchá fēnduì, diàochá fāngxiàng tiáozhěng le, ràng tāmen tíngzhǐ guǎimài fāngxiàng de diàochá.
"Right. Tell all the search teams the investigation has changed direction; stop treating it as an abduction.
派两个人去公交公司，问一下昨天下午班的司机们有没有看到这两个小孩。
Pài liǎnggè rénqù gōngjiāogōngsī, wèn yíxià zuótiānxiàwǔ bān de sījī men yǒuméiyǒu kàndào zhè liǎnggè xiǎohái.
Send two people to the bus company and ask yesterday afternoon's drivers if they saw these two boys.
让陈江父亲带路，我们去他钓鱼的地方。其他人也立刻去河边，我们在那里汇合。”
Ràng Chén Jiāng fùqīn dàilù, wǒmen qù tā diàoyú de dìfāng. Qítārén yě lìkè qù hébiān, wǒmen zài nàlǐ huìhé. "
Chen Jiang's father will show us the way to where he fishes. Everyone else go to the river at once; we'll meet there."
李队有条不紊地布置了工作，随后立刻下楼，要去河边。
Lǐ duì yǒutiáobùwěn de bùzhì le gōngzuò, suíhòu lìkè xiàlóu, yào qù hébiān.
Captain Li calmly gave out the jobs, then went straight downstairs to head for the river.
王梅和吴建国也要求一同前去，李队没有反对。
Wáng Méi hé Wú Jiànguó yě yāoqiú yìtóng qiánqù, Lǐ duì méiyǒu fǎnduì.
Wang Mei and Wu Jianguo asked to go too, and Captain Li didn't object.
他虽然嘴上没说，但他认为孩子们应该是凶多吉少。
Tā suīrán zuǐshàng méi shuō, dàn tā rènwéi háizi men yīnggāi shì xiōngduōjíshǎo.
He didn't say so, but he believed things looked very bad for the boys.
此刻，他们需要尽可能多的人手，沿着河岸进行搜查。
Cǐkè, tāmen xūyào jǐnkěnéng duō de rénshǒu, yánzhe hé'àn jìnxíng sōuchá.
Right now they needed as many hands as possible to search along the riverbank.
经过一夜的大雨，河水涨高了很多，
Jīngguò yíyè de dàyǔ, héshuǐ zhǎnggāo le hěnduō,
After a night of heavy rain, the river had risen a lot,
河岸边的人类活动痕迹也被雨水冲刷掉了。
Hé ànbiān de rénlèi huódòng hénjì yě bèi yǔshuǐ chōngshuā diào le.
and the rain had washed away any traces of people on the bank.
搜查了一会儿后，李队接到了同事的电话。
Sōuchá le yíhuì'er hòu, Lǐ duì jiēdào le tóngshì de diànhuà.
After searching for a while, Captain Li got a call from a colleague.
同事说，一个公交车司机昨天下午看到了两个孩子，
Tóngshì shuō, yígè gōngjiāochē sījī zuótiānxiàwǔ kàndào le liǎnggè háizi,
The colleague said a bus driver had seen two boys the afternoon before,
他们手里拿着鱼竿，还有水桶之类的东西。
Tāmen shǒulǐ ná zhe yúgān, háiyǒu shuǐtǒng zhīlèi de dōngxī.
carrying a fishing rod and something like a bucket.
警察们的推测进一步得到了验证。
Jǐngchá men de tuīcè jìnyíbù dédào le yànzhèng.
The police's guess was confirmed.
此时，现场搜查的同事在岸边找到了一件蓝色的衣服。
Cǐshí, xiànchǎng sōuchá de tóngshì zài ànbiān zhǎodào le yíjiàn lánsè de yīfú.
At that moment, a colleague searching the scene found a blue piece of clothing on the bank.
衣服被挂在树杈上，被前一天晚上的暴雨打湿了，但幸好没有被雨水冲走。
Yīfú bèi guà zài shùchà shàng, bèi qiányìtiān wǎnshàng de bàoyǔ dǎshī le, dàn xìnghǎo méiyǒu bèi yǔshuǐ chōngzǒu.
It was hanging in the fork of a tree, soaked by the night's storm, but luckily not washed away.
经王梅的辨认，这衣服正是吴天天的。
Jīng Wáng Méi de biànrèn, zhè yīfú zhèngshì Wú Tiāntiān de.
Wang Mei identified it: it was Wu Tiantian's.
不远处，他们又在另一个树杈上找到了陈江的衣服。
Bùyuǎnchù, tāmen yòu zài lìng yígè shùchà shàng zhǎodào le Chén Jiāng de yīfú.
Not far away, they found Chen Jiang's clothes in another tree fork.
根据两个树杈的高度，警察们认为，这是孩子们在下河游泳前脱掉，挂在那里的。
Gēnjù liǎnggè shùchà de gāodù, jǐngchá men rènwéi, zhèshì háizi men zài xiàhé yóuyǒng qián tuōdiào, guà zài nàlǐ de.
From the height of the branches, the police concluded the boys had taken their clothes off and hung them there before going into the river to swim.
看着眼前奔腾的河水，李队打电话向领导汇报了情况。
Kànzhe yǎnqián bēnténg de héshuǐ, Lǐ duì dǎdiànhuà xiàng lǐngdǎo huìbào le qíngkuàng.
Looking at the rushing water, Captain Li phoned his superiors to report.
他认为，现在要做的就是打捞了。
Tā rènwéi, xiànzài yào zuò de jiùshì dǎlāo le.
He believed that what had to be done now was to search the water for bodies.
他让人把哭天抢地的父母们送回家，调来了小船，并向消防队请求支援，
Tā ràng rén bǎ kūtiānqiāngdì de fùmǔ men sòng huíjiā, diàolái le xiǎochuán, bìng xiàng xiāofángduì qǐngqiú zhīyuán,
He had the wailing parents taken home, called in small boats and asked the fire brigade for help,
在河的下游方向开始了打捞。
Zài hé de xiàyóu fāngxiàng kāishǐ le dǎlāo.
and they began searching downstream.
王梅哭累了，瘫坐在沙发上。
Wáng Méi kūlèi le, tānzuò zài shāfā shàng.
Wang Mei, worn out from crying, slumped on the sofa.
自责的情绪像洪水一样吞噬了她。
Zìzé de qíngxù xiàng hóngshuǐ yíyàng tūnshì le tā.
Guilt swallowed her like a flood.
不应该让天天一个人回家的。
Bù yīnggāi ràng Tiāntiān yígè rén huíjiā de.
She shouldn't have let Tiantian go home alone.
就算让他回了家，她也应该给亲朋好友打电话，让他们帮忙照顾一下天天。
Jiùsuàn ràng tā huí le jiā, tā yě yīnggāi gěi qīnpénghǎoyǒu dǎdiànhuà, ràng tāmen bāngmáng zhàogù yíxià Tiāntiān.
Even if she had sent him home, she should have called friends or relatives to keep an eye on him.
他才只有八岁呀。
Tā cái zhǐyǒu bāsuì ya.
He was only eight.
看到撒在茶几上的蛋糕渣，王梅想象着天天一个人坐在这里，啃着干巴巴的蛋糕。
Kàndào sā zài chájī shàng de dàngāo zhā, Wáng Méi xiǎngxiàng zhe Tiāntiān yígè rén zuòzài zhèlǐ, kěnzhe gānbābā de dàngāo.
Seeing the cake crumbs on the coffee table, Wang Mei pictured Tiantian sitting here alone, gnawing on dry cake.
这很可能就是他人生的最后一顿饭。
Zhè hěn kěnéng jiùshì tā rénshēng de zuìhòu yídùnfàn.
That was very probably the last meal of his life.
王梅的泪水再一次涌出眼眶。
Wáng Méi de lèishuǐ zài yícì yǒngchū yǎnkuàng.
Tears welled up in Wang Mei's eyes again.
她的胸腔好像被灌入了辣椒水，又痛又酸又涩。
Tā de xiōngqiāng hǎoxiàng bèi guànrù le làjiāoshuǐ, yòu tòng yòu suān yòu sè.
Her chest felt as if it had been filled with chilli water: painful, sour and bitter.
想想这些年来，她是一个称职的教师，却是一个失职的母亲。
Xiǎngxiǎng zhèxiēniánlái, tā shì yígè chènzhí de jiàoshī, quèshì yígè shīzhí de mǔqīn.
She thought how all these years she had been a good teacher, but a mother who had failed in her duty.
星期六下午两点，警察在下游打捞出一具尸体，是陈江的。
Xīngqīliù xiàwǔ liǎngdiǎn, jǐngchá zài xiàyóu dǎlāo chū yíjù shītǐ, shì Chén Jiāng de.
At two o'clock on Saturday afternoon, the police pulled a body from the river downstream. It was Chen Jiang.
吴天天依然没有被发现。
Wú Tiāntiān yīrán méiyǒu bèi fāxiàn.
Wu Tiantian still hadn't been found.
星期六下午五点，离开市区五十多公里的一个县城里，
Xīngqīliù xiàwǔ wǔdiǎn, líkāi shìqū wǔshíduō gōnglǐ de yígè xiànchéng lǐ,
At five on Saturday afternoon, in a county town more than fifty kilometres from the city,
几个少年在河水退去的河滩上捡鱼。
Jǐgè shàonián zài héshuǐ tuìqù de hétān shàng jiǎn yú.
some teenagers were picking up fish on the riverbank where the water had gone down.
他们翻动着被大水冲到岸上的树枝和树干，
Tāmen fāndòng zhe bèi dà shuǐchōng dào ànshàng de shùzhī hé shùgàn,
They turned over branches and tree trunks washed up by the flood,
在一节树干旁边发现了一具尸体。
Zài yìjié shùgàn pángbiān fāxiàn le yíjù shītǐ.
and found a body beside a log.
少年们被吓得失声尖叫，跑到了派出所去报案。
Shàonián men bèi xià déshī shēngjiānjiào, pǎo dào le pàichūsuǒ qù bào'àn.
The boys screamed in terror and ran to the police station to report it.
警察们赶到河岸边，发现了一具男孩的尸体，根据身高推测是七至九岁。
Jǐngchá men gǎndào hé ànbiān, fāxiàn le yíjù nánhái de shītǐ, gēnjù shēngāo tuīcè shì qī zhì jiǔsuì.
The police rushed to the bank and found the body of a boy who, judging by his height, was seven to nine years old.
他们先是排查了本村是否有失踪的小孩，随后电话汇报给河流上游的乡镇和城市。
Tāmen xiānshì páichá le běncūn shìfǒu yǒu shīzōng de xiǎohái, suíhòu diànhuà huìbào gěi héliú shàngyóu de xiāngzhèn hé chéngshì.
First they checked whether any child was missing in their own village, then phoned the towns and cities upstream.
王梅所在辖区的派出所接到电话时，已经是星期天中午。
Wáng Méi suǒzài xiáqū de pàichūsuǒ jiēdào diànhuà shí, yǐjīng shì xīngqītiān zhōngwǔ.
By the time the police station in Wang Mei's district got the call, it was Sunday noon.
他们立刻开车带着王梅夫妇前往发现尸体的县城。
Tāmen lìkè kāichē dài zhe Wáng Méi fūfù qiánwǎng fāxiàn shītǐ de xiànchéng.
They immediately drove Wang Mei and her husband to the county town where the body had been found.
尸体经过长时间的浸泡，皮肤已经开始脱落，面部特征难以辨认。
Shītǐ jīngguò zhǎngshíjiān de jìnpào, pífū yǐjīng kāishǐ tuōluò, miànbù tèzhēng nányǐbiànrèn.
After so long in the water, the skin had started to come away and the face was hard to recognise.
但尸体的脖子上系着一个红绳做的项链，上面还拴着一个小小的玉佩。
Dàn shītǐ de bózi shàngxì zhe yígè hóngshéng zuò de xiàngliàn, shàngmiàn hái shuānzhe yígè xiǎoxiǎode yùpèi.
But around the neck was a necklace of red string with a small jade pendant tied to it.
王梅就是通过这个项链确认这尸体就是天天的。
Wáng Méi jiùshì tōngguò zhège xiàngliàn quèrèn zhè shītǐ jiùshì Tiāntiān de.
It was by this necklace that Wang Mei confirmed the body was Tiantian.
即便早就预料到这个结果，王梅还是哭晕了过去。
Jíbiàn zǎojiù yùliàodào zhège jiéguǒ, Wáng Méi háishì kū yūn le guòqù.
Even though she had long expected it, Wang Mei cried until she fainted.
一场车祸事故，直接和间接地带走了三条鲜活的生命，三个家庭因此支离破碎。
Yīcháng chēhuò shìgù, zhíjiē hé jiànjiēdì dàizǒu le sāntiáo xiānhuó de shēngmìng, sāngè jiātíng yīncǐ zhīlípòsuì.
One car accident had, directly and indirectly, taken three young lives and torn three families apart.
可谓是人间惨剧呀。
Kěwèi shì rénjiān cǎnjù ya.
It was truly a human tragedy.
王梅的学校给她放了长假，让她好好调整一下。
Wáng Méi de xuéxiào gěi tā fàng le chángjià, ràng tā hǎohǎo tiáozhěng yíxià.
Wang Mei's school gave her a long leave to recover.
这丧子之痛要怎么调节呢？
Zhèsàngzi zhī tòngyào zěnme tiáojié ne?
But how do you recover from losing a child?
王梅没有动天天房间里的任何东西。
Wáng Méi méiyǒu dòng Tiāntiān fángjiān lǐ de rènhé dōngxī.
Wang Mei didn't touch anything in Tiantian's room.
她每夜睡在儿子的小床上，以泪洗面。
Tā měiyè shuì zài érzi de xiǎo chuángshàng, yǐlèixǐmiàn.
Every night she slept in her son's little bed, her face wet with tears.
吴建国也很伤心，但活着的人还要继续生活下去啊。
Wú Jiànguó yě hěn shāngxīn, dàn huózhe de rén háiyào jìxù shēnghuó xiàqù a.
Wu Jianguo was heartbroken too, but the living have to go on living.
他劝说王梅，他们可以再要一个小孩。
Tā quànshuō Wáng Méi, tāmen kěyǐ zàiyào yígè xiǎohái.
He tried to persuade Wang Mei that they could have another child.
他们才三十岁，再生一个小孩也不晚。
Tāmen cái sānshísuì, zàishēng yígè xiǎohái yě bùwǎn.
They were only thirty; it wasn't too late.
但王梅不愿意。
Dàn Wáng Méi bú yuànyì.
But Wang Mei didn't want to.
吴建国要去别的城市出差，他想让王梅也一起去，出去散散心。
Wú Jiànguó yào qù biéde chéngshì chūchāi, tā xiǎng ràng Wáng Méi yě yìqǐ qù, chūqù sànsànxīn.
Wu Jianguo had to go to another city on business and wanted Wang Mei to come too, to take her mind off things.
王梅也不想去。
Wáng Méi yě bùxiǎng qù.
Wang Mei didn't want to go either.
吴建国只好自己出差了。
Wú Jiànguó zhǐhǎo zìjǐ chūchāi le.
So Wu Jianguo went on his trip alone.
王梅躺在天天的小床上。
Wáng Méi tǎng zài Tiāntiān de xiǎo chuángshàng.
Wang Mei lay on Tiantian's little bed.
明明是夏日的中午，王梅还是感觉到异常冰冷，可她不想多加一床被子。
Míngmíng shì xiàrì de zhōngwǔ, Wáng Méi háishì gǎnjué dào yìcháng bīnglěng, kě tā bùxiǎng duōjiā yìchuáng bèizi.
Although it was a summer noon, she felt terribly cold, but she didn't want another quilt.
冷又怎样？再冷，能冷过暴雨后的河水吗？
Lěng yòu zěnyàng? Zài lěng, néng lěngguò bàoyǔ hòu de héshuǐ ma?
So what if she was cold? However cold, could it be colder than the river after the storm?
王梅就这么迷迷糊糊地睡着了。
Wáng Méi jiù zhème mímíhūhū de shuìzháo le.
And so Wang Mei drifted off to sleep.
梦里，儿子天天浑身发抖地站在河岸上，对着王梅哭泣。
Mènglǐ, érzi Tiāntiān húnshēnfādǒu dìzhàn zài hé'àn shàng, duì zhe Wáng Méi kūqì.
In her dream, Tiantian stood on the riverbank, shivering all over, crying to her.
王梅一下子惊醒。
Wáng Méi yíxiàzi jīngxǐng.
Wang Mei woke with a start.
梦里的河岸如此地熟悉，就是吴天天尸体被发现的那个岸边。
Mènglǐ de hé'àn rúcǐ de shúxī, jiùshì Wú Tiāntiān shītǐ bèi fāxiàn de nàge ànbiān.
The riverbank in the dream was so familiar: it was where Wu Tiantian's body had been found.
王梅立刻坐长途汽车去了那个县城，然后步行走到梦里的那个河边，
Wáng Méi lìkè zuò chángtúqìchē qù le nàge xiànchéng, ránhòu bùxíng zǒudào mènglǐ de nàge hébiān,
Wang Mei immediately took a long-distance bus to that county town and walked to the river from her dream.
坐在岸边的沙子上，嘤嘤地哭泣。
Zuòzài ànbiān de shāzi shàng, yīng yīng de kūqì.
She sat on the sand by the water and sobbed quietly.
哭了一会儿后，她决然向河里走去，抱着必死之心。
Kū le yíhuì'er hòu, tā juérán xiàng hélǐ zǒu qù, bào zhe bìsǐzhīxīn.
After crying for a while, she walked resolutely into the river, determined to die.
那也是一个盛夏。
Nà yě shì yígè shèngxià.
That too was high summer.
河水被太阳照了一天，非常温暖。
Héshuǐ bèi tàiyáng zhào le yìtiān, fēicháng wēnnuǎn.
The water had been in the sun all day and was very warm.
王梅走到河水快没过她胸部的位置时，突然听到了孩子的笑声。
Wáng Méi zǒu dào héshuǐ kuài mòguò tā xiōngbù de wèizhì shí, tūrán tīngdào le háizi de xiàoshēng.
When the water was almost up to her chest, she suddenly heard children laughing.
她回头一看，看到两个和天天年纪差不多大的男孩，
Tā huítóuyíkàn, kàndào liǎnggè hé Tiāntiān niánjì chàbuduō dà de nánhái,
She turned and saw two boys about Tiantian's age,
没有大人的陪伴，正在不远处的河里打闹嬉戏。
Méiyǒu dàrén de péibàn, zhèngzài bùyuǎnchù de hélǐ dǎnào xīxì.
with no adult around, splashing and playing in the river not far away.
“你们两个，快上岸去！不许在河里游泳！”王梅大喊，然后向两个小孩走去。
"Nǐmen liǎnggè, kuài shàng'àn qù! Bùxǔ zài hélǐ yóuyǒng!" Wáng Méi dàhǎn, ránhòu xiàng liǎnggè xiǎohái zǒu qù.
"You two, get out of the water now! No swimming in the river!" Wang Mei shouted, and went towards them.
那两个孩子被吓了一跳，连忙跑回岸边，穿上衣服逃跑。
Nà liǎnggè háizi bèi xiàleyítiào, liánmáng pǎo huí ànbiān, chuān shàng yīfú táopǎo.
The boys got a fright, rushed back to the bank, pulled on their clothes and ran away.
其实因为陈江和吴天天的溺水事故，
Qíshí yīnwèi Chén Jiāng hé Wú Tiāntiān de nìshuǐ shìgù,
In fact, because of Chen Jiang and Wu Tiantian drowning,
近几个月来，学校的老师和家长们都告诉孩子们不准下河游泳。
Jìnjǐgèyuè lái, xuéxiào de lǎoshī hé jiāzhǎng men dōu gàosù háizi men bùzhǔn xiàhé yóuyǒng.
for months teachers and parents had been telling children they must not swim in the river.
但总有顽皮的孩子偷偷下河。
Dàn zǒngyǒu wánpí de háizi tōutōu xiàhé.
But there were always naughty children who sneaked into the water.
王梅放弃了轻生的念头，在这个镇子住了下来。
Wáng Méi fàngqì le qīngshēng de niàntou, zài zhège zhènzi zhù le xiàlái.
Wang Mei gave up the idea of killing herself and settled in this town.
一部分是因为她觉得在这个镇上，她离天天的魂魄好像更近了一些。
Yībùfèn shìyīnwèi tā juéde zài zhège zhènshàng, tā lí Tiāntiān de húnpò hǎoxiàng gèngjìn le yìxiē.
Partly because she felt that in this town she was a little closer to Tiantian's soul.
另外，她仿佛被赋予了使命：每天巡视河边，不让小孩子下河游泳，
Lìngwài, tā fǎngfú bèi fùyǔ le shǐmìng: měitiān xúnshì hébiān, búràng xiǎoháizi xiàhé yóuyǒng,
And she seemed to have been given a mission: patrolling the river every day so children wouldn't swim in it,
成为了周围村子孩子们的守护人。
Chéngwéi le zhōuwéi cūnzi háizi men de shǒuhùrén.
she became the guardian of the children of the surrounding villages.
吴建国多次来劝她回市里去，恢复他们的生活。
Wú Jiànguó duōcì lái quàn tā huí shìlǐ qù, huīfù tāmen de shēnghuó.
Wu Jianguo came many times to persuade her to come back to the city and resume their life.
王梅不同意，反倒正式向学校辞了职，来到镇上的中学工作。
Wáng Méi bù tóngyì, fǎndào zhèngshì xiàng xuéxiào cí le zhí, láidào zhènshàng de zhōngxué gōngzuò.
Wang Mei refused; instead she formally resigned from her school and took a job at the town's secondary school.
吴建国无法忍受这样的生活，和王梅离婚了。
Wú Jiànguó wúfǎrěnshòu zhèyàng de shēnghuó, hé Wáng Méi líhūn le.
Wu Jianguo couldn't bear this life, and he and Wang Mei divorced.
时光荏苒，二十五年过去。
Shíguāngrěnrǎn, èrshíwǔnián guòqù.
Time slipped by, and twenty-five years passed.
王梅收回思绪，用河水洗了一把脸，推着电瓶车，向江阳家走去。
Wáng Méi shōuhuí sīxù, yòng héshuǐ xǐ le yìbǎ liǎn, tuī zhe diànpíngchē, xiàng Jiāng Yáng jiā zǒu qù.
Wang Mei came back to the present, splashed river water on her face and, pushing her scooter, set off for Jiang Yang's home.

q: 暴雨在天亮以前停了。
Bàoyǔ zài tiānliàng yǐqián tíng le.
The storm stopped before dawn.
tf.why: It rained for hours and stopped just before it got light.

q: 警察在吴天天的日记里发现了奇怪的事情。
Jǐngchá zài Wú Tiāntiān de rìjì lǐ fāxiàn le qíguài de shìqíng.
The police found something strange in Wu Tiantian's diary.
tf.why: They looked at his room, bag and diary and found nothing strange.

q: 吴建国是一名警察。
Wú Jiànguó shì yìmíng jǐngchá.
Wu Jianguo is a policeman.
tf.why: He is a businessman.

q: 陈江的爸爸发现家里的鱼竿和捞网不见了。
Chén Jiāng de bàbà fāxiàn jiālǐ de yúgān hé lāo wǎng bújiàn le.
Chen Jiang's father noticed the fishing rod and net were missing.
tf.why: That was the lead the young policeman brought.

q: 一个出租车司机看见了两个孩子。
Yígè chūzūchē sījī kànjiàn le liǎnggè háizi.
A taxi driver saw the two boys.
tf.why: It was a bus driver.

q: 警察在河边的树上找到了两个孩子的衣服。
Jǐngchá zài hébiān de shùshàng zhǎodào le liǎnggè háizi de yīfú.
The police found both boys' clothes in trees by the river.
tf.why: A blue shirt (Tiantian's) and then Chen Jiang's clothes, each in a tree fork.

q: 陈江的尸体是在一个县城里被几个少年发现的。
Chén Jiāng de shītǐ shì zài yígè xiànchéng lǐ bèi jǐgè shàonián fāxiàn de.
Chen Jiang's body was found by some teenagers in a county town.
tf.why: The teenagers found Tiantian's body; Chen Jiang was pulled out downstream by the police.

q: 王梅是通过一条红绳项链认出儿子的。
Wáng Méi shì tōngguò yìtiáo hóngshéng xiàngliàn rènchū érzi de.
Wang Mei recognised her son by a red-string necklace.
tf.why: The face couldn't be recognised, but the necklace with the jade pendant could.

q: 吴天天的玉佩是他奶奶送给他的。
Wú Tiāntiān de yùpèi shì tā nǎinǎi sònggěi tā de.
Tiantian's jade pendant was a present from his grandmother.
tf.why: We aren't told where the pendant came from.

q: 吴建国想再要一个孩子，王梅也同意了。
Wú Jiànguó xiǎng zài yào yígè háizi, Wáng Méi yě tóngyì le.
Wu Jianguo wanted another child, and Wang Mei agreed.
tf.why: Wang Mei didn't want to.

q: 王梅走进河里时，听到了孩子的笑声。
Wáng Méi zǒujìn hélǐ shí, tīngdào le háizi de xiàoshēng.
As Wang Mei walked into the river, she heard children laughing.
tf.why: Two boys were playing in the water nearby.

q: 王梅后来在镇上的小学工作。
Wáng Méi hòulái zài zhènshàng de xiǎoxué gōngzuò.
Wang Mei later worked at the town's primary school.
tf.why: She took a job at the town's secondary school.

q: 王梅和吴建国后来又生了一个女儿。
Wáng Méi hé Wú Jiànguó hòulái yòushēng le yígè nǚ'ér.
Wang Mei and Wu Jianguo later had a daughter.
tf.why: They divorced; there was no other child.

q: 吴建国为什么生气？
Wú Jiànguó wèishénme shēngqì?
Why was Wu Jianguo angry?
o: Because the police came too late
因为他觉得警察在家里盘问他们是浪费时间
Yīnwèi tā juéde jǐngchá zài jiālǐ pánwèn tāmen shì làngfèishíjiān
Because he felt questioning them at home was a waste of time
Yīnwèi Wáng Méi méiyǒu gàosù tā
Because Wang Mei hadn't told him
mc.why: He thought the police should be out searching, not questioning the parents.

q: 警察为什么认为孩子们是去游泳了？
Jǐngchá wèishénme rènwéi háizi men shì qù yóuyǒng le?
Why did the police think the boys had gone swimming?
o: 因为有人看见他们游泳
因为他们的衣服挂在树上
Yīnwèi tāmen de yīfú guà zài shùshàng
Because their clothes were hanging in trees
mc.why: The clothes were hung at a child's height, as if taken off before swimming.

q: 王梅为什么没有走进河里死去？
Wáng Méi wèishénme méiyǒu zǒujìn hélǐ sǐqù?
Why didn't Wang Mei drown herself?
o: Because the water was too cold
Yīnwèi tā de zhàngfū lái le
因为她看见两个男孩在河里玩，就去叫他们上岸
Yīnwèi tā kànjiàn liǎnggè nánhái zài hélǐ wán, jiù qù jiào tāmen shàng'àn
Because she saw two boys playing in the river and went to make them get out
mc.why: The two boys made her shout and go after them, and she gave up the idea.

q: 王梅为什么觉得自己是一个“失职的母亲”？
Wáng Méi wèishénme juéde zìjǐ shì yígè "shīzhí de mǔqīn"?
Why does Wang Mei feel she was a mother who failed in her duty?
ans: 因为她让八岁的儿子一个人回家，也没有请别人照顾他。
Yīnwèi tā ràng bāsuì de érzi yígè rén huíjiā, yě méiyǒu qǐng biérén zhàogù tā.
Because she let her eight-year-old son go home alone and didn't ask anyone to look after him.

q: 王梅为什么留在那个镇上？
Wáng Méi wèishénme liúzài nàge zhènshàng?
Why did Wang Mei stay in that town?
ans: 她觉得在那里离天天更近，而且她要保护孩子们，不让他们下河游泳。
Tā juéde zài nàlǐ lí Tiāntiān gèngjìn, érqiě tā yào bǎohù háizi men, búràng tāmen xiàhé yóuyǒng.
She felt closer to Tiantian there, and she wanted to protect children by keeping them out of the river.

q: “守护人”是什么意思？在这一章里谁是守护人？
"Shǒuhùrén" shì shénme yìsi? Zài zhè yìzhāng lǐ shuí shì shǒuhùrén?
What does 守护人 mean? Who is the guardian in this chapter?
ans: 守护人就是保护别人的人。王梅每天巡视河边，是孩子们的守护人。
Shǒuhùrén jiùshì bǎohù biérén de rén. Wáng Méi měitiān xúnshì hébiān, shì háizi men de shǒuhùrén.
A guardian is someone who protects others. Wang Mei, who patrols the river every day, is the children's guardian.

003.title: Chapter 3 · A Mysterious Call

blocks.label: 章
lines: 第三章 神秘来电
Dìsānzhāng shénmì láidiàn
Chapter 3: A Mysterious Call
江阳今天逃学了。
Jiāng Yáng jīntiān táoxué le.
Today Jiang Yang skipped school.
自从爸妈离婚后，他就不想学习。
Zìcóng bàmā líhūn hòu, tā jiù bùxiǎng xuéxí.
Ever since his parents divorced, he hadn't wanted to study.
虽然在爸妈离婚之前，他们就长期缺席自己的生活，但是过年的时候，他们还是会回来，有时还会带礼物给他。
Suīrán zài bàmā líhūn zhīqián, tāmen jiù chángqī quēxí zìjǐ de shēnghuó, dànshì guònián de shíhòu, tāmen háishì huì huílái, yǒushí háihuì dài lǐwù gěi tā.
Even before the divorce they had long been missing from his life, but they still came home at New Year, sometimes with presents for him.
妈妈曾经说过，让他好好学习，如果考得好，就带他去广州生活。
Māmā céngjīng shuō guò, ràng tā hǎohǎoxuéxí, rúguǒ kǎodé hǎo, jiù dài tā qù guǎngzhōu shēnghuó.

Jiāng Yáng dǎkāi diànhuàtíng de mén, zǒu le jìnqù, zhàn zài lǐmiàn sìchùzhāngwàng.
Jiang Yang opened the door, stepped in and stood looking around.
叮铃铃，叮铃铃！
Dīnglínglíng, dīnglínglíng!
Ring-ring! Ring-ring!
电话铃突然响了，吓了江阳一跳。
Diànhuàlíng tūrán xiǎng le, xià le Jiāng Yáng yítiào.
The phone suddenly rang, making Jiang Yang jump.
他犹豫了几秒钟，还是拿起了电话。
Tā yóuyù le jǐmiǎozhōng, háishì ná qǐ le diànhuà.
He hesitated a few seconds, then picked it up.
"Wèi?"
"Hello?"
“我是黑暗之神。我可以实现你一个愿望。说吧，你的愿望是什么？”
"Wǒ shì Hēi'àn zhī Shén. Wǒ kěyǐ shíxiàn nǐ yígè yuànwàng. Shuō ba, nǐ de yuànwàng shì shénme?"
"I am the God of Darkness. I can grant you one wish. Speak: what is your wish?"

，即便是在大白天的，也看不到一个人影。

q: 江阳的妈妈答应过，如果他考得好，就带他去广州。
Jiāng Yáng de māmā dāyìng guò, rúguǒ tā kǎodé hǎo, jiù dài tā qù guǎngzhōu.
Jiang Yang's mother once promised to take him to Guangzhou if he did well in exams.
tf.why: She said so, but now she has a new family.

tf.why: She is a woman in her fifties.

Wánglǎoshī jiào de liǎnggè bān yīngyǔ chéngjì shì quánnián jí zuìhǎo de.

tf.why: The old fridge had nothing in it.

Jiang Yang enjoyed eating with Teacher Wang.
tf.why: He didn't enjoy it; he hated the way she looked at him.

q: 江阳的好朋友搬到了深圳。

tf.why: His parents took him to school in Shenzhen.

His friend phones him every month.
tf.why: The chapter doesn't say whether they keep in touch.

q: 那个老街区人很多，很热闹。
Nàge lǎojiēqū rén hěnduō, hěn rènào.
The old neighbourhood was crowded and lively.
tf.why: It was deserted; not a soul in sight.

q: 书店里的老太太在看书。
Shūdiàn lǐ de lǎotàitài zài kànshū.
The old woman in the bookshop was reading.
tf.why: She was sitting with her eyes closed, apparently asleep.

q: 电话亭的玻璃很干净，好像每天有人擦。
Diànhuàtíng de bōlí hěn gānjìng, hǎoxiàng měitiān yǒurén cā.
The glass of the phone booth was clean, as if someone wiped it every day.
tf.why: Lots of scratches but no dirt.

q: 江阳以前用过电话亭打电话。
Jiāng Yáng yǐqián yòngguò diànhuàtíng dǎdiànhuà.
Jiang Yang had used a phone booth before.
tf.why: He'd only seen them on TV.

q: 江阳为什么逃学？
Jiāng Yáng wèishénme táoxué?
Why did Jiang Yang skip school?
o: 因为王老师总是管着他，他受够了
Yīnwèi wánglǎoshī zǒngshì guǎnzhe tā, tā shòugòule
Because Teacher Wang was always on his case and he'd had enough
Because he was going to Shenzhen
因为奶奶让他去卖东西
Yīnwèi nǎinǎi ràng tā qù màidōngxī
Because his grandmother sent him to sell things
mc.why: He was fed up with Teacher Wang always checking up on him.

q: 江阳是怎么去城市的？
Jiāng Yáng shì zěnme qù chéngshì de?
How did Jiang Yang get to the city?
o: 用朋友送的公交卡坐公交车
Yòng péngyǒu sòng de gōngjiāo kǎzuò gōngjiāochē
By bus, with the card his friend gave him
mc.why: He used his friend's IC bus card.

q: 那家书店是什么样的书店？
Nà jiā shūdiàn shì shénmeyàng de shūdiàn?
What kind of bookshop was it?

mc.why: All the books were used.

q: 电话里的声音说了什么？
Diànhuà lǐ de shēngyīn shuō le shénme?
What did the voice on the phone say?
o: “我是黑暗之神，我可以实现你一个愿望。”
"Wǒ shì Hēi'àn zhī Shén, wǒ kěyǐ shíxiàn nǐ yígè yuànwàng."
"I am the God of Darkness, I can grant you a wish."
mc.why: The God of Darkness offers one wish.

q: 江阳为什么觉得父母是“熟悉的陌生人”？
Jiāng Yáng wèishénme juéde fùmǔ shì "shúxī de mòshēngrén"?
Why does Jiang Yang feel his parents are "familiar strangers"?
ans: 因为父母很早就去城市打工，很少在他身边，后来离婚了，都不要他。
Yīnwèi fùmǔ hěn zǎojiù qù chéngshì dǎgōng, hěnshǎo zài tā shēnbiān, hòulái líhūn le, dōu búyào tā.
Because they left for the city when he was small, were hardly ever with him, then divorced and neither wanted him.

q: 王老师是怎么关心江阳的？说两件事。
Wánglǎoshī shì zěnme guānxīn Jiāng Yáng de? Shuō liǎngjiànshì.
How does Teacher Wang look after Jiang Yang? Give two examples.
ans: 她检查他的作业，让他在办公室做练习题，还带他去吃饭。
Tā jiǎnchá tā de zuòyè, ràng tā zài bàngōngshì zuò liànxítí, hái dài tā qù chīfàn.
She checks his homework, makes him do exercises in the office, and takes him out to eat.

q: 电话亭是什么样的？
Diànhuàtíng shì shénmeyàng de?
What was the phone booth like?
ans: 是封闭式的，顶部和框架是金属的，油漆掉了，墙和门是玻璃做的，玻璃很干净。
Shì fēngbìshì de, dǐngbù hé kuāngjià shì jīnshǔ de, yóuqī diào le, qiánghémén shì bōlí zuò de, bōlí hěn gānjìng.
Enclosed, with a metal roof and frame, the paint peeling off, glass walls and door, and the glass very clean.

004.title: Chapter 4 · Teacher, I Wish You Were Ill

blocks.label: 章
lines: 第四章 老师，我希望你生病
Dìsìzhāng lǎoshī, wǒ xīwàng nǐ shēngbìng
Chapter 4: Teacher, I Wish You Were Ill
电话里传来的声音低沉又冷淡，听起来是成年男性的声音。
Diànhuà lǐ chuánlái de shēngyīn dīchén yòu lěngdàn, tīng qǐlái shì chéngnián nánxìng de shēngyīn.
The voice on the phone was deep and cold; it sounded like a grown man.
江阳觉得有点好笑。
Jiāng Yáng juéde yǒudiǎn hǎoxiào.
Jiang Yang found it a bit funny.
怎么有人比自己还无聊呀？
Zěnme yǒurén bǐ zìjǐ hái wúliáo ya?
How could anyone be even more bored than he was?
这个恶作剧还挺有创意。
Zhège èzuòjù hái tǐng yǒu chuàngyì.
This prank was quite creative.
“我的愿望就是你给我一千万块钱。”江阳开玩笑地回答。
"Wǒ de yuànwàng jiùshì nǐ gěi wǒ yīqiānwàn kuàiqián." Jiāng Yáng kāiwánxiào de huídá.
"My wish is for you to give me ten million yuan," Jiang Yang answered jokingly.
“不行。我是黑暗之神，我只能实现你坏的、邪恶的愿望。”
"Bùxíng. Wǒ shì Hēi'àn zhī Shén, wǒ zhǐnéng shíxiàn nǐ huài de, xié'è de yuànwàng."
"No. I am the God of Darkness. I can only grant bad, evil wishes."
“邪恶的愿望？比如毁灭这座城市之类的吗？”
"Xié'è de yuànwàng? Bǐrú huǐmiè zhèzuò chéngshì zhīlèi de ma?"
"Evil wishes? Like destroying this city or something?"
“没错。毁灭城市是你的愿望吗？”
"Méicuò. Huǐmiè chéngshì shì nǐ de yuànwàng ma?"
"Exactly. Is destroying the city your wish?"
“哦，不是。那我希望我的英语老师生病，不要再来学校了。”
"Ó, búshì. Nà wǒ xīwàng wǒ de yīngyǔlǎoshī shēngbìng, búyào zài lái xuéxiào le."
"Oh, no. Then I wish my English teacher would get ill and stop coming to school."
“好。马上实现你的愿望。”
"Hǎo. Mǎshàng shíxiàn nǐ de yuànwàng."
"Very well. Your wish will be granted at once."
话音一落，电话就挂断了。
Huàyīn yíluò, diànhuà jiù guàduàn le.
The moment the words were spoken, the line went dead.
江阳愣在原地。
Jiāng Yáng lèng zài yuándì.
Jiang Yang stood there, stunned.
过了一会儿，他咧嘴笑了，嘴里嘀咕着：
Guò le yíhuì'er, tā liězuǐ xiào le, zuǐlǐ dígū zhe:
After a while he grinned and muttered to himself:
“看来这人不是恶作剧，是个神经病吧。要是这个世界上真的有神就好了。”
"Kànlái zhè rén búshì èzuòjù, shì gè shénjīngbìng ba. Yàoshì zhège shìjiè shàng zhēnde yǒushén jiù hǎo le."
"So it's not a prank, he's just a nutcase. If only there really were gods in this world."
江阳又游荡了一会儿，然后坐公交车回家了。
Jiāng Yáng yòu yóudàng le yíhuì'er, ránhòu zuò gōngjiāochē huíjiā le.
Jiang Yang wandered around a bit longer, then took the bus home.
自从英语老师盯上他之后，他已经快忘了饿肚子的感觉。
Zìcóng yīngyǔlǎoshī dīngshàng tā zhīhòu, tā yǐjīng kuài wàng le èdǔzi de gǎnjué.
Since the English teacher had started keeping an eye on him, he had almost forgotten what being hungry felt like.
因为王老师每天叫他去办公室做题，之后给他买饭吃。
Yīnwèi wánglǎoshī měitiān jiào tā qù bàngōngshì zuò tí, zhīhòu gěi tā mǎifàn chī.
Every day Teacher Wang called him to the office to do exercises and afterwards bought him a meal.
但今天他只吃了两个馒头，肚子开始咕咕叫。
Dàn jīntiān tā zhǐ chī le liǎnggè mántou, dǔzi kāishǐ gūgū jiào.
But today he'd only eaten two steamed buns, and his stomach began to rumble.
不过，他此刻担心的不是肚子饿，而是逃学的后果。
Búguò, tā cǐkè dānxīn de búshì dùzi'è, érshì táoxué de hòuguǒ.
But what worried him now wasn't hunger, it was what would happen for skipping school.
如果王老师发现他没上学，肯定要打电话给爷爷奶奶的吧。
Rúguǒ wánglǎoshī fāxiàn tā méi shàngxué, kěndìng yào dǎdiànhuà gěi yéyénǎinǎi de ba.
If Teacher Wang found out he hadn't been at school, she'd surely phone his grandparents.
他有些胆怯地回到家。
Tā yǒuxiē dǎnqiè de huídào jiā.
He came home a little scared.
爷爷奶奶还没回来，应该还在镇上的农贸市场卖菜。
Yéyénǎinǎi hái méi huílái, yīnggāi hái zài zhènshàng de nóngmàoshìchǎng màicài.
His grandparents weren't back yet; they must still be selling vegetables at the town market.
江阳翻遍了厨房，找到了几个土豆。
Jiāng Yáng fānbiàn le chúfáng, zhǎodào le jǐgè tǔdòu.
Jiang Yang searched the whole kitchen and found a few potatoes.
他用水煮熟了土豆，就着盐巴吃掉了土豆。
Tā yòngshuǐ zhǔshú le tǔdòu, jiù zhe yánbā chīdiào le tǔdòu.
He boiled them and ate them with salt.
吃完后，他无所事事地坐在房间里，回想着今天的电话亭和他许下的坏愿望。
Chī wánhòu, tā wúsuǒshìshì de zuòzài fángjiān lǐ, huíxiǎng zhe jīntiān de diànhuàtíng hé tā xǔxià de huài yuànwàng.
Afterwards he sat in his room with nothing to do, thinking about the phone booth and the bad wish he had made.
墙上的时钟滴答滴答地响着。
Qiángshàng de shízhōng dīdā dīdā dìxiǎng zhe.
The clock on the wall ticked away.
他发现自己不知道什么时候拿出了作业，正在做着英语题。
Tā fāxiànzìjǐ bù zhīdào shénme shíhòu náchū le zuòyè, zhèngzài zuò zhe yīngyǔ tí.
He realised that at some point he had taken out his homework and was doing English exercises.
该死！
Gāisǐ!
Damn!
他把英语题扔到一边，冲着无人的房间喊着：“讨厌的王老师，真的希望你生病！”
Tā bǎ yīngyǔ tí rēng dào yìbiān, chōngzhe wúrén de fángjiān hǎn zhe: "tǎoyàn de wánglǎoshī, zhēnde xīwàng nǐ shēngbìng!"
He flung the exercises aside and shouted into the empty room, "Horrible Teacher Wang, I really hope you get ill!"
第二天早上，他去上学了。
Dì'èrtiān zǎoshàng, tā qù shàngxué le.
The next morning he went to school.
第一节课是英语课。
Dìyījié kèshì yīngyǔkè.
The first lesson was English.
他内心琢磨着，王老师看见自己，会是什么表现呢？生气？还是没有表情？
Tā nèixīn zhuómó zhe, wánglǎoshī kànjiàn zìjǐ, huì shì shénme biǎoxiàn ne? Shēngqì? Háishì méiyǒu biǎoqíng?
He wondered how Teacher Wang would react when she saw him. Angry? Or no expression at all?
然而，王老师没有来。
Rán'ér, wánglǎoshī méiyǒu lái.
But Teacher Wang didn't come.
走进来的是初二的一位英语老师。
Zǒujìn lái de shì chū'èr de yíwèi yīngyǔlǎoshī.
In walked an English teacher from the second year.
他说，王老师请病假了，短时间内不会来上课。
Tā shuō, wánglǎoshī qǐng bìngjià le, duǎnshíjiān nèi búhuì lái shàngkè.
He said Teacher Wang was on sick leave and wouldn't be teaching for a while.
王老师生病了？
Wánglǎoshī shēngbìng le?
Teacher Wang was ill?
江阳有些懵，胡思乱想了一节课。
Jiāng Yáng yǒuxiē měng, húsīluànxiǎng le yìjiékè.
Jiang Yang was dazed; his thoughts ran wild the whole lesson.
下课后，新的英语老师问：“哪位同学叫江阳？”
Xiàkèhòu, xīn de yīngyǔlǎoshī wèn: "nǎwèi tóngxué jiào Jiāng Yáng?"
After class the new English teacher asked, "Which of you is Jiang Yang?"
江阳麻木地举起了手。
Jiāng Yáng mámù de jǔqǐ le shǒu.
Jiang Yang numbly raised his hand.
老师让江阳跟他去办公室。
Lǎoshī ràng Jiāng Yáng gēn tā qù bàngōngshì.
The teacher had him come to the office.
到了办公室后，老师给了他几本练习册，还有一张教师食堂的饭卡。
Dào le bàngōngshì hòu, lǎoshī gěi le tā jǐběn liànxícè, háiyǒu yìzhāng jiàoshī shítáng de fànkǎ.
There he gave Jiang Yang some workbooks and a meal card for the teachers' canteen.
学生们去的食堂只提供免费的早餐和午餐，但是教师们的小食堂可以提供一日三餐。
Xuéshēng men qù de shítáng zhǐ tígōng miǎnfèi de zǎocān hé wǔcān, dànshì jiàoshī men de xiǎo shítáng kěyǐ tígōng yīrìsāncān.
The students' canteen only gave free breakfast and lunch, but the small teachers' canteen served three meals a day.
王老师晚上经常带江阳去教师食堂吃饭。
Wánglǎoshī wǎnshàng jīngcháng dài Jiāng Yáng qù jiàoshī shítáng chīfàn.
Teacher Wang often took Jiang Yang to eat in the teachers' canteen in the evening.
学校领导们知道江阳家的状况，再加上每次都是王老师付费的，所以就默许了这件事。
Xuéxiào lǐngdǎo men zhīdào Jiāng Yáng jiā de zhuàngkuàng, zài jiāshàng měicì dōu shì wánglǎoshī fùfèi de, suǒyǐ jiù mòxǔ le zhèjiàn shì.
The school heads knew about his family, and Teacher Wang always paid, so they quietly allowed it.
新的英语老师说：“王老师让我给你的。她说，让你好好吃饭，好好学习。等她回来，要检查你做的题。”
Xīn de yīngyǔlǎoshī shuō: "wánglǎoshī ràng wǒ gěi nǐ de. Tā shuō, ràng nǐ hǎohǎo chīfàn, hǎohǎoxuéxí. Děng tā huílái, yào jiǎnchá nǐ zuò de tí."
The new teacher said, "Teacher Wang asked me to give you these. She says eat properly and study hard. When she's back, she'll check your exercises."
江阳欲言又止。
Jiāng Yáng yùyányòuzhǐ.
Jiang Yang started to speak, then stopped.
他实在没有勇气去问王老师怎么了，生了什么病。
Tā shízài méiyǒuyǒngqì qù wèn wánglǎoshī zěnme le, shēng le shénme bìng.
He didn't have the courage to ask what was wrong with Teacher Wang, what illness she had.
中午过后，他又逃学了。
Zhōngwǔ guòhòu, tā yòu táoxué le.
After lunch he skipped school again.
他急匆匆地坐上去市里的公交车，按照那天的路线，想要找到那个电话亭，

Nǎinǎi wèishénme kàndào chéngjìdān bùzhī shì xǐ shì yōu?
Why was Grandma both happy and worried about the report card?
o: 因为她担心没钱让江阳上高中和大学
Yīnwèi tā dānxīn méiqián ràng Jiāng Yáng shàng gāozhōng hé dàxué
Because she worried there was no money for high school and university
Yīnwèi Jiāng Yáng de yīngyǔ bùhǎo
mc.why: Further study costs money they don't have.

q: 王梅告诉爷爷奶奶什么好消息？
Wáng Méi gàosù yéyénǎinǎi shénme hǎoxiāoxī?
What good news did Wang Mei give the grandparents?
o: Jiāng Yáng kěyǐ qù guǎngzhōu shàngxué
Jiang Yang can go to school in Guangzhou
上高中有奖学金，上大学有助学贷款
Shàng gāozhōng yǒu jiǎngxuéjīn, shàng dàxué yǒu zhùxué dàikuǎn
There are grants for high school and loans for university
The school will give them money
Jiāng Yáng de māmā yào huílái le
mc.why: Grants for poor students and student loans mean money needn't stop him.

q: 江阳许了什么愿望？他后来为什么后悔？
Jiāng Yáng xǔle shénme yuànwàng? Tā hòulái wèishénme hòuhuǐ?
What did Jiang Yang wish for, and why did he regret it?
ans: 他希望英语老师生病。后来王老师真的请了病假，他担心是自己的愿望害了她。
Tā xīwàng yīngyǔlǎoshī shēngbìng. Hòulái wánglǎoshī zhēnde qǐng le bìngjià, tā dānxīn shì zìjǐ de yuànwàng hài le tā.
He wished his English teacher would fall ill. Then she really went on sick leave, and he feared his wish had harmed her.

q: 王老师不在的时候，江阳有什么变化？
Wánglǎoshī bú zài de shíhòu, Jiāng Yáng yǒu shénme biànhuà?
How did Jiang Yang change while Teacher Wang was away?
ans: 他每天按时上学，认真做练习题，英语考了一百分。
Tā měitiān ànshí shàngxué, rènzhēn zuò liànxítí, yīngyǔ kǎole yìbǎifēn.
He went to school on time every day, did his exercises, and got a hundred in English.

q: 王梅为什么去菜市场？
Wáng Méi wèishénme qù càishìchǎng?
Why did Wang Mei go to the market?
ans: 因为她觉得江阳最近行动可疑，想看看他在不在那里。
Yīnwèi tā juéde Jiāng Yáng zuìjìn xíngdòng kěyí, xiǎng kànkàn tā zài bú zài nàlǐ.
Because she felt Jiang Yang had been acting suspiciously and wanted to see if he was there.

005.title: Chapter 5 · The Bus Driver's Secret

blocks.label: 章
lines: 第五章 公交车司机的秘密
Dìwǔzhāng gōngjiāochē sījī de mìmì
Chapter 5: The Bus Driver's Secret
11路公交车是一条已经运营了二十多年的公交线路。
11 lù gōngjiāochē shì yìtiáo yǐjīng yùnyíng le èrshíduōnián de gōngjiāoxiànlù.
The No. 11 bus is a route that has been running for over twenty years.
期间，由于修路或者区域重建而改过路线，但是它的始发站和终点站从来没有变过。
Qījiān, yóuyú xiūlù huòzhě qūyù chóngjiàn ér gǎiguò lùxiàn, dànshì tā de shǐfāzhàn hé zhōngdiǎnzhàn cónglái méiyǒu biàn guò.
In that time the route has changed because of roadworks or rebuilding, but its first and last stops have never changed.
司机会从人民广场站出发，从西至东穿过整个城市，到达市第三人民医院站，
Sījī huì cóng rénmínguǎngchǎng zhàn chūfā, cóng xīzhìdōng chuānguò zhěnggè chéngshì, dàodá shì dìsān rénmín yīyuàn zhàn,
The driver sets off from People's Square, crosses the whole city from west to east and reaches the City No. 3 People's Hospital stop,
然后立刻返回，按照同样的路线，回到人民广场站。
Ránhòu lìkè fǎnhuí, ànzhào tóngyàng de lùxiàn, huídào rénmínguǎngchǎng zhàn.
then turns straight back and follows the same route back to People's Square.
全程约两个半小时。
Quánchéng yuē liǎnggè bànxiǎoshí.
The whole trip takes about two and a half hours.
公交车司机只有在返回人民广场站时，才有机会去卫生间。
Gōngjiāochē sījī zhǐyǒu zài fǎnhuí rénmínguǎngchǎng zhàn shí, cái yǒu jīhuì qù wèishēngjiān.
Only when he gets back to People's Square does the driver get a chance to go to the toilet.
另外，由于途经农贸市场、市中心商业区、办公楼密集区域和两所学校，公交车上经常挤满了乘客。
Lìngwài, yóuyú tújīng nóngmàoshìchǎng, shìzhōngxīn shāngyèqū, bàngōnglóu mìjí qūyù hé liǎngsuǒ xuéxiào, gōngjiāochē shàng jīngcháng jǐmǎn le chéngkè.
Also, since it passes a farmers' market, the city-centre shopping district, an area packed with office blocks and two schools, the bus is often crammed with passengers.
所以这条公交线路对于司机们来说是一条很辛苦的线路。
Suǒyǐ zhè tiáo gōngjiāoxiànlù duìyú sījī men láishuō shì yìtiáo hěn xīnkǔ de xiànlù.
So for drivers this is a very hard route.
很多公交车司机都不愿意跑这趟线路，经常开了几年后就申请转到其他公交线路上去工作。
Hěnduō gōngjiāochē sījī dōu bú yuànyì pǎo zhètàng xiànlù, jīngcháng kāi le jǐnián hòu jiù shēnqǐng zhuǎn dào qítā gōngjiāoxiànlù shàngqù gōngzuò.
Many drivers don't want to work it, and after a few years they often apply to move to other routes.
只有李良在这条线路上工作了将近二十年。
Zhǐyǒu Lǐ Liáng zài zhètiáo xiànlù shàng gōngzuò le jiāngjìn èrshínián.
Only Li Liang has worked this route for nearly twenty years.
李良个子很高，身材也很壮。
Lǐ Liáng gèzi hěn gāo, shēncái yě hěn zhuàng.
Li Liang is tall and powerfully built.
据说他常年跑步健身，长着一身的腱子肉。
Jùshuō tā chángnián pǎobù jiànshēn, zhǎngzhe yìshēn de jiànzi ròu.
They say he has run and worked out for years and is all muscle.
他性格非常沉默寡言。
Tā xìnggé fēicháng chénmòguǎyán.
He is very quiet and says little.
在公交公司工作了二十年，一个关系亲近的同事都没有。
Zài gōngjiāogōngsī gōngzuò le èrshínián, yígè guānxì qīnjìn de tóngshì dōu méiyǒu.
In twenty years at the bus company, he hasn't got close to a single colleague.
相反，同事们都有些怕他，因为他的面相有些凶，而且脸上有一条长长的疤痕。
Xiāngfǎn, tóngshì men dōu yǒuxiē pà tā, yīnwèi tā de miànxiàng yǒuxiē xiōng, érqiě liǎnshàng yǒu yìtiáo chángchángde bāhén.
On the contrary, his colleagues are a little afraid of him, because he looks rather fierce and has a long scar on his face.
甚至有传言说，李良曾经坐过牢。
Shènzhì yǒu chuányán shuō, Lǐ Liáng céngjīng zuòguò láo.
There's even a rumour that he has been in prison.
但李良工作上非常任劳任怨。
Dàn Lǐ Liáng gōngzuò shàng fēicháng rènláorènyuàn.
But at work Li Liang never complains, however hard the job.
节假日里，很多同事都抢着休息，想要和家人共度佳节。
Jiéjiàrì lǐ, hěnduō tóngshì dōu qiǎng zhe xiūxī, xiǎngyào hé jiārén gòngdù jiājié.
On public holidays, many colleagues rush to take time off to celebrate with their families.
那些没人愿意工作的时段都是李良在工作。
Nàxiē méi rén yuànyì gōngzuò de shíduàn dōu shì Lǐ Liáng zài gōngzuò.
The shifts nobody wants are all worked by Li Liang.
二十年来，李良从来没有在春节休息过。
Èrshínián lái, Lǐ Liáng cónglái méiyǒu zài chūnjié xiūxī guò.
In twenty years, he has never taken Spring Festival off.
平日里也是如此，每天最早一班车、最晚一班车，通常都是李良在跑。
Píngrì lǐ yě shì rúcǐ, měitiān zuìzǎo yì bānchē, zuìwǎn yì bānchē, tōngcháng dōu shì Lǐ Liáng zài pǎo.
Normal days are the same: the first bus and the last bus of the day are usually driven by Li Liang.
工作时间稍微久一点的同事们都知道，李良有一个奇怪的习惯。
Gōngzuò shíjiān shāowēi jiǔ yìdiǎn de tóngshì men dōu zhīdào, Lǐ Liáng yǒu yígè qíguài de xíguàn.
Colleagues who have been there a little longer all know Li Liang has a strange habit.
那就是，他每天中午必须要休息两个半小时。
Nà jiùshì, tā měitiān zhōngwǔ bìxū yào xiūxī liǎnggè bànxiǎoshí.
Every day at noon he must take a two-and-a-half-hour break.
这是他顶替同事们节假日班的交换条件。
Zhè shì tā dǐngtì tóngshì men jiéjiàrì bān de jiāohuàntiáojiàn.
That's what he gets in exchange for covering his colleagues' holiday shifts.
中午十一点多，李良的公交车回到始发站人民广场站。
Zhōngwǔ shíyìdiǎnduō, Lǐ Liáng de gōngjiāochē huídào shǐfāzhàn rénmínguǎngchǎng zhàn.
A little after eleven, Li Liang's bus gets back to the first stop, People's Square.
车上的乘客都下车后，他会把车开到十五分钟远的公交总站停车场，然后步行离开。
Chēshàng de chéngkè dōu xiàchē hòu, tāhuì bǎ chē kāidào shíwǔfēnzhōng yuǎn de gōngjiāo zǒngzhàn tíngchēchǎng, ránhòu bùxíng líkāi.
When all the passengers have got off, he drives to the main depot car park fifteen minutes away and then leaves on foot.
到了下午上班时，他会再次出现，从不迟到。
Dào le xiàwǔ shàngbān shí, tāhuì zàicìchūxiàn, cóngbù chídào.
When the afternoon shift starts he reappears, never late.
有胆大又好奇的同事曾经问过李良，他每天中午去做什么。
Yǒu dǎndà yòu hàoqí de tóngshì céngjīng wènguò Lǐ Liáng, tā měitiān zhōngwǔ qù zuò shénme.
A bold and curious colleague once asked him what he did every day at noon.
李良没有回答，只是冷冷地扫了同事一眼。
Lǐ Liáng méiyǒu huídá, zhǐshì lěnglěngdì sǎo le tóngshì yìyǎn.
Li Liang didn't answer; he just gave the colleague a cold glance.
暑假的某一天中午，李良把车开到人民广场站后，等着车上的乘客下车。
Shǔjià de mǒu yìtiān zhōngwǔ, Lǐ Liáng bǎ chē kāidào rénmínguǎngchǎng zhàn hòu, děng zhe chēshàng de chéngkè xiàchē.
One noon in the summer holidays, Li Liang drove into People's Square and waited for the passengers to get off.
最后的一个男学生走到驾驶座旁边，问李良：
Zuìhòu de yígè nán xuéshēng zǒu dào jiàshǐzuò pángbiān, wèn Lǐ Liáng:
The last one, a schoolboy, came up to the driver's seat and asked him:
“叔叔，请问你有没有见过这样的地方？”
"Shūshū, qǐngwèn nǐ yǒuméiyǒu jiànguò zhèyàng de dìfāng?"
"Excuse me, sir, have you ever seen a place like this?"
说着，那男生举起来一个本子。
Shuō zhe, nà nánshēng jǔ qǐlái yígè běnzi.
As he spoke, the boy held up a notebook.
上面是用铅笔画的简笔画，不怎么好看，但能看清楚画的是什么。
Shàngmiàn shì yòng qiānbǐhuà de jiǎnbǐhuà, bùzěnme hǎokàn, dàn néng kànqīngchǔ huà de shì shénme.
On it was a simple pencil sketch, not very good, but you could see clearly what it showed.
画上是一个丁字路口，路的这边有一个老式电话亭，路的另一边有一个书店，招牌上写着“博文书店”。
Huàshàng shì yígè dīngzì lùkǒu, lù de zhèbiān yǒu yígè lǎoshì diànhuàtíng, lù de lìngyìbiān yǒu yígè shūdiàn, zhāopái shàng xiě zhe "Bówén Shūdiàn".
It was a T-junction, with an old-fashioned phone booth on one side of the road and a bookshop on the other, its sign reading "Bowen Bookshop".
“你问这个做什么？”李良面无表情地问。
"Nǐ wèn zhège zuò shénme?" Lǐ Liáng miàn wúbiǎoqíng dìwèn.
"What do you want to know for?" Li Liang asked, expressionless.
“啊，我曾经在这里接到过一个神秘的电话，后来我就找不到这个电话亭了。叔叔，你见过它吗？”
"A, wǒ céngjīng zài zhèlǐ jiēdào guò yígè shénmì de diànhuà, hòulái wǒ jiù zhǎo búdào zhège diànhuàtíng le. Shūshū, nǐ jiàn guò tā ma?"
"Oh, I once got a mysterious phone call there, and afterwards I could never find the booth again. Have you seen it, sir?"
“没有。”
"Méiyǒu."
"No."
男生失望地下了车。
Nánshēng shīwàng dìxià le chē.
The boy got off, disappointed.
李良看他又坐上了返回的公交车后，才开车离开。
Lǐ Liáng kàn tā yòu zuò shàng le fǎnhuí de gōngjiāochē hòu, cái kāichē líkāi.
Li Liang waited until he had got on a bus going back before driving off.
他把车开回停车场，停好车后，从停车场走出来。
Tā bǎ chē kāihuí tíngchēchǎng, tínghǎo chēhòu, cóng tíngchēchǎng zǒu chūlái.
He drove back to the car park, parked and walked out.
一个扫地的大爷看到他，跟他打了个招呼。
Yígè sǎodì de dàyé kàndào tā, gēn tā dǎlegè zhāohū.
An old man sweeping the ground saw him and said hello.
李良冲大爷点点头，继续沉默地往前走。
Lǐ Liáng chōng dàyé diǎndiǎntóu, jìxù chénmò de wǎngqiánzǒu.
Li Liang nodded to him and walked on in silence.
走着走着，他突然想起他在哪里见过刚才那个男孩了。
Zǒu zhe zǒu zhe, tā tūrán xiǎngqǐ tā zài nǎlǐ jiànguò gāngcái nàge nánhái le.
As he walked, he suddenly remembered where he'd seen that boy before.
几个月前，那个男孩坐过他的车，在最后面的座位上睡着了。
Jǐgè yuè qián, nàge nánhái zuòguò tā de chē, zài zuìhòu miàn de zuòwèi shàng shuìzháo le.
A few months earlier, the boy had ridden on his bus and fallen asleep on the back seat.
导致车到达人民广场站时，李良没有看到他，就这样把他拉回了公交总站的停车场。
Dǎozhì chē dàodá rénmínguǎngchǎng zhàn shí, Lǐ Liáng méiyǒu kàndào tā, jiù zhèyàng bǎ tā lā huí le gōngjiāo zǒngzhàn de tíngchēchǎng.
So when the bus reached People's Square, Li Liang didn't see him, and carried him all the way back to the depot car park.
想到这时，李良已经七拐八拐，走到了一个古老的街区。
Xiǎngdào zhèshí, Lǐ Liáng yǐjīng qīguǎibāguǎi, zǒudào le yígè gǔlǎo de jiēqū.
By the time he'd remembered this, Li Liang had taken many twists and turns and reached an old neighbourhood.
他走进二手书店，把手里提着的重物递给书店里的一个男人。
Tā zǒujìn èrshǒu shūdiàn, bǎ shǒulǐ tízhe de zhòngwù dìgěi shūdiàn lǐ de yígè nánrén.
He went into the second-hand bookshop and handed the heavy bag he was carrying to a man inside.
那男人默不作声地接过那袋东西，进入了书店后面的一个空间里。
Nà nánrén mòbúzuòshēng de jiēguò nàdài dōngxī, jìnrù le shūdiàn hòumiàn de yígè kōngjiān lǐ.
Without a word the man took the bag and went into a space at the back of the shop.
李良看了看书店里的老太太。
Lǐ Liáng kàn le kànshū diànlǐ de lǎotàitài.
Li Liang looked at the old woman in the shop.
她正在收银台后面的椅子上睡觉。
Tā zhèngzài shōuyíntái hòumiàn de yǐzi shàng shuìjiào.
She was asleep on the chair behind the till.
李良走出了书店，来到电话亭前，向四周张望了一会儿，然后进入了电话亭，关上玻璃门。
Lǐ Liáng zǒuchū le shūdiàn, láidào diànhuàtíng qián, xiàng sìzhōu zhāngwàng le yíhuì'er, ránhòu jìnrù le diànhuàtíng, guānshàng bōlímén.
Li Liang left the shop, went to the phone booth, looked around for a while, then stepped in and closed the glass door.
他等了十几分钟，电话铃也没有响。
Tā děng le shíjǐfēnzhōng, diànhuàlíng yě méiyǒu xiǎng.
He waited more than ten minutes, but the phone didn't ring.
他表情阴郁地观察着旁边的建筑，久久没有离开。
Tā biǎoqíng yīnyù de guānchá zhe pángbiān de jiànzhù, jiǔjiǔ méiyǒu líkāi.
With a gloomy look he studied the buildings nearby and stayed there for a long time.
书店里的老太太不知道什么时候醒了。
Shūdiàn lǐ de lǎotàitài bù zhīdào shénme shíhòu xǐng le.
At some point the old woman in the shop had woken up.
她走出书店，对着李良招了招手。
Tā zǒuchū shūdiàn, duì zhe Lǐ Liáng zhāo le zhāoshǒu.
She came out and beckoned to Li Liang.
李良回到了书店里，对老太太耳语了几句。
Lǐ Liáng huídào le shūdiàn lǐ, duì lǎotàitài ěryǔ le jǐjù.
He went back into the shop and whispered a few words to her.
老太太露出疑惑的表情，随后拉下了书店的卷帘门。
Lǎotàitài lùchū yíhuò de biǎoqíng, suíhòu lāxià le shūdiàn de juànliánmén.
The old woman looked puzzled, then pulled down the shop's roller shutter.
