tf.why: The route changed, but the first and last stops never did.

q: 11路公交车跑一个来回大约需要两个半小时。
11 lù gōngjiāochē pǎo yígè láihuí dàyuē xūyào liǎnggè bànxiǎoshí.
A round trip on the No. 11 takes about two and a half hours.
tf.why: From People's Square to the hospital and back.

q: 很多司机喜欢开11路，因为乘客很少。
Hěnduō sījī xǐhuān kāi 11 lù, yīnwèi chéngkè hěnshǎo.
Many drivers like the No. 11 because there are few passengers.
tf.why: It's often packed and many drivers ask to transfer.

q: 李良的脸上有一条长长的疤痕。
Lǐ Liáng de liǎnshàng yǒu yìtiáo chángchángde bāhén.
Li Liang has a long scar on his face.
tf.why: That's one reason colleagues are afraid of him.

q: 李良确实坐过牢。
Lǐ Liáng quèshí zuòguò láo.
Li Liang really has been in prison.
tf.why: It's only a rumour; the chapter doesn't confirm it.

q: 李良每年春节都回家过年。
Lǐ Liáng měinián chūnjié dōu huíjiā guònián.
Li Liang goes home for Spring Festival every year.
tf.why: In twenty years he has never had Spring Festival off.

q: 李良有一个很好的朋友是公交公司的同事。
Lǐ Liáng yǒu yígè hěn hǎo de péngyǒu shì gōngjiāogōngsī de tóngshì.
Li Liang has a close friend among his colleagues.
tf.why: He has no close colleague at all.

q: 李良每天中午要休息两个半小时。
Lǐ Liáng měitiān zhōngwǔ yào xiūxī liǎnggè bànxiǎoshí.
Li Liang takes a two-and-a-half-hour break every noon.
tf.why: In exchange for covering holiday shifts.

q: 那个男学生给李良看了一张照片。
Nàge nán xuéshēng gěi Lǐ Liáng kàn le yìzhāng zhàopiān.
The schoolboy showed Li Liang a photo.
tf.why: It was a pencil sketch in a notebook.

q: 李良告诉男孩，他见过那个电话亭。
Lǐ Liáng gàosù nánhái, tā jiàn guò nàge diànhuàtíng.
Li Liang told the boy he had seen the phone booth.
tf.why: He said "No", though he goes there every day.

q: 李良把一袋重东西交给了书店里的一个男人。
Lǐ Liáng bǎ yídài zhòng dōngxī jiāogěi le shūdiàn lǐ de yígè nánrén.
Li Liang handed a heavy bag to a man in the bookshop.
tf.why: The man took it silently to the back of the shop.

q: 李良在电话亭里接到了一个电话。
Lǐ Liáng zài diànhuàtíng lǐ jiēdào le yígè diànhuà.
Li Liang got a phone call in the booth.
tf.why: He waited over ten minutes, but it didn't ring.

q: 袋子里装的是食物。
Dàizi lǐzhuāng de shì shíwù.
The bag contained food.
tf.why: We aren't told what was in the bag.

q: 为什么李良记得那个男孩？
Wèishénme Lǐ Liáng jìde nàge nánhái?
Why did Li Liang remember the boy?
o: Yīnwèi nánhái shì tā de línjū
Because the boy was his neighbour
因为男孩以前在他的车上睡着了，被拉到了停车场
Yīnwèi nánhái yǐqián zài tā de chēshàng shuìzháo le, bèilādào le tíngchēchǎng
Because the boy once fell asleep on his bus and was carried to the car park
因为男孩每天坐他的车
Yīnwèi nánhái měitiān zuò tā de chē
Because the boy rode his bus every day
因为男孩在书店买过书
Yīnwèi nánhái zài shūdiàn mǎiguò shū
Because the boy bought books at the shop
mc.why: A few months earlier the boy slept on the back seat and wasn't noticed.

q: 同事们为什么有点怕李良？
Tóngshì men wèishénme yǒudiǎn pà Lǐ Liáng?
Why are his colleagues a bit afraid of Li Liang?
o: Because he often swears at people
因为他面相凶，脸上有疤，还有人说他坐过牢
Yīnwèi tā miànxiàng xiōng, liǎnshàng yǒubā, háiyǒu rén shuō tā zuò guò láo
Because he looks fierce, has a scar, and people say he's been in prison
mc.why: His fierce face, scar and the prison rumour.

q: 李良中午离开停车场后去了哪里？
Lǐ Liáng zhōngwǔ líkāi tíngchēchǎng hòu qù le nǎlǐ?
Where did Li Liang go after leaving the car park at noon?
o: 去了老街区的二手书店和电话亭
Qù le lǎojiēqū de èrshǒu shūdiàn hé diànhuàtíng
To the second-hand bookshop and the phone booth in the old neighbourhood
mc.why: He went to the bookshop, then into the phone booth.

q: 这一章的男学生可能是谁？你为什么这么想？
Zhè yìzhāng de nán xuéshēng kěnéng shì shuí? Nǐ wèishénme zhème xiǎng?
Who could the schoolboy in this chapter be? Why do you think so?
ans: 可能是江阳，因为他一直在找那个电话亭和博文书店。
Kěnéng shì Jiāng Yáng, yīnwèi tā yìzhí zài zhǎo nàge diànhuàtíng hé Bówén Shūdiàn.
Probably Jiang Yang, because he has been looking for the phone booth and the Bowen Bookshop.

q: 李良为什么对男孩说“没有”？你觉得他在隐瞒什么？
Lǐ Liáng wèishénme duì nánhái shuō "méiyǒu"? Nǐ juéde tā zài yǐnmán shénme?
Why did Li Liang tell the boy "No"? What might he be hiding?
ans: 他不想让别人知道那个地方，可能和电话亭有秘密。
Tā bùxiǎng ràng biérén zhīdào nàge dìfāng, kěnéng hé diànhuàtíng yǒu mìmì.
He doesn't want anyone to know about the place; maybe he is hiding a secret connected with the booth.

q: 李良离开电话亭以后，老太太做了什么？
Lǐ Liáng líkāi diànhuàtíng yǐhòu, lǎotàitài zuò le shénme?
What did the old woman do after Li Liang left the booth?
ans: 她把李良叫回书店，听了他的话，然后拉下了卷帘门。
Tā bǎ Lǐ Liáng jiào huí shūdiàn, tīng le tā dehuà, ránhòu lāxià le juànliánmén.
She called Li Liang back into the shop, listened to him, then pulled down the shutter.

006.title: Chapter 6 · The Lost Memory

blocks.label: 章
lines: 第六章 失去的记忆
Dìliùzhāng shīqù de jìyì
Chapter 6: The Lost Memory
徐志伟是一个公务员，在市文物局工作。
Xú Zhìwěi shì yígè gōngwùyuán, zài shì wénwùjú gōngzuò.
Xu Zhiwei is a civil servant who works at the city's Cultural Heritage Bureau.
除了组织和协调本市范围的考古调查，文物的保护工作，以及博物馆的建设和管理工作以外，
Chúle zǔzhī hé xiétiáo běnshì fànwéi de kǎogǔ diàochá, wénwù de bǎohù gōngzuò, yǐjí bówùguǎn de jiànshè hé guǎnlǐgōngzuò yǐwài,
Besides organising and coordinating archaeological surveys across the city, protecting cultural relics, and building and running museums,
文物局还要负责在旧城区改建之前，先进行不可移动文物的调查，制定保护方案和措施。
Wénwùjú háiyào fùzé zài jiùchéngqū gǎijiàn zhīqián, xiān jìnxíng bùkě yídòng wénwù de diàochá, zhìdìng bǎohù fāng'àn hé cuòshī.
the bureau must also, before an old district is rebuilt, survey its immovable heritage and draw up plans and measures to protect it.
今年，市政府要对一片老区进行开发和重建。
Jīnnián, shìzhèngfǔ yào duì yípiàn lǎoqū jìnxíng kāifā hé chóngjiàn.
This year the city government plans to develop and rebuild an old district.
徐志伟带领了他的团队，去这片老区考察文物状况。
Xú Zhìwěi dàilǐng le tā de tuánduì, qù zhèpiàn lǎoqū kǎochá wénwù zhuàngkuàng.
Xu Zhiwei led his team to inspect the heritage there.
说来也巧，徐志伟小时候就在这个老区居住，在那里的小学上学。
Shuōlái yě qiǎo, Xú Zhìwěi xiǎoshíhòu jiù zài zhège lǎoqū jūzhù, zài nàlǐ de xiǎoxué shàngxué.
As it happens, Xu Zhiwei lived in this district as a child and went to primary school there.
后来，徐志伟考入了市重点中学，他们家就从那里搬走了。
Hòulái, Xú Zhìwěi kǎorù le shì zhòngdiǎnzhōngxué, tāmen jiā jiù cóng nàlǐ bānzǒu le.
Later he got into the city's top secondary school, and his family moved away.
随着城市的发展，这片老区也逐渐被搬迁和改造，旧建筑的面积越来越小。
Suízhe chéngshì de fāzhǎn, zhèpiàn lǎoqū yě zhújiàn bèi bānqiān hé gǎizào, jiù jiànzhù de miànjī yuèláiyuè xiǎo.
As the city grew, the old district was gradually cleared and redeveloped, and less and less of it was left.
徐志伟曾经就读的小学也拆迁了。
Xú Zhìwěi céngjīng jiùdú de xiǎoxué yě chāiqiān le.
His old primary school had been demolished too.
徐志伟和他的同事们走在老区的街道上，童年的回忆涌上心头。
Xú Zhìwěi hé tā de tóngshì men zǒu zài lǎoqū de jiēdào shàng, tóngnián de huíyì yǒng shàng xīntóu.
Walking the streets of the old district with his colleagues, Xu Zhiwei was flooded with childhood memories.
他经常买零食吃的小卖铺已经关门了，但是学校附近的早餐店还在营业。
Tā jīngcháng mǎi língshí chī de xiǎomài pù yǐjīng guānmén le, dànshì xuéxiào fùjìn de zǎocān diàn hái zài yíngyè.
The little shop where he used to buy snacks had closed, but the breakfast place near the school was still open.
学校原来的建筑已经被推平，正在施工中，计划是建一个五层楼的商场。
Xuéxiào yuánlái de jiànzhù yǐjīng bèi tuīpíng, zhèngzài shīgōng zhōng, jìhuà shì jiàn yígè wǔcéng lóu de shāngchǎng.
The old school building had been flattened and work was under way on a five-storey shopping centre.
故地重游，让徐志伟心情复杂，说不上来是喜悦，还是忧伤。
Gùdìzhòngyóu, ràng Xú Zhìwěi xīnqíng fùzá, shuōbúshànglái shì xǐyuè, háishì yōushāng.
Revisiting the place stirred mixed feelings in him; he couldn't say whether he felt happy or sad.
不过这一天的考察工作还是很顺利的。
Búguò zhè yìtiān de kǎochá gōngzuò háishì hěn shùnlì de.
Still, the day's inspection went smoothly.
这个街区虽然很旧，但大多数建筑都是上个世纪八十年代开始建造的，没有特别的文物需要保护。
Zhège jiēqū suīrán hěn jiù, dàn dàduōshù jiànzhù dōu shì shànggèshìjì bāshíniándài kāishǐ jiànzào de, méiyǒu tèbié de wénwù xūyào bǎohù.
The neighbourhood was old, but most of the buildings dated from the 1980s on, with no special heritage needing protection.
这是所有同事们一起得出的结论。
Zhèshì suǒyǒu tóngshì men yìqǐ déchū de jiélùn.
That was the conclusion all the colleagues reached together.
可是，徐志伟总是觉得哪里怪怪的，有些不对劲的感觉。
Kěshì, Xú Zhìwěi zǒngshì juéde nǎlǐ guàiguàide, yǒuxiē búduìjìn de gǎnjué.
But Xu Zhiwei kept feeling that something was odd, that something wasn't right.
是他们忽略了什么文物吗？
Shì tāmen hūlüè le shénme wénwù ma?
Had they overlooked some piece of heritage?
徐志伟的妻子是医生，平时工作也很忙，没时间接送孩子去学校、补习班。
Xú Zhìwěi de qīzǐ shì yīshēng, píngshí gōngzuò yě hěn máng, méi shíjiān jiēsòng háizi qù xuéxiào, bǔxíbān.
Xu Zhiwei's wife is a doctor, very busy too, with no time to take their son to school and extra classes.
徐志伟就请爸妈过来和他们一起住，帮他们接送小孩，还有做饭。
Xú Zhìwěi jiù qǐng bàmā guòlái hé tāmen yìqǐ zhù, bāng tāmen jiēsòng xiǎohái, háiyǒu zuòfàn.
So Xu Zhiwei asked his parents to come and live with them, to take the boy to and fro and to cook.
徐志伟的妻子和公公婆婆相处得很好，没有复杂的婆媳关系，家庭氛围很和睦。
Xú Zhìwěi de qīzǐ hé gōnggōng pópo xiāngchǔ dé hěn hǎo, méiyǒu fùzá de póxíguānxì, jiātíng fēnwéi hěn hémù.
His wife got on well with her in-laws; there was none of the usual mother-in-law trouble, and the family was harmonious.
晚饭时，徐志伟问起爸妈那个老区的事情，
Wǎnfàn shí, Xú Zhìwěi wènqǐ bàmā nàge lǎoqū de shìqíng,
At dinner, Xu Zhiwei asked his parents about the old district,
问他们有没有听说过那里有什么老建筑，清朝的或者民国时期的。
Wèn tāmen yǒuméiyǒu tīngshuō guò nàlǐ yǒu shénme lǎo jiànzhù, qīngcháo de huòzhě mínguóshíqī de.
whether they'd heard of any old buildings there, from the Qing dynasty or the Republic era.
爸妈都表示没有听说过。
Bàmā dōu biǎoshì méiyǒu tīngshuō guò.
Both said they hadn't.
“妈，你说咱们搬走后，怎么从来没回去看看呢？”徐志伟问。
"Mā, nǐ shuō zánmen bānzǒu hòu, zěnme cóngláiméi huíqù kànkàn ne?" Xú Zhìwěi wèn.
"Mum, why have we never gone back to visit since we moved away?" Xu Zhiwei asked.
“回去干啥？又没有什么好的回忆。”
"Huíqù gàn shá? Yòu méiyǒu shénme hǎo de huíyì."
"What for? There aren't any good memories there."
徐志伟的父亲吃完了饭，正坐在沙发上刷手机，看短视频。他随口回答。
Xú Zhìwěi de fùqīn chī wán le fàn, zhèng zuòzài shāfā shàngshuā shǒujī, kànduǎn shìpín. Tā suíkǒu huídá.
It was his father who said it: he had finished eating and was on the sofa scrolling short videos on his phone. He answered without thinking.
“咋了？有啥不好的回忆吗？”徐志伟笑着打趣。
"Zǎ le? Yǒu shá bùhǎo de huíyì ma?" Xú Zhìwěi xiào zhe dǎqù.
"Why, what bad memories?" Xu Zhiwei teased, laughing.
徐志伟的妈妈说：“别听你爸胡说。有什么不好的回忆？都搬家了，回去做什么？”
Xú Zhìwěi de māmā shuō: "bié tīng nǐ bà húshuō. Yǒu shénme bùhǎo de huíyì? Dōu bānjiā le, huíqù zuò shénme?"
His mother said, "Don't listen to your dad's nonsense. What bad memories? We've moved; why go back?"
晚上睡觉前，徐志伟跟妻子说，第二天是星期六，他反正也没事做，他准备再去一次老街区。
Wǎnshàng shuìjiào qián, Xú Zhìwěi gēn qīzǐ shuō, dì'èrtiān shì xīngqīliù, tā fǎnzhèng yě méishì zuò, tā zhǔnbèi zài qù yícì lǎojiēqū.
Before bed, Xu Zhiwei told his wife that tomorrow was Saturday, he had nothing to do anyway, and he planned to go to the old streets again.
根据市政府的规划，那里可能很快就要进行拆迁和重建了。
Gēnjù shìzhèngfǔ de guīhuà, nàlǐ kěnéng hěnkuài jiùyào jìnxíng chāiqiān hé chóngjiàn le.
According to the city's plans, it might soon be demolished and rebuilt.
以后再想去探访他的童年记忆，就没有机会了。
Yǐhòu zài xiǎng qù tànfǎng tā de tóngnián jìyì, jiù méiyǒu jīhuì le.
After that there'd be no chance to revisit his childhood memories.
徐志伟的妻子表示支持，但是她不能陪他一同前去，因为她需要加班，有一个重要的手术要做。
Xú Zhìwěi de qīzǐ biǎoshì zhīchí, dànshì tā bùnéng péi tā yìtóng qiánqù, yīnwèi tā xūyào jiābān, yǒu yígè zhòngyào de shǒushù yào zuò.
His wife was all for it, but couldn't go with him because she had to work: there was an important operation.
她让徐志伟带他们的儿子一起去，就当去散步了。
Tā ràng Xú Zhìwěi dài tāmen de érzi yìqǐ qù, jiù dāngqù sànbù le.
She told him to take their son along, as a nice walk.
第二天早上，徐志伟的妻子早早就出门了。
Dì'èrtiān zǎoshàng, Xú Zhìwěi de qīzǐ zǎozǎo jiù chūmén le.
The next morning his wife left early.
吃早饭时，徐志伟告诉儿子徐阳阳，要带他出去玩。
Chī zǎofàn shí, Xú Zhìwěi gàosù érzi Xú Yángyáng, yào dài tā chūqùwán.
At breakfast, Xu Zhiwei told his son, Xu Yangyang, he was taking him out.
徐阳阳今年十三岁，上小学五年级。
Xú Yángyáng jīnnián shísānsuì, shàng xiǎoxué wǔniánjí.
Xu Yangyang was thirteen, in the fifth year of primary school.
他非常开朗，喜欢冒险。
Tā fēicháng kāilǎng, xǐhuān màoxiǎn.
He was very cheerful and loved adventure.
听爸爸要带他去探索城市的老区，他非常开心。
Tīng bàbà yào dài tā qù tànsuǒ chéngshì de lǎoqū, tā fēicháng kāixīn.
Hearing that his dad would take him to explore the old part of the city, he was delighted.
快速喝完手里的豆浆，回房间收拾他的背包去了。
Kuàisù hēwán shǒulǐ de dòujiāng, huí fángjiān shōushí tā de bēibāo qù le.
He gulped down his soy milk and went to his room to pack his backpack.
几分钟后，父子二人穿戴整齐，准备出发。
Jǐfēnzhōng hòu, fùzǐ èrrén chuāndàizhěngqí, zhǔnbèi chūfā.
A few minutes later father and son were dressed and ready to go.
徐志伟的母亲站在门口送别他们，眼神中透露出了一丝担忧。
Xú Zhìwěi de mǔqīn zhàn zài ménkǒu sòngbié tāmen, yǎnshén zhōng tòulù chū le yìsī dānyōu.
Xu Zhiwei's mother stood at the door to see them off, a hint of worry in her eyes.
她嘱咐儿子说：“今天入伏啦，天气可热，别在外面走太久啊。小心中暑。有事打电话啊。”
Tā zhǔfù érzi shuō: "jīntiān rùfú la, tiānqì kěrè, bié zài wàimiàn zǒu tàijiǔ a. Xiǎoxīn zhòngshǔ. Yǒushì dǎdiànhuà a."
She told her son, "The dog days start today, it'll be really hot. Don't stay out walking too long. Watch out for heatstroke. Call if anything happens."
徐志伟笑着说：“妈，我都三十九岁了，又不是小孩子。别操心了啊，没事的。”
Xú Zhìwěi xiào zhe shuō: "mā, wǒ dōu sānshíjiǔsuì le, yòu búshì xiǎoháizi. Bié cāoxīn le a, méishì de."
Xu Zhiwei laughed. "Mum, I'm thirty-nine, not a child. Don't worry, it'll be fine."
徐志伟开车抵达老区附近的停车场，然后带着儿子步行走到老街区。
Xú Zhìwěi kāichē dǐdá lǎoqū fùjìn de tíngchēchǎng, ránhòu dài zhe érzi bùxíng zǒu dào lǎojiēqū.
Xu Zhiwei drove to a car park near the old district and then walked with his son to the old streets.
他们周五来考察的时候，街道上还挺冷清的，没几个人。
Tāmen zhōuwǔ lái kǎochá de shíhòu, jiēdào shàng hái tǐng lěngqīng de, méi jǐgè rén.
When they'd come to inspect on Friday, the streets had been quiet, with few people.
但是今天人还挺多，大部分都是大学生模样的年轻人，来这个街区拍照打卡的。
Dànshì jīntiān rén hái tǐng duō, dàbùfèn dōu shì dàxuéshēng múyàng de niánqīngrén, lái zhège jiēqū pāizhào dǎkǎ de.
But today there were quite a few, mostly young people who looked like university students, there to take photos and "check in".
城市发展迅速，像这样集中的旧建筑、老铺子已经不多了。
Chéngshì fāzhǎn xùnsù, xiàng zhèyàng jízhōng de jiù jiànzhù, lǎo pùzi yǐjīng bùduō le.
The city had developed so fast that places with so many old buildings and old shops were rare.
有商业头脑的人在这里租下了一个老房子，简单装修一下，就开成了咖啡馆。
Yǒu shāngyè tóunǎo de rén zài zhèlǐ zūxià le yígè lǎofángzi, jiǎndān zhuāngxiū yíxià, jiù kāichéng le kāfēiguǎn.
Someone with a head for business had rented an old house here, done it up a little, and turned it into a café.
里面的桌椅、墙上挂的画、各种装饰，全是上个世纪的风格，吸引了很多年轻人进去喝咖啡、拍照。
Lǐmiàn de zhuōyǐ, qiángshàng guà de huà, gèzhǒng zhuāngshì, quánshì shànggèshìjì de fēnggé, xīyǐn le hěnduō niánqīngrén jìnqù hēkāfēi, pāizhào.
The tables and chairs, the pictures on the walls, all the decorations were in last-century style, drawing lots of young people in to drink coffee and take photos.
有些人还分享照片到小红书上，让这个咖啡馆越来越火。
Yǒuxiē rén hái fēnxiǎng zhàopiān dào xiǎohóng shūshàng, ràng zhège kāfēiguǎn yuèláiyuè huǒ.
Some shared photos on Xiaohongshu, making the café more and more popular.
一个咖啡馆又带火了一条街。
Yígè kāfēiguǎn yòu dài huǒ le yìtiáojiē.
And one café made a whole street popular.
街角的二手书店之前很冷清，现在有很多年轻人在里面翻看二手书。
Jiējiǎo de èrshǒu shūdiàn zhīqián hěn lěngqīng, xiànzài yǒu hěnduō niánqīngrén zài lǐmiàn fānkàn èrshǒushū.
The second-hand bookshop on the corner, once empty, now had lots of young people browsing.
他们觉得很有趣、复古。
Tāmen juéde hěn yǒuqù, fùgǔ.
They found it fun and retro.
甚至书店的老太太也让大家觉得很好玩。
Shènzhì shūdiàn de lǎotàitài yě ràng dàjiā juéde hěn hǎowán.
Even the old woman who ran the shop amused everyone.
她经常在收银台后面睡觉，就算醒了也不招待顾客，不怎么说话。
Tā jīngcháng zài shōuyíntái hòumiàn shuìjiào, jiùsuàn xǐng le yě bù zhāodài gùkè, bùzěnme shuōhuà.
She was often asleep behind the till, and even awake she didn't serve customers or say much.
她的脾气也很古怪。
Tā de píqì yě hěn gǔguài.
She had an odd temper too.
有一次，一个人拿起一本书，问她多少钱，她生气地抢过来说不卖，然后又把书放回了书架。
Yǒu yícì, yígè rénnáqǐ yì běnshū, wèn tā duōshǎoqián, tā shēngqì de qiǎngguòlái shuō bú mài, ránhòu yòu bǎ shūfànghuí le shūjià.
Once, someone picked up a book and asked the price; she angrily snatched it, said it wasn't for sale and put it back on the shelf.
也有一个网友分享说，他女朋友低血糖，有些头晕，这个老太太塞给他一包糖。
Yě yǒu yígè wǎngyǒu fēnxiǎng shuō, tā nǚpéngyǒu dīxuètáng, yǒuxiē tóuyūn, zhège lǎotàitài sāi gěi tā yìbāo táng.
Another person posted online that his girlfriend had low blood sugar and felt dizzy, and the old woman pressed a packet of sweets into his hand.
大多数人都认为，这个老太太很亲切，就像自己那刀子嘴豆腐心的奶奶。
Dàduōshù rén dōu rènwéi, zhège lǎotàitài hěn qīnqiè, jiù xiàng zìjǐ nà dāozizuǐ dòufǔxīn de nǎinǎi.
Most people thought she was sweet, like their own grandmothers: sharp tongue, soft heart.
徐阳阳第一次来到这样的街区。
Xú Yángyáng dìyīcì láidào zhèyàng de jiēqū.
It was Xu Yangyang's first time in a neighbourhood like this.
他从来没见过这么多的旧房子，感觉很酷。
Tā cóngláiméi jiànguò zhème duō de jiù fángzi, gǎnjué hěnkù.
He'd never seen so many old houses; he thought it was cool.
二手书店他更是没有见过，里面发旧的、泛黄的连环画册也很特别。
Èrshǒu shūdiàn tā gèngshì méiyǒu jiànguò, lǐmiàn fājiù de, fànhuáng de liánhuánhuà cè yě hěn tèbié.
He'd never seen a second-hand bookshop either, and the worn, yellowed picture-story books were really special.
他兴奋地对徐志伟说：“爸爸，这个博文书店太有趣了。”
Tā xīngfèn de duì Xú Zhìwěi shuō: "bàbà, zhège Bówén Shūdiàn tài yǒuqù le."
He said excitedly to his father, "Dad, this Bowen Bookshop is so much fun."
徐志伟说：“不是博文书店，是富文书店。招牌上的字有些不清晰了。里面那个奶奶就是富文。”
Xú Zhìwěi shuō: "búshì Bówén Shūdiàn, shì Fùwén Shūdiàn. Zhāopái shàng de zì yǒuxiē bù qīngxī le. Lǐmiàn nàge nǎinǎi jiùshì Fùwén."
Xu Zhiwei said, "It's not the Bowen Bookshop, it's the Fuwen Bookshop. The letters on the sign have faded. That granny in there is Fuwen."
说着，他指了指收银台后面的老太太。
Shuō zhe, tā zhǐ le zhǐ shōuyíntái hòumiàn de lǎotàitài.
As he said it, he pointed at the old woman behind the till.
老太太听到这话，抬头看向徐志伟：“你认识我？”
Lǎotàitài tīngdào zhèhuà, táitóu kàn xiàng Xú Zhìwěi: "nǐ rènshí wǒ?"
Hearing this, she looked up at Xu Zhiwei. "You know me?"
徐志伟笑着说：“奶奶，您耳朵怎么还这么灵啊？我之前在那边的小学上学。您还记得那边有个小学吗？”
Xú Zhìwěi xiào zhe shuō: "nǎinǎi, nín ěrduǒ zěnme hái zhème líng a? Wǒ zhīqián zài nàbiān de xiǎoxué shàngxué. Nín hái jìde nàbiān yǒugè xiǎoxué ma?"
Xu Zhiwei smiled. "Granny, how is your hearing still so sharp? I used to go to the primary school over there. Do you remember there was a school there?"
老太太笑着点点头：“那小学后来搬走了。你什么时候在那里上学的？”
Lǎotàitài xiào zhe diǎndiǎntóu: "nà xiǎoxué hòulái bānzǒu le. Nǐ shénme shíhòu zài nàlǐ shàngxué de?"
She smiled and nodded. "The school moved away later. When were you there?"
徐志伟开心地和老太太聊着。
Xú Zhìwěi kāixīn de hé lǎotàitài liáozhe.
Xu Zhiwei chatted happily with the old woman.
人的记忆力真的很神奇。
Rén de jìyìlì zhēnde hěn shénqí.
Human memory is truly amazing.
在来这里之前，徐志伟其实已经不记得这些细节了，但是来到这里，就毫不费力地全想起来了。
Zài lái zhèlǐ zhīqián, Xú Zhìwěi qíshí yǐjīng bú jìde zhèxiē xìjié le, dànshì láidào zhèlǐ, jiù háobúfèilì de quánxiǎng qǐlái le.
Before coming here he had forgotten these details, but now he was here, it all came back effortlessly.
聊了几句后，他突然发现站在他旁边的儿子不见了。
Liáo le jǐjù hòu, tā tūrán fāxiàn zhàn zài tā pángbiān de érzi bújiàn le.
After a few words he suddenly noticed that his son, who'd been standing beside him, was gone.
他急忙走出书店，站在书店门口四处张望，
Tā jímáng zǒuchū shūdiàn, zhàn zài shūdiàn ménkǒu sìchùzhāngwàng,
He hurried out and looked all around from the doorway,
看见马路对面有一个电话亭，儿子徐阳阳正在里面打电话。
Kànjiàn mǎlù duìmiàn yǒu yígè diànhuàtíng, érzi Xú Yángyáng zhèngzài lǐmiàn dǎdiànhuà.
and saw a phone booth across the road, with his son Xu Yangyang inside, on the phone.
徐志伟的头突然有些疼。
Xú Zhìwěi de tóu tūrán yǒuxiē téng.
Xu Zhiwei's head suddenly began to hurt.
他的脑海中出现了一个男孩的模样：他穿着蓝色的校服，背着书包，也在电话亭里打电话。
Tā de nǎohǎizhōng chūxiàn le yígènánhái de múyàng: tā chuānzhe lánsè de xiàofú, bèizhe shūbāo, yě zài diànhuàtíng lǐ dǎdiànhuà.
The image of a boy appeared in his mind: in a blue school uniform, with a school bag on his back, also on the phone in the booth.
这男孩是谁呢？
Zhè nánhái shì shuí ne?
Who was this boy?
徐志伟感觉到他似乎遗忘了什么，是一段奇妙的记忆。
Xú Zhìwěi gǎnjué dào tā sìhū yíwàng le shénme, shì yíduàn qímiào de jìyì.
Xu Zhiwei felt he had forgotten something: a strange, wonderful memory.
徐阳阳挂了电话，推开电话亭的门，开心地穿过马路，朝着徐志伟跑来。
Xú Yángyáng guà le diànhuà, tuīkāi diànhuàtíng de mén, kāixīn de chuānguò mǎlù, cháozhe Xú Zhìwěi pǎo lái.
Xu Yangyang hung up, pushed open the booth door and ran happily across the road towards his father.
徐志伟的头更痛了。
Xú Zhìwěi de tóu gèng tòng le.
Xu Zhiwei's head hurt even more.
突然间，他听到一声巨响。
Tūrán jiān, tā tīngdào yìshēng jùxiǎng.
Suddenly he heard a huge bang.
徐志伟的耳朵里响起巨大的轰鸣声，他的头仿佛要爆炸。
Xú Zhìwěi de ěrduǒ lǐ xiǎngqǐ jùdà de hōngmíngshēng, tā de tóu fǎngfú yào bàozhà.
A great roar filled his ears, and his head felt as if it would explode.
他眼前一黑，晕倒在书店门口。
Tā yǎnqián yìhēi, yūndǎo zài shūdiàn ménkǒu.
Everything went black, and he collapsed at the bookshop door.

q: 徐志伟在市文物局工作。
Xú Zhìwěi zài shì wénwùjú gōngzuò.
Xu Zhiwei works at the city's Cultural Heritage Bureau.
tf.why: He's a civil servant there.

q: 徐志伟小时候在这个老区上过小学。
Xú Zhìwěi xiǎoshíhòu zài zhège lǎoqū shàng guò xiǎoxué.
Xu Zhiwei went to primary school in this old district.
tf.why: He lived there as a child.

q: 徐志伟以前的小学现在还在上课。
Xú Zhìwěi yǐqián de xiǎoxué xiànzài hái zài shàngkè.
His old primary school still holds classes.
tf.why: It was demolished; a shopping centre is being built.

q: 同事们认为那个街区有很多需要保护的文物。
Tóngshì men rènwéi nàge jiēqū yǒu hěnduō xūyào bǎohù de wénwù.
The colleagues decided the neighbourhood had lots of heritage to protect.
tf.why: They concluded there was nothing special to protect.

q: 徐志伟的妻子是一名老师。
Xú Zhìwěi de qīzǐ shì yìmíng lǎoshī.
Xu Zhiwei's wife is a teacher.
tf.why: She's a doctor.

q: 徐志伟的爸爸说那个老区没有什么好的回忆。
Xú Zhìwěi de bàbà shuō nàge lǎoqū méiyǒu shénme hǎo de huíyì.
Xu Zhiwei's father said there were no good memories in the old district.
tf.why: His mother then told him not to listen to his dad.

q: 星期六徐志伟的妻子也一起去了老街区。
Xīngqīliù Xú Zhìwěi de qīzǐ yě yìqǐ qù le lǎojiēqū.
On Saturday his wife went to the old streets too.
tf.why: She had an important operation at work.

q: 徐阳阳今年十三岁。
Xú Yángyáng jīnnián shísānsuì.
Xu Yangyang is thirteen.
tf.why: And he loves adventure.

q: 老街区的咖啡馆是徐志伟的朋友开的。
Lǎojiēqū de kāfēiguǎn shì Xú Zhìwěi de péngyǒu kāi de.
The café in the old streets is run by a friend of Xu Zhiwei.
tf.why: We only know someone with a business head rented a house and opened it.

q: 书店的老太太对所有顾客都很热情。
Shūdiàn de lǎotàitài duì suǒyǒu gùkè dōu hěn rèqíng.
The old woman in the bookshop is warm to every customer.
tf.why: She often sleeps and doesn't serve customers, though she can be kind.

q: 徐志伟知道书店老太太的名字。
Xú Zhìwěi zhīdào shūdiàn lǎotàitài de míngzì.
Xu Zhiwei knows the bookshop woman's name.
tf.why: He tells his son she is Fuwen.

q: 徐阳阳在电话亭里打电话。
Xú Yángyáng zài diànhuàtíng lǐ dǎdiànhuà.
Xu Yangyang made a call in the phone booth.
tf.why: His father saw him on the phone across the road.

q: 徐志伟晕倒以后被送到了医院。
Xú Zhìwěi yūndǎo yǐhòu bèi sòngdào le yīyuàn.
After fainting, Xu Zhiwei was taken to hospital.
tf.why: The chapter ends with him fainting; it doesn't say what happened next.

q: 徐志伟为什么星期六又去了老街区？
Xú Zhìwěi wèishénme xīngqīliù yòu qù le lǎojiēqū?
Why did Xu Zhiwei go back to the old streets on Saturday?
o: 因为那里很快要拆迁，他想再看看童年的地方
Yīnwèi nàlǐ hěnkuài yào chāiqiān, tā xiǎng zài kànkàn tóngnián de dìfāng
Because it would soon be demolished and he wanted to see his childhood places again
Because he wanted to buy books
Yīnwèi tā māmā ràng tā qù
Because his mother told him to
mc.why: He might not get another chance to revisit his childhood memories.

q: 为什么老街区现在有很多年轻人？
Wèishénme lǎojiēqū xiànzài yǒu hěnduō niánqīngrén?
Why are there now lots of young people in the old streets?
o: 因为一家复古咖啡馆在网上很火
Yīnwèi yìjiā fùgǔ kāfēiguǎn zài wǎngshàng hěnhuǒ
Because a retro café became popular online
mc.why: Photos shared on Xiaohongshu made the café, then the whole street, popular.

q: 书店真正的名字是什么？
Shūdiàn zhēnzhèng de míngzì shì shénme?
What is the bookshop's real name?
mc.why: The sign has faded; Xu Zhiwei says it's Fuwen, the owner's name.

q: 看见儿子在电话亭里，徐志伟想起了什么？
Kànjiàn érzi zài diànhuàtíng lǐ, Xú Zhìwěi xiǎngqǐ le shénme?
Seeing his son in the booth, what did Xu Zhiwei remember?
o: 一个穿蓝色校服、背着书包在电话亭里打电话的男孩
Yígè chuān lánsè xiàofú, bèizhe shūbāo zài diànhuàtíng lǐ dǎdiànhuà de nánhái
A boy in a blue uniform with a school bag, on the phone in the booth
mc.why: A forgotten memory of a boy in the booth.

q: 徐志伟的妈妈出门前为什么担心？她说了什么？
Xú Zhìwěi de māmā chū ménqián wèishénme dānxīn? Tā shuō le shénme?
Why was Xu Zhiwei's mother worried before they left, and what did she say?
ans: 她担心天气太热，让儿子别在外面走太久，小心中暑，有事打电话。
Tā dānxīn tiānqì tàirè, ràng érzi bié zài wàimiàn zǒu tàijiǔ, xiǎoxīn zhòngshǔ, yǒushì dǎdiànhuà.
She worried about the heat: don't walk around too long, watch out for heatstroke, call if anything happens.

q: 大家为什么觉得书店的老太太有意思？
Dàjiā wèishénme juéde shūdiàn de lǎotàitài yǒuyìsi?
Why do people find the old woman in the bookshop interesting?
ans: 她脾气古怪，常常睡觉，有时不卖书，但也会关心别人，比如给低血糖的人糖。
Tā píqì gǔguài, chángcháng shuìjiào, yǒushí bú màishū, dàn yě huì guānxīn biérén, bǐrú gěi dīxuètáng de rén táng.
She's odd: she sleeps, sometimes refuses to sell books, but can be kind, like giving sweets to someone with low blood sugar.

q: 你觉得徐志伟“失去的记忆”可能和什么有关？
Nǐ juéde Xú Zhìwěi "shīqù de jìyì" kěnéng hé shénme yǒuguān?
What might Xu Zhiwei's "lost memory" be connected with?
ans: 可能和那个电话亭有关，他小时候可能也在那里接过神秘的电话。
Kěnéng hé nàge diànhuàtíng yǒuguān, tā xiǎoshíhòu kěnéng yě zài nàlǐ jiēguò shénmì de diànhuà.
Probably the phone booth: as a child he may also have taken a mysterious call there.

007.title: Chapter 7 · Two Lines That Cross

blocks.label: 章
lines: 第七章 交叉的两条线
Dìqīzhāng jiāochā de liǎngtiáoxiàn
Chapter 7: Two Lines That Cross
徐志伟做了一个长长的梦，梦到了很多人。
Xú Zhìwěi zuò le yígè chángchángde mèng, mèngdào le hěnduō rén.
Xu Zhiwei had a long dream and dreamt of many people.
一个大眼睛的男孩出现得最多。
Yígè dà yǎnjīng de nánhái chūxiàn dé zuì duō.
A big-eyed boy appeared most often.
他总是快乐地和徐志伟走在一起，两个人好像有说不完的话题。
Tā zǒngshì kuàilè de hé Xú Zhìwěi zǒu zài yìqǐ, liǎnggè rén hǎoxiàng yǒu shuōbùwán de huàtí.
He was always walking happily with Xu Zhiwei; they seemed to have endless things to talk about.
“志伟，我们考进了同一个中学，太棒了！我们要做一辈子的好朋友。”
"Zhìwěi, wǒmen kǎojìn le tóngyígè zhōngxué, tàibàngle! Wǒmen yào zuò yíbèizi de hǎo péngyǒu."
"Zhiwei, we got into the same secondary school, brilliant! We'll be best friends for life."
“志伟，最新一集的《名侦探柯南》你看了吗？真是太精彩了。”
"Zhìwěi, zuì xīnyìjí de" míng zhēntàn kēnán "nǐ kàn le ma? Zhēnshì tàijīngcǎi le."
"Zhiwei, did you see the latest Detective Conan? It was amazing."

Yèshēn le, Lǐ Liáng xiānsòng Fùwén huíjiā.
It was late; Li Liang first saw Fuwen home.
富文就住在书店的后院。
Fùwén jiù zhù zài shūdiàn de hòuyuàn.
Fuwen lived in the yard behind the bookshop.
书店收银台的后面有一扇不起眼的门，打开那扇门，就进到院子里了。
Shūdiàn shōuyíntái de hòumiàn yǒu yíshàn bùqǐyǎn de mén, dǎkāi nà shànmén, jiù jìndào yuànzi lǐ le.
Behind the till there was an inconspicuous door; open it, and you were in the yard.
院子里有三间平房，富文和她儿子住其中两间，还有一间是杂物室。
Yuànzi lǐ yǒu sānjiān píngfáng, Fùwén hé tā érzi zhù qízhōng liǎngjiān, háiyǒu yìjiān shì záwù shì.
In the yard were three single-storey rooms: Fuwen and her son lived in two, and the third was a storeroom.
除了从书店走进院子，院子里还有一个大门。
Chúle cóng shūdiàn zǒujìn yuànzi, yuànzi lǐ háiyǒu yígè dàmén.
Besides the way in through the shop, the yard had its own gate.
那门的旁边是一个楼梯，从楼梯上二楼，是刘大鹏的家。
Nàmén de pángbiān shì yígè lóutī, cóng lóutī shàng èrlóu, shì Liú Dàpéng de jiā.
Next to the gate was a staircase; up the stairs on the first floor was Liu Dapeng's home.
到家后，富文给李良倒了一杯水，关心地问：“吃饭了吗？”
Dàojiāhòu, Fùwén gěi Lǐ Liáng dào le yìbēi shuǐ, guānxīn dìwèn: "chīfàn le ma?"
At home, Fuwen poured Li Liang a glass of water and asked kindly, "Have you eaten?"
李良点点头，喝了一口水。
Lǐ Liáng diǎndiǎntóu, hē le yìkǒu shuǐ.
Li Liang nodded and took a sip.
富文抓住他的手，盯着他的眼睛，又说：
Fùwén zhuāzhù tā de shǒu, dīng zhe tā de yǎnjīng, yòu shuō:
Fuwen took his hand, looked him in the eye and said:
“二十多年了，小李啊，二十多年了。你应该放下了。都从少年熬到中年了。就算有罪，也都赎完了。
"Èrshíduōnián le, xiǎo lǐ a, èrshíduōnián le. Nǐ yīnggāi fàngxià le. Dōu cóng shàonián áo dào zhōngnián le. Jiùsuàn yǒuzuì, yě dōu shú wán le.
"More than twenty years, Xiao Li. More than twenty years. You should let it go. You've gone from a boy to a middle-aged man. Even if you were guilty, you've paid for it.
以后不要再来了。你得过你自己的人生啊。都四十了，不找女朋友吗？不结婚吗？”
Yǐhòu búyào zàilái le. Nǐ dé guò nǐ zìjǐ de rénshēng a. Dōu sìshí le, bù zhǎo nǚpéngyǒu ma? Bù jiéhūn ma? "
Don't come any more. You have to live your own life. You're forty. Don't you want a girlfriend? Don't you want to marry?"
李良小声说：“谁能看上我啊？”说着，摸了摸脸上的疤痕。
Lǐ Liáng xiǎoshēng shuō: "shuí néng kàn shàng wǒ a?" shuō zhe, mōlemō liǎnshàng de bāhén.
Li Liang said quietly, "Who would want me?" and touched the scar on his face.
“怎么了？我就觉得你很帅气呀。个子高，身体壮，人又善良。男人有点疤痕，算得了什么？”
"Zěnme le? Wǒ jiù juéde nǐ hěn shuàiqì ya. Gèzi gāo, shēntǐ zhuàng, rén yòu shànliáng. Nánrén yǒudiǎn bāhén, suàndéle shénme?"
"What do you mean? I think you're handsome. Tall, strong, and kind. What's a little scar on a man?"
李良似乎有点不好意思，连忙转移话题：“那电话亭的事儿呢？”
Lǐ Liáng sìhū yǒudiǎn bùhǎoyìsī, liánmáng zhuǎnyí huàtí: "nà diànhuàtíng de shì'ér ne?"
Li Liang seemed embarrassed and quickly changed the subject. "And the phone booth business?"
富文轻轻捶了一下腰，说话的语气带着疲惫：
Fùwén qīngqīng chuí le yíxià yāo, shuōhuà de yǔqì dài zhe píbèi:
Fuwen gently thumped her lower back and spoke wearily:
“有些事情，注定解决不了。谁的人生没留下点遗憾？顺其自然吧。”
"Yǒuxiē shìqíng, zhùdìng jiějuébùliǎo. Shuí de rénshēng méi liúxià diǎn yíhàn? Shùnqízìrán ba."
"Some things are fated never to be solved. Whose life doesn't leave some regrets? Let it take its course."
李良站了起来，看富文累了，让她赶紧躺下休息。
Lǐ Liáng zhàn le qǐlái, kàn Fùwén lèi le, ràng tā gǎnjǐn tǎng xià xiūxī.
Li Liang stood up; seeing Fuwen was tired, he told her to lie down and rest.
他从院子的大门走出来，又绕到书店的门口，来到电话亭前，站在那里抽了一颗烟。
Tā cóng yuànzi de dàmén zǒu chūlái, yòu rào dào shūdiàn de ménkǒu, láidào diànhuàtíng qián, zhàn zài nàlǐ chōu le yìkē yān.
He went out through the yard gate, round to the front of the bookshop, to the phone booth, and stood there smoking a cigarette.
边抽边看着刘大鹏家的窗子，又看看眼前这条马路。
Biān chōubiān kànzhe Liú Dàpéng jiā de chuāngzi, yòu kànkàn yǎnqián zhè tiáo mǎlù.
As he smoked he looked at Liu Dapeng's window, then at the road in front of him.
一切还是二十五年前的模样。
Yīqiè háishì èrshíwǔnián qián de múyàng.
Everything looked just as it had twenty-five years ago.
他的心里堵堵的，仿佛二十五年前的石头还压在他心上。
Tā de xīnlǐ dǔdǔ de, fǎngfú èrshíwǔnián qián de shítou háiyā zài tā xīnshàng.
His heart felt heavy, as if the stone from twenty-five years ago still lay on it.
二十五年前，他十六岁。
Èrshíwǔnián qián, tā shíliùsuì.
Twenty-five years ago he was sixteen.
一天下午，他逃学了，偷骑着哥哥的摩托车在马路上飙车。
Yītiān xiàwǔ, tā táoxué le, tōuqí zhe gēgē de mótuōchē zài mǎlùshàng biāochē.
One afternoon he skipped school and raced along the roads on his brother's motorbike, which he'd taken without asking.
路过这个街区时，正好碰上小学放学。
Lùguò zhège jiēqū shí, zhènghǎo pèngshàng xiǎoxué fàngxué.
As he passed this neighbourhood, the primary school was just letting out.
他已经减速了，还没等速度慢下来，对面的小轿车撞飞了一个学生，落在他前面的马路上。
Tā yǐjīng jiǎnsù le, hái méi děng sùdùmàn xiàlái, duìmiàn de xiǎojiàochē zhuàng fēi le yígè xuéshēng, luò zài tā qiánmiàn de mǎlùshàng.
He had already braked, but before he could slow down, a car coming the other way sent a pupil flying, and he landed on the road in front of him.
他来不及避让，车轮从学生的头上碾压了过去。
Tā láibùjí bìràng, chēlún cóng xuéshēng de tóushàng niǎnyā le guòqù.
He had no time to swerve, and his wheel ran over the boy's head.
随后，他的摩托车也失控了，冲向了路边商铺的窗户。
Suíhòu, tā de mótuōchē yě shīkòng le, chōngxiàng le lùbiān shāngpù de chuānghù.
Then his motorbike went out of control and crashed into a shop window by the road.
玻璃窗的碎片割伤了他的脸。
Bōlíchuāng de suìpiàn gēshāng le tā de liǎn.
Broken glass cut his face.
他的脸上缝了三针，肋骨断了两根，在医院躺了半个月。
Tā de liǎnshàng fèng le sānzhēn, lèigǔ duàn le liǎnggēn, zài yīyuàn tǎng le bàngè yuè.
He needed three stitches in his face, broke two ribs and spent half a month in hospital.
由于他还未成年，再加上不是车祸的主要责任人，他没有受到法律的惩罚。
Yóuyú tā hái wèichéngnián, zài jiāshàng búshì chēhuò de zhǔyào zérènrén, tā méiyǒu shòudào fǎlǜ de chéngfá.
Because he was under age, and not mainly to blame for the accident, the law didn't punish him.
他的自责感像一块大石头压在心上。
Tā de zìzé gǎnxiàng yíkuài dàshítou yāzài xīnshàng.
But his guilt lay on his heart like a great stone.
二十五年来，他只要一闭上眼，就能看到车轮从头上碾压过去的画面，能听到死亡学生的父亲撕心裂肺的哭声。
Èrshíwǔnián lái, tā zhǐyào yí bìshàngyǎn, jiù néng kàndào chēlún cóng tóushàng niǎnyā guòqù de huàmiàn, néng tīngdào sǐwáng xuéshēng de fùqīn sīxīnlièfèi de kūshēng.
For twenty-five years, whenever he closed his eyes he saw the wheel going over that head and heard the dead boy's father's heart-rending cries.
事故过去一年后，他阴郁的心情仍然无法得到缓解。
Shìgù guòqù yìnián hòu, tā yīnyù de xīnqíng réngrán wúfǎ dédào huǎnjiě.
A year after the accident, his dark mood still hadn't lifted.
他偷偷跑到刘大鹏家楼下观察，
Tā tōutōu pǎo dào Liú Dàpéng jiā lóuxià guānchá,
He secretly went to watch from below Liu Dapeng's home,
想着，如果死者的父母可以恢复正常的生活，那他的罪责感是不是也会减轻一点。
Xiǎngzhe, rúguǒ sǐzhě de fùmǔ kěyǐ huīfùzhèngcháng de shēnghuó, nà tā de zuìzé gǎn shìbúshì yě huì jiǎnqīng yìdiǎn.
thinking that if the dead boy's parents could get back to a normal life, maybe his guilt would ease a little.
然而，他发现，刘大鹏的妻子已经跳楼死了，刘大鹏也有些精神失常了。
Rán'ér, tā fāxiàn, Liú Dàpéng de qīzǐ yǐjīng tiàolóu sǐ le, Liú Dàpéng yě yǒuxiē jīngshénshīcháng le.
But he found that Liu Dapeng's wife had already jumped to her death, and Liu Dapeng had lost his mind.
看着富文奶奶扶着刘大鹏上楼，他不知不觉地走上前去帮忙。
Kànzhe Fùwén nǎinǎi fú zhe Liú Dàpéng shànglóu, tā bùzhībùjué de zǒushàng qiánqù bāngmáng.
Seeing Granny Fuwen helping Liu Dapeng up the stairs, he found himself going over to help.
就这样，一帮就是二十多年。
Jiù zhèyàng, yìbāng jiùshì èrshíduōnián.
And so he has been helping for more than twenty years.
这就好像是他的解药，并且已经产生了依赖性。
Zhè jiù hǎoxiàng shì tā de jiěyào, bìngqiě yǐjīng chǎnshēng le yīlàixìng.
It is like his medicine, and he has come to depend on it.
如果不去，就觉得心慌。
Rúguǒ búqù, jiù juéde xīnhuāng.
If he doesn't go, he feels panicky.
富文从李良的行为举止中已经猜到了缘由，但她没有和他谈过这件事。
Fùwén cóng Lǐ Liáng de xíngwéi jǔzhǐ zhōng yǐjīng cāidào le yuányóu, dàn tā méiyǒu hé tā tánguò zhèjiàn shì.
From the way Li Liang behaved, Fuwen had guessed why, but she had never talked to him about it.
她以为李良坚持个一两年后，就会离开了，没想到他坚持了这么多年。
Tā yǐwéi Lǐ Liáng jiānchí gè yìliǎngnián hòu, jiù huì líkāi le, méixiǎngdào tā jiānchí le zhème duōnián.
She thought he'd keep it up for a year or two and then leave; she never expected him to keep going for so many years.
富文躺在床上，太累了。
Fùwén tǎng zài chuángshàng, tàilèi le.
Fuwen lay in bed, exhausted.
她已经八十岁了，还能活几年呢？
Tā yǐjīng bāshísuì le, hái nénghuó jǐnián ne?
She was eighty already. How many more years did she have?
她不怕死，但是想到刘大鹏，一阵无力感就涌上心头。
Tā búpàsǐ, dànshì xiǎngdào Liú Dàpéng, yízhèn wúlìgǎn jiù yǒng shàng xīntóu.
She wasn't afraid to die, but when she thought of Liu Dapeng, a wave of helplessness came over her.
“小刘啊小刘，咱们俩谁会死在前头呢？”
"Xiǎo liú a xiǎo liú, zánmen liǎ shuí huì sǐ zài qiántou ne?"
"Oh, Xiao Liu, Xiao Liu, which of us will die first?"

Zhè yìzhāng de tímù "jiāochā de liǎngtiáoxiàn" shì shénme yìsi?
What does the chapter title "Two Lines That Cross" mean?
ans: 徐志伟和李良本来不认识，但他们的人生都和二十五年前那个死去的男孩有关，在这里交叉了。
Xú Zhìwěi hé Lǐ Liáng běnlái bú rènshí, dàn tāmen de rénshēng dōu hé èrshíwǔnián qián nàge sǐqù de nánhái yǒuguān, zài zhèlǐ jiāochā le.
Xu Zhiwei and Li Liang didn't know each other, but both their lives are tied to the boy who died 25 years ago, and here they cross.

q: 富文劝李良什么？
Fùwén quàn Lǐ Liáng shénme?
What does Fuwen urge Li Liang to do?
ans: 她劝他放下过去，不要再来了，过自己的人生，找女朋友结婚。
Tā quàn tā fàngxià guòqù, búyào zàilái le, guò zìjǐ de rénshēng, zhǎo nǚpéngyǒu jiéhūn.
She urges him to let go of the past, stop coming, live his own life, find a girlfriend and marry.

008.title: Chapter 8 · Clues

blocks.label: 章
lines: 第八章 蛛丝马迹
Dìbāzhāng zhūsīmǎjì
Chapter 8: Clues
徐志伟出院回了家。
Xú Zhìwěi chūyuàn huí le jiā.
Xu Zhiwei left hospital and went home.
刚一进门，徐志伟的爸妈和儿子就围了过来，关心地看着他。
Gāngyí jìnmén, Xú Zhìwěi de bàmā hé érzi jiùwéi le guòlái, guānxīn de kànzhe tā.
The moment he came in, his parents and son gathered round and looked at him with concern.
“爸爸，爸爸，你好点了吗？”
"Bàbà, bàbà, nǐhǎo diǎn le ma?"
"Dad, Dad, are you feeling better?"
徐志伟抱起儿子，抚摸着他的头，说：
Xú Zhìwěi bào qǐ érzi, fǔmō zhe tā de tóu, shuō:
Xu Zhiwei picked up his son, stroked his head and said:
“爸爸没事了。听说你跟着救护车一起送爸爸去医院，还给妈妈打了电话。很勇敢，是个男子汉了。”
"Bàbà méishì le. Tīngshuō nǐ gēnzhe jiùhùchē yìqǐ sòng bàbà qù yīyuàn, huángěi māmā dǎ le diànhuà. Hěn yǒnggǎn, shì gè nánzihàn le."
"Dad's fine now. I hear you went in the ambulance with me to the hospital and phoned Mum. Very brave. You're a real man now."
“当然，我都是个大老爷们了。”阳阳得意地说，逗得全家人都笑了。
"Dāngrán, wǒ dōu shì gè dàlǎoyémen le." Yángyáng déyì dìshuō, dòudé quánjiārén dōu xiào le.
"Of course, I'm a grown man," Yangyang said proudly, making everyone laugh.
徐志伟的妈妈虽然也笑了，还是担心地看着儿子，仔细地询问：
Xú Zhìwěi de māmā suīrán yě xiào le, háishì dānxīn de kànzhe érzi, zǐxì de xúnwèn:
Xu Zhiwei's mother laughed too, but still looked at her son anxiously and questioned him closely:
“好好的，怎么晕倒了呢？医生怎么说？你上学时候的老毛病犯了吗？头疼吗？”
"Hǎohǎo de, zěnme yūndǎo le ne? Yīshēng zěnme shuō? Nǐ shàngxué shíhòu de lǎomáobìng fàn le ma? Tóuténg ma?"
"You were fine, how did you faint? What did the doctor say? Has your old trouble from school come back? Does your head hurt?"
“妈，我没事儿，放心吧。可能就是中暑。但是妈，我上学时有头疼的问题吗？我怎么一点都不记得了？”
"Mā, wǒ méishì'ér, fàngxīn ba. Kěnéng jiùshì zhòngshǔ. Dànshì mā, wǒ shàngxuéshí yǒu tóuténg de wèntí ma? Wǒ zěnme yìdiǎn dōu bú jìde le?"
"Mum, I'm fine, don't worry. Probably just heatstroke. But Mum, did I have headaches at school? I don't remember that at all."
“谁还没有过头疼脑热？没事儿就好。我给你们俩热饭去啊。”
"Shuí hái méiyǒu guò tóuténgnǎorè? Méishì'ér jiù hǎo. Wǒ gěi nǐmen liǎ rèfàn qù a."
"Who hasn't had the odd headache or fever? As long as you're all right. I'll go and heat up some food for you two."
说完，徐志伟的妈妈就连忙钻进了厨房。
Shuōwán, Xú Zhìwěi de māmā jiù liánmáng zuānjìn le chúfáng.
With that, his mother hurried into the kitchen.
徐志伟看着爸妈忙碌的背影，想起梦里他们两个说过的话。
Xú Zhìwěi kànzhe bàmā mánglù de bèiyǐng, xiǎngqǐ mènglǐ tāmen liǎnggè shuō guò dehuà.
Watching his parents bustle about, Xu Zhiwei remembered what they'd said in his dream.
他们让自己忘了某个人，忘了那段经历。
Tāmen ràng zìjǐ wàng le mǒugè rén, wàng le nàduàn jīnglì.
They'd told him to forget someone, to forget what had happened.
那场景不像是梦境，就好像是真实发生过的。
Nà chǎngjǐng bú xiàngshì mèngjìng, jiù hǎoxiàng shì zhēnshí fāshēng guò de.
That scene didn't feel like a dream; it felt as if it had really happened.
现在回想，每次一提到小学的事，他们就讳莫如深。
Xiànzài huíxiǎng, měicì yì tídào xiǎoxué de shì, tāmen jiù huìmòrúshēn.
Thinking back, whenever primary school came up, they always kept quiet about it.
晚上睡觉前，徐志伟又试探了一下父母。
Wǎnshàng shuìjiào qián, Xú Zhìwěi yòu shìtàn le yíxià fùmǔ.
Before bed, Xu Zhiwei sounded out his parents again.
“妈，我今天见到富文奶奶了，就是小学附近那个书店的老板，你们还记得吗？”
"Mā, wǒ jīntiān jiàndào Fùwén nǎinǎi le, jiùshì xiǎoxué fùjìn nàge shūdiàn de lǎobǎn, nǐmen hái jìde ma?"
"Mum, today I saw Granny Fuwen, the owner of the bookshop near my primary school. Do you remember her?"
徐志伟的妈妈有些不自然地回答：“啊，记不清了。怎么了？”
Xú Zhìwěi de māmā yǒuxiē bú zìrán de huídá: "a, jìbùqīng le. Zěnme le?"
His mother answered a little awkwardly, "Oh, I don't really remember. Why?"
“没什么，就是觉得挺有意思的。我本来都不记得这个人了，今天走进书店，一下子就想起来了。”
"Méishénme, jiùshì juéde tǐng yǒuyìsi de. Wǒ běnlái dōu bú jìde zhège rén le, jīntiān zǒujìn shūdiàn, yíxiàzi jiù xiǎng qǐlái le."
"Nothing, I just thought it was funny. I'd completely forgotten her, but when I walked into the shop today it all came back."
徐志伟的妈妈咽了一下口水，盯着徐志伟：“还想起来什么了？”
Xú Zhìwěi de māmā yàn le yíxià kǒushuǐ, dīng zhe Xú Zhìwěi: "hái xiǎng qǐlái shénme le?"
His mother swallowed and stared at him. "What else did you remember?"
“别的想不起来了。咱家还能找到我小学毕业照吗？”
"Biéde xiǎngbùqǐlái le. Zájiā hái néng zhǎodào wǒ xiǎoxué bìyè zhào ma?"
"Nothing else. Do we still have my primary school graduation photo?"
“你们没拍毕业照。你可能都忘了，你们小学班主任家里出事了，她孩子溺水死了。
"Nǐmen méipāi bìyè zhào. Nǐ kěnéng dōu wàng le, nǐmen xiǎoxué bānzhǔrèn jiālǐ chūshì le, tā háizi nìshuǐ sǐ le.
"You didn't have one taken. You've probably forgotten: something happened in your class teacher's family. Her child drowned.
她在你们毕业前都没回学校上班。也不知道她后来怎么样了。”
Tā zài nǐmen bìyè qián dōu méihuí xuéxiào shàngbān. Yě bù zhīdào tā hòulái zěnmeyàng le. "
She didn't come back to work before you finished school. I don't know what became of her."
母子俩聊完天后，各怀心思地回了房间。
Mǔziliǎ liáo wántiān hòu, gèhuái xīnsī dìhuí le fángjiān.
After talking, mother and son went to their rooms, each with their own thoughts.
徐志伟的父亲安慰自己的妻子说：
Xú Zhìwěi de fùqīn ānwèi zìjǐ de qīzǐ shuō:
Xu Zhiwei's father comforted his wife:
“不要担心了。他现在都这么大了，就算想起来，也不会像小时候那样承受不住了。”
"Búyào dānxīn le. Tā xiànzài dōu zhème dà le, jiùsuàn xiǎng qǐlái, yě búhuì xiàng xiǎoshíhòu nàyàng chéngshòubúzhù le."
"Stop worrying. He's grown up now. Even if he remembers, he won't fall apart like he did as a child."
徐志伟躺在床上，想着刚才母亲紧张的表情。
Xú Zhìwěi tǎng zài chuángshàng, xiǎngzhe gāngcái mǔqīn jǐnzhāng de biǎoqíng.
Lying in bed, Xu Zhiwei thought about his mother's nervous face.
他更加确定，他们有事瞒着自己。
Tā gèngjiā quèdìng, tāmen yǒushì mán zhe zìjǐ.
He was more certain than ever that they were hiding something from him.
徐志伟决定去揭开这个秘密，去找回自己丢失的记忆。
Xú Zhìwěi juédìng qù jiēkāi zhège mìmì, qù zhǎohuí zìjǐ diūshī de jìyì.
He decided to uncover the secret and find his lost memory.
徐志伟想到的第一个办法，是找到小学同学或者老师问一下。
Xú Zhìwěi xiǎngdào de dìyígè bànfǎ, shì zhǎodào xiǎoxuétóngxué huòzhě lǎoshī wèn yíxià.
His first idea was to find primary school classmates or teachers and ask them.
然而，他发现他自从小学毕业后就没有和同学们联系了，现在连他们叫什么名字都不记得。
Rán'ér, tā fāxiàn tā zìcóng xiǎoxué bìyè hòu jiù méiyǒu hé tóngxuémen liánxì le, xiànzài lián tāmen jiào shénme míngzì dōu bú jìde.
But he realised he hadn't been in touch with any classmates since primary school and couldn't even remember their names.
他现在只记得他小学的班主任老师叫王梅。
Tā xiànzài zhǐ jìde tā xiǎoxué de bānzhǔrèn lǎoshī jiào Wáng Méi.
All he remembered was that his primary school class teacher was called Wang Mei.
不过，他并不记得王梅家里出了那么大的变故。
Búguò, tā bìng bú jìde Wáng Méi jiālǐ chū le nàme dà de biàngù.
But he didn't remember that such a terrible thing had happened in her family.
她现在过得还好吗？
Tā xiànzài guòdé háihǎo ma?
Was she doing all right now?
徐志伟打开手机浏览器，输入“王梅老师”，但是出来很多条结果。
Xú Zhìwěi dǎkāi shǒujī liúlǎnqì, shūrù "Wáng Méi lǎoshī", dànshì chūlái hěnduō tiáo jiéguǒ.
Xu Zhiwei opened the browser on his phone and typed "Teacher Wang Mei", but got lots of results.
叫王梅的人太多了。
Jiào Wáng Méi de réntàiduō le.
There were too many people called Wang Mei.
他又找到小学学校的网站，在网站的搜索框里输入“王梅”。
Tā yòu zhǎodào xiǎoxué xuéxiào de wǎngzhàn, zài wǎngzhàn de sōusuǒ kuānglǐ shūrù "Wáng Méi".
Then he found his primary school's website and typed "Wang Mei" into the search box.
虽然找到了一个叫王梅的老师，但这位老师只有三十多岁，显然不是他之前的老师。
Suīrán zhǎodào le yígè jiào Wáng Méi de lǎoshī, dàn zhèwèi lǎoshī zhǐyǒu sānshíduōsuì, xiǎnrán búshì tā zhīqián de lǎoshī.
He found a teacher called Wang Mei, but she was only in her thirties, clearly not his old teacher.
看来，他的王梅老师已经离开了这所学校。
Kànlái, tā de Wáng Méi lǎoshī yǐjīng líkāi le zhè suǒ xuéxiào.
It seemed his Teacher Wang Mei had left the school.
星期二，徐志伟去市政府开会，和其他部门的同事一起讨论老区的规划。
Xīngqī'èr, Xú Zhìwěi qù shìzhèngfǔ kāihuì, hé qítā bùmén de tóngshì yìqǐ tǎolùn lǎoqū de guīhuà.
On Tuesday Xu Zhiwei went to a meeting at city hall to discuss plans for the old district with colleagues from other departments.
他作为文物局的代表，发表了他的专业报告。
Tā zuòwéi wénwùjú de dàibiǎo, fābiǎo le tā de zhuānyè bàogào.
As the Heritage Bureau's representative, he presented his expert report.
报告里显示，这片街区的建筑都是上个世纪八十年代和九十年代的，没有不可移动文物需要保护。
Bàogào lǐ xiǎnshì, zhèpiàn jiēqū de jiànzhù dōu shì shànggèshìjì bāshíniándài hé jiǔshíniándài de, méiyǒu bùkě yídòng wénwù xūyào bǎohù.
It showed that the buildings in the area were all from the 1980s and 1990s, with no immovable heritage needing protection.
这个报告本来让徐志伟手下的同事来做就行。
Zhège bàogào běnlái ràng Xú Zhìwěi shǒuxià de tóngshì lái zuò jiù xíng.
Someone in his team could easily have presented it.
徐志伟亲自跑来开会，是想要多了解一下那个街区的信息。
Xú Zhìwěi qīnzì pǎo lái kāihuì, shì xiǎngyào duō liǎojiě yíxià nàge jiēqū de xìnxī.
Xu Zhiwei came in person because he wanted to learn more about the neighbourhood.
负责街区民情调查的部门也作了报告。
Fùzé jiēqū mínqíng diàochá de bùmén yě zuò le bàogào.
The department responsible for surveying residents also gave a report.
徐志伟了解到以下信息。
Xú Zhìwěi liǎojiě dào yǐxià xìnxī.
Xu Zhiwei learned the following.
第一，徐志伟就读的小学是三年前搬迁的。
Dìyī, Xú Zhìwěi jiùdú de xiǎoxué shì sānnián qián bānqiān de.
First, his old primary school had moved three years earlier.
搬迁前，该区域的房屋居住率有百分之五十。
Bānqiān qián, gāi qūyù de fángwū jūzhù lǜyǒu bǎifēnzhīwǔshí.
Before that, fifty per cent of the houses in the area were occupied.
小学搬迁后，房屋居住率开始快速下降，目前有百分之二十七左右的居住率。
Xiǎoxué bānqiān hòu, fángwū jūzhù lǜ kāishǐ kuàisù xiàjiàng, mùqián yǒu bǎifēnzhī'èrshí qī zuǒyòu de jūzhù lǜ.
After the school moved, occupancy fell fast; now it is about twenty-seven per cent.
居住率连年下降的最重要理由是设施老化，
Jūzhù lǜ liánnián xiàjiàng de zuì zhòngyào lǐyóu shì shèshī lǎohuà,
The main reason for the yearly fall is ageing facilities:
导致房屋外墙墙体脱落、供电不稳定、下水道散发异味等。
Dǎozhì fángwū wàiqiáng qiángtǐ tuōluò, gōngdiàn bù wěndìng, xiàshuǐdào sànfà yìwèi děng.
outer walls crumbling, an unreliable power supply, drains that smell, and so on.
之前有家庭为了孩子上学方便，还坚持在那边居住，学校搬迁加速了居民的迁出速度。
Zhīqián yǒu jiātíng wèile háizi shàngxué fāngbiàn, hái jiānchí zài nàbiān jūzhù, xuéxiào bānqiān jiāsù le jūmín de qiānchū sùdù.
Some families had stayed for their children's convenience in getting to school; the school's move sped up people leaving.
由此可知，从居住率上来看，如果对整片区域进行拆迁和重建，迁移居民的压力并不大。
Yóucǐkězhī, cóng jūzhù lǜshàng láikàn, rúguǒ duì zhěngpiàn qūyù jìnxíng chāiqiān hé chóngjiàn, qiānyí jūmín de yālì bìngbúdà.
So, judging by occupancy, demolishing and rebuilding the whole area wouldn't mean moving many residents.
第二，区街道办事处做了一个调查问卷。
Dì'èr, qū jiēdào bànshìchù zuò le yígè diàochá wènjuǎn.
Second, the local sub-district office had done a questionnaire.
数据显示，目前，在老区居住的居民中，百分之六十五的人表示愿意接受迁移费，然后在今年就搬家。
Shùjù xiǎnshì, mùqián, zài lǎoqū jūzhù de jūmín zhōng, bǎifēnzhīliùshíwǔ de rén biǎoshì yuànyì jiēshòu qiānyífèi, ránhòu zài jīnnián jiù bānjiā.
It showed that sixty-five per cent of residents of the old district were willing to accept relocation money and move this year.
百分之十二的人表示，可以接受迁移，但是搬家要在两至三年内进行，无法今年就搬走。
Bǎifēnzhīshí'èr de rén biǎoshì, kěyǐ jiēshòu qiānyí, dànshì bānjiā yào zài liǎngzhì sānnián nèi jìnxíng, wúfǎ jīnnián jiù bānzǒu.
Twelve per cent would accept relocation but needed two to three years and couldn't move this year.
百分之十七的人表示，需要再考虑一下。
Bǎifēnzhīshíqī de rén biǎoshì, xūyào zài kǎolǜyíxià.
Seventeen per cent said they needed to think about it.
百分之二的人表示，不愿意搬迁。
Bǎifēnzhī'èr de rén biǎoshì, bú yuànyì bānqiān.
Two per cent said they didn't want to move.
剩下百分之四的居民没有回复调查问题。
Shèngxià bǎifēnzhīsì de jūmín méiyǒu huífù diàochá wèntí.
The remaining four per cent didn't answer.
第三，在不愿意搬迁的人当中，有一户人家曾经做出过激的举动。
Dìsān, zài bú yuànyì bānqiān de rén dāngzhōng, yǒu yíhù rénjiā céngjīng zuòchū guòjī de jǔdòng.
Third, among those unwilling to move, one household had once acted violently.
这户人家目前只有一个孤寡老人：刘大鹏。
Zhèhù rénjiā mùqián zhǐyǒu yígè gūguǎlǎorén: Liú Dàpéng.
That household now consists of one old man living alone: Liu Dapeng.
刘大鹏的儿子和妻子在二十五年前相继离世，他的精神就有些失常了。
Liú Dàpéng de érzi hé qīzǐ zài èrshíwǔnián qián xiāngjì líshì, tā de jīngshén jiù yǒuxiē shīcháng le.
His son and wife died one after the other twenty-five years ago, and since then his mind has been disturbed.
不过平时他并没有攻击性。
Búguò píngshí tā bìng méiyǒu gōngjīxìng.
But normally he isn't aggressive.
只有一次，在2010年前后，电信公司集中拆除了城市里的大部分电话亭。
Zhǐyǒu yícì, zài 2010 nián qiánhòu, diànxìngōngsī jízhōng chāichú le chéngshì lǐ de dàbùfèn diànhuàtíng.
Only once: around 2010, the phone company removed most of the city's phone booths.
在进行刘大鹏家楼下电话亭的拆除工作时，受到了刘大鹏的激烈阻拦，并有过用刀攻击工作人员的行为。
Zài jìnxíng Liú Dàpéng jiā lóuxià diànhuàtíng de chāichú gōngzuò shí, shòudào le Liú Dàpéng de jīliè zǔlán, bìng yǒu guò yòng dāo gōngjī gōngzuòrényuán de xíngwéi.
When they came to remove the booth below Liu Dapeng's home, he fiercely blocked them and even attacked the workers with a knife.
刘大鹏的邻居说，刘大鹏的儿子就死在电话亭旁边。
Liú Dàpéng de línjū shuō, Liú Dàpéng de érzi jiù sǐ zài diànhuàtíng pángbiān.
His neighbours said that Liu Dapeng's son had died right next to the phone booth.
后来，电信公司从人文关怀的角度考虑，决定保留这个电话亭。
Hòulái, diànxìngōngsī cóng rénwén guānhuái de jiǎodù kǎolǜ, juédìng bǎoliú zhège diànhuàtíng.
So the phone company, out of compassion, decided to keep that booth.
会议结束后，徐志伟找到了做民情报告的同事。
Huìyì jiéshù hòu, Xú Zhìwěi zhǎodào le zuò mínqíng bàogào de tóngshì.
After the meeting, Xu Zhiwei found the colleague who had given the residents' report.
“你好。请问你们在调查的时候，有没有查过电话亭的通话记录？我的意思是，这些年来那个电话亭还有人使用吗？”
"Nǐhǎo. Qǐngwèn nǐmen zài diàochá de shíhòu, yǒuméiyǒu chá guò diànhuàtíng de tōnghuàjìlù? Wǒ de yìsi shì, zhèxiēniánlái nàge diànhuàtíng háiyǒu rén shǐyòng ma?"
"Hello. When you did your survey, did you check the phone booth's call records? I mean, has anyone used that booth all these years?"
那同事有些莫名其妙：“没有啊。查通话记录是要警察配合的。我们觉得这不是很重要，就没有查。徐主任，您是觉得有什么疏漏吗？”
Nà tóngshì yǒuxiē mòmíngqímiào: "méiyǒu a. Chá tōnghuàjìlù shì yào jǐngchá pèihé de. Wǒmen juéde zhè búshì hěn zhòngyào, jiù méiyǒu chá. Xú zhǔrèn, nín shì juéde yǒu shénme shūlòu ma?"
The colleague looked puzzled. "No. Checking call records needs the police. We didn't think it was important, so we didn't. Director Xu, do you think we missed something?"
徐志伟连忙否认，表示这只是自己的好奇心。
Xú Zhìwěi liánmáng fǒurèn, biǎoshì zhè zhǐshì zìjǐ de hàoqíxīn.
Xu Zhiwei quickly said no, it was just his own curiosity.
和那同事告别后，他给一个警察朋友打了电话，让他帮忙查一下这个电话亭的通话记录。
Hé nà tóngshì gàobié hòu, tā gěi yígè jǐngchá péngyǒu dǎ le diànhuà, ràng tā bāngmáng chá yíxià zhège diànhuàtíng de tōnghuàjìlù.
After saying goodbye, he phoned a friend in the police and asked him to look up the booth's call records.
徐志伟记得，他在晕倒前，看到儿子阳阳曾经在那里接了一个电话。
Xú Zhìwěi jìde, tā zài yūndǎo qián, kàndào érzi Yángyáng céngjīng zài nàlǐ jiē le yígè diànhuà.
He remembered that before he fainted, he had seen Yangyang take a call there.
两个小时后，朋友就给他发来了记录。
Liǎnggè xiǎoshí hòu, péngyǒu jiù gěi tā fālái le jìlù.
Two hours later, his friend sent him the records.
上面显示，从2020年到2022年，也就是小学搬迁之前的三年里，电话亭几乎每个月都有通话记录，但是寒假、暑假除外。
Shàngmiàn xiǎnshì, cóng 2020 nián dào 2022 nián, yě jiùshì xiǎoxué bānqiān zhīqián de sānnián lǐ, diànhuàtíng jīhū měigè yuè dōu yǒu tōnghuàjìlù, dànshì hánjià, shǔjià chúwài.
They showed that from 2020 to 2022, the three years before the school moved, there were calls to the booth almost every month, except in the winter and summer holidays.
而且所有的电话都不是从电话亭打出去的，而是从一个固定电话打给电话亭的。
Érqiě suǒyǒu de diànhuà dōu búshì cóng diànhuàtíng dǎ chūqù de, érshì cóng yígè gùdìng diànhuà dǎ gěi diànhuàtíng de.
And none of the calls were made from the booth; they were all made to the booth, from one landline.
小学搬迁后的三年里，通话记录寥寥无几。
Xiǎoxué bānqiān hòu de sānnián lǐ, tōnghuàjìlù liáoliáowújǐ.
In the three years since the school moved, there were hardly any.
今年，也就是2025年，只有两通电话。
Jīnnián, yě jiùshì 2025 nián, zhǐyǒu liǎng tōngdiànhuà.
This year, 2025, there were only two calls.
一个是在几个月前，另一个是前几天，应该就是阳阳接到的那个电话。
Yígè shì zài jǐgè yuè qián, lìng yígè shì qián jǐtiān, yīnggāi jiùshì Yángyáng jiēdào de nàge diànhuà.
One a few months ago, and one a few days ago, which must be the call Yangyang answered.
下班后，徐志伟钻进了儿子阳阳的房间，说是要辅导他的作业，其实是想偷偷问阳阳电话的事情。
Xiàbān hòu, Xú Zhìwěi zuānjìn le érzi Yángyáng de fángjiān, shuō shì yào fǔdǎo tā de zuòyè, qíshí shì xiǎng tōutōu wèn Yángyáng diànhuà de shìqíng.
After work, Xu Zhiwei slipped into Yangyang's room, supposedly to help with his homework, but really to quietly ask him about the call.
阳阳说，电话里的人自称是黑暗之神，可以实现他的坏愿望。
Yángyáng shuō, diànhuà lǐ de rén zìchēng shì Hēi'àn zhī Shén, kěyǐ shíxiàn tā de huài yuànwàng.
Yangyang said the person on the phone called himself the God of Darkness and could grant him a bad wish.
但是他没有坏的愿望，后来就挂了电话。
Dànshì tā méiyǒu huài de yuànwàng, hòulái jiù guà le diànhuà.
But he didn't have any bad wishes, so in the end he hung up.
徐志伟一头雾水。
Xú Zhìwěi yìtóuwùshuǐ.
Xu Zhiwei was completely baffled.
黑暗之神？
Hēi'àn zhī Shén?
The God of Darkness?
根据徐志伟的推测，那个会打电话过来的人，应该就是刘大鹏。
Gēnjù Xú Zhìwěi de tuīcè, nàge huì dǎdiànhuà guòlái de rén, yīnggāi jiùshì Liú Dàpéng.
Xu Zhiwei guessed that the person calling must be Liu Dapeng.
可是，他为什么要说这个？
Kěshì, tā wèishénme yàoshuō zhège?
But why would he say that?
看来他的精神状态真的很糟糕。
Kànlái tā de jīngshénzhuàngtài zhēnde hěn zāogāo.
His mental state must really be very bad.
徐志伟和刘大鹏在医院有过一面之缘，他当时就觉得这个人很眼熟。
Xú Zhìwěi hé Liú Dàpéng zài yīyuàn yǒuguò yímiànzhīyuán, tā dāngshí jiù juéde zhège rén hěn yǎnshú.
Xu Zhiwei had seen Liu Dapeng once, at the hospital, and had thought then that he looked familiar.
他又打电话给那个警察朋友，问他能不能找到刘大鹏及其家人的个人信息和照片。
Tā yòu dǎdiànhuà gěi nàge jǐngchá péngyǒu, wèn tā néng bùnéng zhǎodào Liú Dàpéng jíqí jiārén de gèrénxìnxī hé zhàopiān.
He phoned his police friend again and asked whether he could find personal details and photos of Liu Dapeng and his family.
那个朋友说：“志伟，你这是干嘛呢？私查公民的个人信息可是违纪的。你要这些信息做什么呀？”
Nàge péngyǒu shuō: "zhìwěi, nǐ zhè shì gànmá ne? Sīchá gōngmín de gèrénxìnxī kěshì wéijì de. Nǐ yào zhèxiē xìnxī zuò shénme ya?"
His friend said, "Zhiwei, what are you up to? Privately looking up citizens' personal information is against the rules. What do you want it for?"
“不好意思啊，我实在没有办法才找你了。”
"Bùhǎoyìsī a, wǒ shízài méiyǒu bànfǎ cái zhǎo nǐ le."
"Sorry, I came to you because I really have no other way."
“要不然这样，你不要发给我。你先查一下这些信息，如果能查到的话，我明天去警察局找你，看有没有合法的方法看到这些信息。”
"Yàobùrán zhèyàng, nǐ búyào fāgěi wǒ. Nǐ xiānchá yíxià zhèxiē xìnxī, rúguǒ néngchá dào dehuà, wǒ míngtiān qù jǐngchájú zhǎo nǐ, kàn yǒuméiyǒu héfǎ de fāngfǎ kàndào zhèxiē xìnxī."
"How about this: don't send it to me. Look the information up first, and if you find it, I'll come to the police station tomorrow and we'll see if there's a legal way for me to see it."
“那还不简单吗？你出个请求配合调查的证明，就说要调查这个房子的历史状况，不就能看了吗？”
"Nà hái bù jiǎndān ma? Nǐ chūgè qǐngqiú pèihé diàochá de zhèngmíng, jiù shuō yào diàochá zhège fángzi de lìshǐzhuàngkuàng, bú jiù néng kàn le ma?"
"That's easy. Write an official request for cooperation, saying you need to look into the history of the house, and then you can see it."
“好的，谢谢你。那我明天下班后去找你。”
"Hǎo de, xièxiè nǐ. Nà wǒ míngtiān xiàbān hòu qù zhǎo nǐ."
"Great, thanks. I'll come and find you after work tomorrow."
徐志伟挂了电话。
Xú Zhìwěi guà le diànhuà.
Xu Zhiwei hung up.
他离真相越来越近了。
Tālí zhēnxiàng yuèláiyuèjìn le.
He was getting closer and closer to the truth.

About fifty per cent of the houses in the old district are lived in now.

There were also many calls during the school holidays.

Yangyang told the God of Darkness a bad wish.
tf.why: He had no bad wishes and hung up.

His police friend was a classmate from primary school.
tf.why: We don't know how they know each other.

Why does Xu Zhiwei think his parents are hiding something?
o: 因为他们不让他去医院
Yīnwèi tāmen búràng tā qù yīyuàn
Because they wouldn't let him go to hospital
因为一提到小学，他们就不愿意多说，妈妈也很紧张
Yīnwèi yì tídào xiǎoxué, tāmen jiù bú yuànyì duō shuō, māmā yě hěn jǐnzhāng
Because they avoid talking about primary school and his mother looked nervous
因为他们卖了他的照片
Yīnwèi tāmen mài le tā de zhàopiān
mc.why: They keep quiet about primary school, and his mother asked nervously what else he remembered.

q: 居住率下降最重要的原因是什么？

What is the main reason occupancy keeps falling?
o: The facilities are old and run down
mc.why: Crumbling walls, unreliable power, smelly drains.

q: 电信公司为什么保留了刘大鹏家楼下的电话亭？
Diànxìngōngsī wèishénme bǎoliú le Liú Dàpéng jiā lóuxià de diànhuàtíng?
Why did the phone company keep the booth below Liu Dapeng's home?
o: Yīnwèi hěnduō rén hái zài yòng
Because many people still use it
因为他的儿子死在电话亭旁边，出于人文关怀
Yīnwèi tā de érzi sǐ zài diànhuàtíng pángbiān, chūyú rénwén guānhuái
Out of compassion, because his son died next to it
Because removing it was too expensive
mc.why: They decided to keep it out of compassion.

q: 通话记录告诉了徐志伟什么？
Tōnghuàjìlù gàosù le Xú Zhìwěi shénme?
What did the call records tell Xu Zhiwei?
ans: 小学搬走前三年，除了寒暑假，几乎每个月都有一个固定电话打给电话亭；今年只有两通电话。
Xiǎoxué bānzǒu qián sānnián, chúle hánshǔjià, jīhū měigè yuè dōu yǒu yígè gùdìng diànhuà dǎ gěi diànhuàtíng; jīnnián zhǐyǒu liǎng tōngdiànhuà.
For the three years before the school moved, a landline called the booth almost every month except in the holidays; this year there were only two calls.

q: 徐志伟猜打电话的人是谁？为什么？
Xú Zhìwěi cāi dǎdiànhuà de rén shì shuí? Wèishénme?
Who does Xu Zhiwei think is making the calls, and why?
ans: 他猜是刘大鹏，因为刘大鹏住在电话亭楼上，他的儿子死在电话亭旁边，他的精神也不正常。
Tā cāi shì Liú Dàpéng, yīnwèi Liú Dàpéng zhù zài diànhuàtíng lóushàng, tā de érzi sǐ zài diànhuàtíng pángbiān, tā de jīngshén yě bú zhèngcháng.
He thinks it's Liu Dapeng, who lives above the booth, whose son died beside it and whose mind is disturbed.

q: 警察朋友为什么不能直接把刘大鹏的信息发给徐志伟？
Jǐngchá péngyǒu wèishénme bùnéng zhíjiē bǎ Liú Dàpéng de xìnxī fāgěi Xú Zhìwěi?
Why can't his police friend just send him Liu Dapeng's details?
ans: 因为私查公民的个人信息是违纪的，要有合法的方法。
Yīnwèi sīchá gōngmín de gèrénxìnxī shì wéijì de, yào yǒu héfǎ de fāngfǎ.
Because privately looking up citizens' personal information breaks the rules; there must be a legal way.

009.title: Chapter 9 · Oh, My Dear Friend

blocks.label: 章
lines: 第九章 亲爱的朋友啊
Dìjiǔzhāng qīn'ài de péngyǒu a
Chapter 9: Oh, My Dear Friend
徐志伟下班后，迫不及待地赶到警察局，拿到了朋友给他的文件袋。
Xú Zhìwěi xiàbān hòu, pòbùjídài de gǎndào jǐngchájú, nádào le péngyǒu gěi tā de wénjiàndài.
After work, Xu Zhiwei hurried impatiently to the police station and got the folder his friend had for him.
道谢后，他又回到了办公室。
Dàoxiè hòu, tā yòu huídào le bàngōngshì.
After thanking him, he went back to his office.
他不想回家看这些资料，但在公共场所看，又有些不私密。
Tā bùxiǎng huíjiā kàn zhèxiē zīliào, dàn zài gōnggòngchǎngsuǒ kàn, yòu yǒuxiē bù sīmì.
He didn't want to read this at home, but in a public place it wasn't private enough.
所以，他只好回了办公室。
Suǒyǐ, tā zhǐhǎo huí le bàngōngshì.
So he went back to the office.
同事们已经下班了，他可以安静地去阅读和回忆。
Tóngshì men yǐjīng xiàbān le, tā kěyǐ ānjìng dìqù yuèdú hé huíyì.
His colleagues had gone home; he could read and remember in peace.
他打开文件袋，拿出里面的资料。
Tā dǎkāi wénjiàndài, náchū lǐmiàn de zīliào.
He opened the folder and took out the papers.
第一份文件是刘大鹏的信息。
Dìyīfèn wénjiàn shì Liú Dàpéng de xìnxī.
The first was about Liu Dapeng.
刘大鹏出生于1961年，高中文化水平。
Liú Dàpéng chū shēngyú 1961 nián, gāozhōngwénhuà shuǐpíng.
Liu Dapeng, born 1961, educated to high-school level.
毕业后先是在工厂工作，后任职于某国企。
Bìyè hòu xiānshì zài gōngchǎng gōngzuò, hòu rènzhí yú mǒu guóqǐ.
After school he first worked in a factory, then at a state-owned company.
1984 nián jiéhūn, 1986 nián shēngzi.
Married in 1984, son born 1986.
1991年下岗后，在自己家里开了小型理发店谋生。
1991 nián xiàgǎng hòu, zài zìjǐ jiālǐ kāi le xiǎoxíng lǐfàdiàn móushēng.
Laid off in 1991, he made a living with a small barber's shop in his home.
2000年，儿子车祸去世。
2000 nián, érzi chēhuò qùshì.
In 2000 his son was killed in a traffic accident.
2001年，妻子跳楼去世。
2001 nián, qīzǐ tiàolóu qùshì.

徐志伟恢复了正常的生活。
Xú Zhìwěi huīfù le zhèngcháng de shēnghuó.
Xu Zhiwei went back to a normal life.
上中学、高中、大学，毕业后考公务员，然后结婚生子。
Shàng zhōngxué, gāozhōng, dàxué, bìyè hòukǎo gōngwùyuán, ránhòu jiéhūn shēngzi.
Secondary school, high school, university, the civil service exam after graduating, then marriage and a child.
直到命运的齿轮又一次缓缓地启动，将他带回了那个被遗忘的街区，让他想起了那个被遗忘的朋友。
Zhídào mìngyùn de chǐlún yòu yícì huǎnhuǎn de qǐdòng, jiāng tā dàihuí le nàge bèi yíwàng de jiēqū, ràng tā xiǎngqǐ le nàge bèi yíwàng de péngyǒu.
Until the wheels of fate slowly began to turn again, bringing him back to that forgotten neighbourhood and reminding him of that forgotten friend.
回忆起这一切，徐志伟已经泪流满面。
Huíyìqǐ zhè yíqiè, Xú Zhìwěi yǐjīng lèiliúmǎnmiàn.
Remembering it all, Xu Zhiwei's face was wet with tears.
亲爱的朋友，我真是太坏了，为了自己的幸福而忘了你。
Qīn'ài de péngyǒu, wǒ zhēnshì tàihuài le, wèile zìjǐ de xìngfú ér wàng le nǐ.
My dear friend, how terrible of me, forgetting you for the sake of my own happiness.
徐志伟擦干眼泪，内心下了一个决定。
Xú Zhìwěi cāgàn yǎnlèi, nèixīn xià le yígè juédìng.
Xu Zhiwei dried his eyes and made a decision.
他要承担起照顾刘叔叔的责任，要像一个成熟的成年人一样，处理好一切，包括他自己的情绪。
Tā yào chéngdān qǐ zhàogù liú shūshū de zérèn, yào xiàng yígè chéngshú de chéngniánrén yíyàng, chǔlǐ hǎo yíqiè, bāokuò tā zìjǐ de qíngxù.
He would take on the responsibility of looking after Uncle Liu and, like a mature adult, handle everything, including his own feelings.
徐志伟满面笑容地走进了家门。
Xú Zhìwěi mǎnmiànxiàoróng de zǒujìn le jiāmén.
Xu Zhiwei came home with a big smile.
他没有告诉父母，他已经找回了丢失的记忆，免得让他们担心。
Tā méiyǒu gàosù fùmǔ, tā yǐjīng zhǎohuí le diūshī de jìyì, miǎnde ràng tāmen dānxīn.
He didn't tell his parents he'd recovered his lost memory, so they wouldn't worry.
但他偷偷地告诉儿子阳阳，周末他要再带阳阳去富文书店。
Dàn tā tōutōudì gàosù érzi Yángyáng, zhōumò tā yào zài dài Yángyáng qù Fùwén Shūdiàn.
But he quietly told his son Yangyang that at the weekend he'd take him back to the Fuwen Bookshop.

tf.why: He thought that if he hadn't called him over, it wouldn't have happened.

tf.why: He'd rather not sleep than dream of Dayang.

Because Xu Zhiwei waved and said he'd found another clue

Because the accident injured his head

Because in the dreams Dayang always smiled happily at him, and since he felt he had caused his death, it made him guilty and afraid.

010.title: Chapter 10 · Reunion

blocks.label: 章
lines: 第十章 重逢
Dìshízhāng chóngféng
Chapter 10: Reunion
暑假已经过去快一个月了。
Shǔjià yǐjīng guòqù kuài yígèyuè le.
Nearly a month of the summer holidays had gone by.
这段时间里，江阳去了城里大约有八九次，还是没有找到那个电话亭。
Zhè duànshíjiān lǐ, Jiāng Yáng qù le chénglǐ dàyuē yǒu bājiǔ cì, háishì méiyǒu zhǎodào nàge diànhuàtíng.
In that time Jiang Yang had been to the city eight or nine times and still hadn't found the phone booth.
江阳也不知道他到底为什么这么执着。
Jiāng Yáng yě bù zhīdào tā dàodǐ wèishénme zhème zhízhuó.
Jiang Yang didn't know himself why he was so stubborn about it.
可能是因为他本来性格就是如此，碰到什么事情总要搞个明白。
Kěnéng shìyīnwèi tā běnlái xìnggé jiùshì rúcǐ, pèngdào shénme shìqíng zǒngyào gǎo gè míngbái.
Maybe it was just his nature: whatever happened, he had to get to the bottom of it.
也可能是因为他想用这件事转移注意力，缓解对父母的思念之情。
Yě kěnéng shìyīnwèi tā xiǎng yòng zhèjiàn shì zhuǎnyí zhùyìlì, huǎnjiě duì fùmǔ de sīniàn zhīqíng.
Or maybe he wanted to use it to take his mind off missing his parents.
一个星期六的早上，他又早早出门，准备坐公交车去城里。
Yígè xīngqīliù de zǎoshàng, tā yòu zǎozǎo chūmén, zhǔnbèi zuò gōngjiāochē qù chénglǐ.
One Saturday morning he set off early again to catch the bus to the city.
一出大门就看到了王老师。
Yīchū dàmén jiù kàndào le wánglǎoshī.
As soon as he stepped out of the gate, he saw Teacher Wang.
王梅站在他家门口，眯着眼看着他。
Wáng Méi zhàn zài tā jiāménkǒu, mīzhuóyǎn kànzhe tā.
Wang Mei was standing by his door, looking at him with narrowed eyes.
“王老师，早上好。这么早，您在我们家门口干什么呀？”
"Wánglǎoshī, zǎoshànghǎo. Zhème zǎo, nín zài wǒmen jiāménkǒu gànshénme ya?"
"Good morning, Teacher Wang. What are you doing at our door so early?"
“你说呢？我一个月找不见你人影了，来你家四五次都没看到你。这下被我抓到了。你神秘兮兮地做什么呢？”
"Nǐ shuō ne? Wǒ yígèyuè zhǎo bújiàn nǐ rényǐng le, lái nǐjiā sìwǔcì dōu méi kàndào nǐ. Zhèxià bèi wǒ zhuā dào le. Nǐ shénmìxīxī de zuò shénme ne?"
"What do you think? I haven't seen hide nor hair of you for a month. I've been here four or five times and never found you. Now I've caught you. What are you up to, being so secretive?"
江阳其实早就想找个人求助了，但那个人不能是王老师。
Jiāng Yáng qíshí zǎojiù xiǎng zhǎo gèrén qiúzhù le, dàn nàge rén bùnéng shì wánglǎoshī.
Jiang Yang had long wanted to ask someone for help, but it couldn't be Teacher Wang.
因为他曾经在电话里说，希望王老师可以生病。
Yīnwèi tā céngjīng zài diànhuà lǐ shuō, xīwàng wánglǎoshī kěyǐ shēngbìng.
Because on that phone he had wished she would fall ill.
所以他支支吾吾地不想回答。
Suǒyǐ tā zhīzhīwúwú de bùxiǎng huídá.
So he hemmed and hawed and didn't want to answer.
越是这样，王梅越是不放他走。
Yuèshì zhèyàng, Wáng Méi yuèshì búfàng tā zǒu.
The more he did, the less Wang Mei would let him go.
她担心江阳去城里认识了一些不好的朋友，走上了歧途。
Tā dānxīn Jiāng Yáng qù chénglǐ rènshí le yìxiē bùhǎo de péngyǒu, zǒushàng le qítú.
She worried he'd met bad company in the city and was going astray.
江阳没办法，只好全盘托出。
Jiāng Yáng méi bànfǎ, zhǐhǎo quánpántuōchū.
Jiang Yang had no choice but to tell her everything.
说完后，他担心地看着王梅，害怕王梅因此生气，以后不再管他了。
Shuōwán hòu, tā dānxīn de kànzhe Wáng Méi, hàipà Wáng Méi yīncǐ shēngqì, yǐhòu búzài guǎn tā le.
When he'd finished, he looked at her anxiously, afraid she'd be angry and never look out for him again.
王梅的脸色确实有些沉重，但她关注的点和江阳担心的事情并不一样。
Wáng Méi de liǎnsè quèshí yǒuxiē chénzhòng, dàn tā guānzhù de diǎn hé Jiāng Yáng dānxīn de shìqíng bìng bù yíyàng.
Wang Mei did look grave, but what caught her attention wasn't what Jiang Yang was worried about.
她问：“那个博文书店里，是不是卖二手书？”
Tā wèn: "nàge Bówén Shūdiàn lǐ, shìbúshì mài èrshǒushū?"
She asked, "That Bowen Bookshop: does it sell second-hand books?"
“是啊。老师，你怎么知道的呢？”
"Shì a. Lǎoshī, nǐ zěnme zhīdào de ne?"
"Yes. Teacher, how did you know?"
“它不叫博文书店，叫富文书店。书店的主人是一个叫富文的阿姨。我知道它在哪儿。走吧，我带你去。”
"Tā bú jiào Bówén Shūdiàn, jiào Fùwén Shūdiàn. Shūdiàn de zhǔrén shì yígè jiào Fùwén de āyí. Wǒ zhīdào tā zài nǎ'ér. Zǒu ba, wǒ dàinǐqù."
"It's not called the Bowen Bookshop, it's the Fuwen Bookshop. The owner is a lady called Fuwen. I know where it is. Come on, I'll take you."
“真的吗？老师，你可太厉害了！你怎么什么都知道啊？”江阳兴奋地跳了起来。
"Zhēnde ma? Lǎoshī, nǐ kě tài lìhài le! Nǐ zěnme shénme dōu zhīdào a?" Jiāng Yáng xīngfèn de tiào le qǐlái.
"Really? Teacher, you're amazing! How do you know everything?" Jiang Yang jumped up with excitement.
王梅带着江阳坐了公交车，换乘了两趟车后，到达了老区。
Wáng Méi dài zhe Jiāng Yáng zuò le gōngjiāochē, huànchéng le liǎngtàng chēhòu, dàodá le lǎoqū.
Wang Mei took Jiang Yang by bus; after changing twice, they reached the old district.
她熟练地领着江阳穿过几条小路，到了富文书店的门口。
Tā shúliàndì lǐngzhe Jiāng Yáng chuānguò jǐtiáo xiǎolù, dào le Fùwén Shūdiàn de ménkǒu.
She led him confidently through a few little streets to the door of the Fuwen Bookshop.
二十五年前，这里是一切的起点。
Èrshíwǔnián qián, zhèlǐ shì yíqiè de qǐdiǎn.
Twenty-five years ago, this was where it all began.
江阳想要去电话亭里，被王梅拉住了。
Jiāng Yáng xiǎngyào qù diànhuàtíng lǐ, bèi Wáng Méi lāzhù le.
Jiang Yang wanted to go to the phone booth, but Wang Mei held him back.
她拉着江阳走进了富文书店。
Tā lā zhe Jiāng Yáng zǒujìn le Fùwén Shūdiàn.
She took him into the bookshop.
书店里人不少，这让王梅有些惊讶。
Shūdiàn lǐ rén bùshǎo, zhè ràng Wáng Méi yǒuxiē jīngyà.
There were quite a few people inside, which surprised her.
现在的年轻人越来越不喜欢阅读了。
Xiànzài de niánqīngrén yuèláiyuè bù xǐhuān yuèdú le.
Young people today read less and less.
就算喜欢，大多数人也会在电子设备上阅读。
Jiùsuàn xǐhuān, dàduōshù rén yě huì zài diànzishèbèi shàng yuèdú.
Even those who like reading mostly do it on screens.
买书的人越来越少，买二手书的人更是寥寥无几。
Mǎishū de rén yuèláiyuèshǎo, mǎi èrshǒushū de rén gèngshì liáoliáowújǐ.
Fewer and fewer people buy books, and hardly anyone buys second-hand ones.
看着书店里的年轻人拿着手机或者相机，摆着各种造型拍照，王梅明白了。
Kànzhe shūdiàn lǐ de niánqīngrén ná zhe shǒujī huòzhě xiàngjī, bǎizhe gèzhǒng zàoxíng pāizhào, Wáng Méi míngbái le.
Watching the young people in the shop striking poses for photos with phones and cameras, Wang Mei understood.
原来这里变成了网红打卡点。
Yuánlái zhèlǐ biànchéng le wǎnghóng dǎkǎ diǎn.
The place had become an internet-famous photo spot.
最近几年，这样的老铺子很受年轻人的欢迎。
Zuìjìn jǐnián, zhèyàng de lǎo pùzi hěnshòu niánqīngrén de huānyíng.
In recent years, old shops like this have been very popular with young people.
有些商店和饭店会特意搞这种复古的装修来吸引顾客。
Yǒuxiē shāngdiàn hé fàndiàn huì tèyì gǎo zhèzhǒng fùgǔ de zhuāngxiū lái xīyǐn gùkè.
Some shops and restaurants even deliberately use this retro décor to attract customers.
王梅环顾着书店，仿佛回到了过去，回到了她人生中最幸福的时光里。
Wáng Méi huángù zhe shūdiàn, fǎngfú huídào le guòqù, huídào le tā rénshēng zhōng zuì xìngfú de shíguāng lǐ.
Looking around the shop, Wang Mei felt as if she'd gone back in time, to the happiest days of her life.
她的手不由得攥紧了江阳的手，好像还牵着她的宝贝儿子天天。
Tā de shǒu bùyóude zuàn jǐn le Jiāng Yáng de shǒu, hǎoxiàng hái qiān zhe tā de bǎobèi'érzi Tiāntiān.
Without thinking, she gripped Jiang Yang's hand tightly, as if she were still holding her darling son Tiantian.
江阳惊讶地看着王老师，没有打断她的思绪。
Jiāng Yáng jīngyà de kànzhe wánglǎoshī, méiyǒu dǎduàn tā de sīxù.
Jiang Yang looked at Teacher Wang in surprise but didn't interrupt her thoughts.
王梅的视线慢慢移到收银台，看见了一位白发苍苍的老人坐在那里睡觉。
Wáng Méi de shìxiàn mànmàn yí dào shōuyíntái, kànjiàn le yíwèi báifàcāngcāng de lǎorén zuòzài nàlǐ shuìjiào.
Her gaze slowly moved to the till, where a white-haired old woman sat sleeping.
这就是富文吧。
Zhè jiùshì Fùwén ba.
That must be Fuwen.
变老了许多呀。
Biànlǎo le xǔduō ya.
She'd aged a lot.
是啊，就连王梅自己都从风华正茂的青年变成了即将退休的妇女。
Shì a, jiù lián Wáng Méi zìjǐ dōu cóng fēnghuázhèngmào de qīngnián biànchéng le jíjiāng tuìxiū de fùnǚ.
Well, Wang Mei herself had gone from a young woman in her prime to one about to retire.
王梅的思绪一下子被拉回了现实。
Wáng Méi de sīxù yíxiàzi bèilāhuí le xiànshí.
Her thoughts were suddenly pulled back to the present.
王梅和富文其实不太熟悉。
Wáng Méi hé Fùwén qíshí bútàishúxī.
Wang Mei didn't actually know Fuwen well.
但富文曾经在学生和老师之间很有名，因为她的书店就像是一个免费的图书馆。
Dàn Fùwén céngjīng zài xuéshēng hé lǎoshī zhījiān hěn yǒumíng, yīnwèi tā de shūdiàn jiù xiàngshì yígè miǎnfèi de túshūguǎn.
But Fuwen used to be well known among pupils and teachers, because her shop was like a free library.
很多孩子们放学都去那里读书，看了几个小时，也不花钱买一本。
Hěnduō háizi men fàngxué dōu qù nàlǐ dúshū, kàn le jǐgè xiǎoshí, yě bù huāqiánmǎi yìběn.
Lots of children went there after school to read for hours without buying a single book.
富文一直对孩子们很友善，从不会撵他们离开。
Fùwén yìzhí duì háizi men hěn yǒushàn, cóng búhuì niǎn tāmen líkāi.
Fuwen was always kind to the children and never chased them out.
王梅没想到她的书店还在营业，而且她还跟之前一样。
Wáng Méi méixiǎngdào tā de shūdiàn hái zài yíngyè, érqiě tā hái gēn zhīqián yíyàng.
Wang Mei hadn't expected the shop still to be open, or Fuwen to be just the same.
年轻人们在她店里拍照打卡，然后一分钱也不花就离开了，富文依然丝毫不介意。
Niánqīng rénmen zài tā diànlǐ pāizhào dǎkǎ, ránhòu yìfēnqián yě bùhuā jiù líkāi le, Fùwén yīrán sī háobújièyì.
Young people took photos in her shop and left without spending a penny, and Fuwen still didn't mind in the least.
王梅知道，这旁边几栋楼的房子都是富文的。
Wáng Méi zhīdào, zhè pángbiān jǐdòng lóu de fángzi dōu shì Fùwén de.
Wang Mei knew that the flats in the buildings next door all belonged to Fuwen.
之前她只要收租金，就生活得很富裕，所以她不在意书店有没有盈利。
Zhīqián tā zhǐyào shōu zūjīn, jiù shēnghuó dé hěn fùyù, suǒyǐ tā búzàiyì shūdiàn yǒuméiyǒu yínglì.
She used to live comfortably just on the rent, so she didn't care whether the shop made money.
但是现在，这片街区已经没有很多租客了，富文还有钱生活吗？
Dànshì xiànzài, zhèpiàn jiēqū yǐjīng méiyǒu hěnduō zūkè le, Fùwén háiyǒu qián shēnghuó ma?
But now there weren't many tenants left in the area. Did Fuwen still have enough to live on?
富文睁开惺忪的睡眼，正好对上了王梅的视线。
Fùwén zhēngkāi xīngsōng de shuìyǎn, zhènghǎo duì shàng le Wáng Méi de shìxiàn.
Fuwen opened her sleepy eyes and met Wang Mei's gaze.
王梅走上前，礼貌地说：“富阿姨，这么睡觉太辛苦了呀。您身体还好吗？”
Wáng Méi zǒushàng qián, lǐmào dìshuō: "Fù āyí, zhème shuìjiào tài xīnkǔ le ya. Nín shēntǐ háihǎo ma?"
Wang Mei stepped forward and said politely, "Auntie Fu, sleeping like that must be hard on you. How are you keeping?"
"Nǐ shì……?"
"And you are...?"
“我是王梅，过去在这附近的小学工作。您记得曾经住在这楼上的刘达阳吗？我之前是他的班主任，过来家访的时候见过您几次。”
"Wǒ shì Wáng Méi, guòqù zài zhè fùjìn de xiǎoxué gōngzuò. Nín jìde céngjīng zhù zài zhè lóushàng de Liú Dáyáng ma? Wǒ zhīqián shì tā de bānzhǔrèn, guòlái jiāfǎng de shíhòu jiàn guò nín jǐcì."
"I'm Wang Mei; I used to work at the primary school near here. Do you remember Liu Dayang, who lived upstairs? I was his class teacher; I met you a few times on home visits."
王梅说到最后，语气有些伤心。
Wáng Méi shuō dào zuìhòu, yǔqì yǒuxiē shāngxīn.
By the end, Wang Mei's voice was sad.
“王老师，我当然记得啦。你是学校的明星教师嘛。那时候经常听孩子们提起你。”
"Wánglǎoshī, wǒ dāngrán jìde la. Nǐ shì xuéxiào de míngxīng jiàoshī ma. Nà shíhòu jīngcháng tīng háizi men tíqǐ nǐ."
"Teacher Wang, of course I remember. You were the school's star teacher. The children talked about you all the time back then."
富文说着话，似乎想起来王梅家后来遭到的变故，语气也伤感了起来：
Fùwén shuō zhe huà, sìhū xiǎng qǐlái Wáng Méi jiā hòulái zāodào de biàngù, yǔqì yě shānggǎn le qǐlái:
As she spoke, Fuwen seemed to remember the tragedy that later struck Wang Mei's family, and her voice grew sad too:
“哎，命运弄人呐。你来这里，有什么事吗？”
"Āi, mìngyùn nòng rén nà. Nǐ lái zhèlǐ, yǒu shénme shì ma?"
"Ah, fate plays cruel tricks. What brings you here?"
没等王梅回答，她的身后响起了一个男人的声音：“王老师？”
Méi děng Wáng Méi huídá, tā de shēnhòu xiǎngqǐ le yígè nánrén de shēngyīn: "wánglǎoshī?"
Before Wang Mei could answer, a man's voice spoke behind her: "Teacher Wang?"
王梅回头，看见一个中年男人领着一个小学生模样的男孩。
Wáng Méi huítóu, kànjiàn yígè zhōngniánnánrén lǐngzhe yígè xiǎoxuéshēng múyàng de nánhái.
She turned and saw a middle-aged man with a boy who looked like a primary school pupil.
她想不起对方是谁了。
Tā xiǎngbùqǐ duìfāng shì shuí le.
She couldn't think who he was.
那男人也没期待王梅会认出自己，他激动地继续说道：
Nà nánrén yě méi qīdài Wáng Méi huì rènchū zìjǐ, tā jīdòng de jìxù shuōdào:
The man hadn't expected her to recognise him; he went on excitedly:
“真是太巧了。老师，你认不出我来了，是吗？我是徐志伟啊，六年级三班的徐志伟。你还记得吗？”
"Zhēnshì tàiqiǎo le. Lǎoshī, nǐ rènbùchū wǒlái le, shì ma? Wǒ shì Xú Zhìwěi a, liùniánjí sānbān de Xú Zhìwěi. Nǐ hái jìde ma?"
"What a coincidence! Teacher, you don't recognise me, do you? I'm Xu Zhiwei, Xu Zhiwei from class 3 in year six. Do you remember?"
“徐志伟？天啊！真是难以相信，你长这么大了！不过还是和小时候一样帅气。”
"Xú Zhìwěi? Tiān a! Zhēnshì nányǐxiāngxìn, nǐzhǎng zhème dà le! Búguò háishì hé xiǎoshíhòu yíyàng shuàiqì."
"Xu Zhiwei? Goodness! I can hardly believe you've grown up so much! But you're as handsome as when you were little."
王梅欣喜若狂。
Wáng Méi xīnxǐruòkuáng.
Wang Mei was overjoyed.
她虽然不能记住自己教过的所有学生，但是总有一些印象深刻的，让她一直无法忘记。
Tā suīrán bùnéng jìzhù zìjǐ jiàoguò de suǒyǒu xuéshēng, dànshì zǒngyǒu yìxiē yìnxiàng shēnkè de, ràng tā yìzhí wúfǎ wàngjì.
She couldn't remember every pupil she had taught, but there were always some who made a deep impression and whom she could never forget.
比如，徐志伟和刘达阳。
Bǐrú, Xú Zhìwěi hé Liú Dáyáng.
Like Xu Zhiwei and Liu Dayang.
两个乖巧懂事、学习成绩好的男孩子。
Liǎnggè guāiqiǎo dǒngshì, xuéxíchéngjì hǎo de nánháizi.
Two well-behaved, sensible boys with good marks.
用现在的话来说，就像是从漫画里走出来的少年，英俊、阳光。
Yòng xiànzài dehuà láishuō, jiù xiàngshì cóng mànhuà lǐ zǒu chūlái de shàonián, yīngjùn, yángguāng.
As people say now, they were like boys who'd stepped out of a manga: good-looking and sunny.
看见这师生重逢的感动场面，富文也很开心。
Kànjiàn zhè shīshēng chóngféng de gǎndòng chǎngmiàn, Fùwén yě hěn kāixīn.
Seeing this moving reunion of teacher and pupil, Fuwen was happy too.
正好富文的儿子中午下班回来，她让儿子替她坐在收银台。
Zhènghǎo Fùwén de érzi zhōngwǔ xiàbān huílái, tā ràng érzi tì tā zuòzài shōuyíntái.
Her son had just come home from work for lunch, and she had him sit at the till for her.
她打开收银台后面的门，对王梅和徐志伟说：“我们到后面的房间里聊吧，这里说话不方便。”
Tā dǎkāi shōuyíntái hòumiàn de mén, duì Wáng Méi hé Xú Zhìwěi shuō: "wǒmen dào hòumiàn de fángjiān lǐ liáo ba, zhèlǐ shuōhuà bù fāngbiàn."
She opened the door behind the till and said to Wang Mei and Xu Zhiwei, "Let's talk in the back room; it's not easy to talk here."
二人欣然同意。
Èrrén xīnrántóngyì.
They gladly agreed.
但徐志伟的儿子徐阳阳提出了反对意见：“爸爸，我不去，我要在这里看书。”
Dàn Xú Zhìwěi de érzi Xú Yángyáng tíchū le fǎnduì yìjiàn: "bàbà, wǒ bú qù, wǒyào zài zhèlǐ kànshū."
But Xu Zhiwei's son, Xu Yangyang, objected: "Dad, I don't want to go. I want to read here."
江阳也表示，他也要留在书店看书。
Jiāng Yáng yě biǎoshì, tā yě yào liúzài shūdiàn kànshū.
Jiang Yang said he wanted to stay and read in the shop too.
徐志伟嘱咐说：“看书可以，但是不能像上次那样自己跑出去。就在书店里等着爸爸，知道了吗？”
Xú Zhìwěi zhǔfù shuō: "kànshū kěyǐ, dànshì bùnéng xiàng shàngcì nàyàng zìjǐ pǎochūqù. Jiù zài shūdiàn lǐ děng zhe bàbà, zhīdào le ma?"
Xu Zhiwei told him, "You can read, but you mustn't run off by yourself like last time. Wait for Dad in the shop, understand?"
说完，他又拜托富文的儿子，帮忙看着两个小孩，不要出去乱跑。
Shuōwán, tā yòu bàituō Fùwén de érzi, bāngmáng kànzhe liǎnggè xiǎohái, búyào chūqù luànpǎo.
Then he asked Fuwen's son to keep an eye on the two boys and not let them wander off.
然后便和富文、王梅一起走进院子，富文住的地方。
Ránhòu biàn hé Fùwén, Wáng Méi yìqǐ zǒujìn yuànzi, Fùwén zhù de dìfāng.
Then he went with Fuwen and Wang Mei into the yard where Fuwen lived.
他们三人开始叙旧，这一聊就是两个多小时。
Tāmen sānrén kāishǐ xùjiù, zhèyìliáo jiùshì liǎnggè duō xiǎoshí.
The three of them began to catch up, and talked for over two hours.
徐志伟终于找到一个可以倾听他的人。
Xú Zhìwěi zhōngyú zhǎodào yígè kěyǐ qīngtīng tā de rén.
Xu Zhiwei had finally found someone who would listen to him.
他从那场事故开始讲起，详细讲述了他这些年的经历。
Tā cóng nàchǎng shìgù kāishǐ jiǎng qǐ, xiángxì jiǎngshù le tā zhèxiē nián de jīnglì.
He started from the accident and told them in detail what he had been through all these years.
期间，他多次痛哭失声，彻底摘下了成年男人的面具，哭得像个未谙世事的少年。
Qījiān, tā duōcì tòngkūshīshēng, chèdǐ zhāixià le chéngnián nánrén de miànjù, kū dé xiàng gè wèi'ān shìshì de shàonián.
Several times he broke down sobbing, completely dropping the mask of a grown man, crying like a boy who knew nothing of the world.
王梅也跟着一起落泪。
Wáng Méi yě gēnzhe yìqǐ luòlèi.
Wang Mei wept with him.
她既伤心又感慨。
Tā jì shāngxīn yòu gǎnkǎi.
She felt both sad and deeply moved.
伤心的是，她竟然不知道她的学生经历过这样的事情，也没有在他最艰难的时刻给他安慰。
Shāngxīn de shì, tā jìngrán bù zhīdào tā de xuéshēng jīnglì guò zhèyàng de shìqíng, yě méiyǒu zài tā zuì jiānnán de shíkè gěi tā ānwèi.
Sad that she had never known her pupil went through all this, and hadn't comforted him in his hardest moments.
感慨的是，即便遇见这样的事故，徐志伟也好好地长大成人了，还是一个有担当和责任感的人。
Gǎnkǎi de shì, jíbiàn yùjiàn zhèyàng de shìgù, Xú Zhìwěi yě hǎohǎo de zhǎngdàchéngrén le, háishì yígè yǒu dāndāng hé zérèngǎn de rén.
Moved that, despite such an accident, Xu Zhiwei had grown up well, a man who takes responsibility.
他们聊着聊着，话题最终落到了刘大鹏身上。
Tāmen liáozhe liáozhe, huàtí zuìzhōng luòdào le Liú Dàpéng shēnshàng.
As they talked, the conversation finally turned to Liu Dapeng.
他们觉得很巧，他们都是因为刘大鹏的电话，又重新回到了事发之地。
Tāmen juéde hěnqiǎo, tāmen dōu shìyīnwèi Liú Dàpéng de diànhuà, yòu chóngxīn huídào le shìfā zhīdì.
They found it a strange coincidence that it was Liu Dapeng's phone calls that had brought them all back to where it happened.
也许是上苍指引着他们重逢，一起解开刘达阳的最后一个谜题。
Yěxǔ shì shàngcāng zhǐyǐn zhe tāmen chóngféng, yìqǐ jiěkāi Liú Dáyáng de zuìhòu yígè mítí.
Perhaps heaven had guided them to meet again, to solve together Liu Dayang's last puzzle.
