Fuwen's son works in a factory near the bookshop.
tf.why: We only know he came home from work at lunchtime.

q: 三个人在后面的房间聊了两个多小时。
Sāngè rén zài hòumiàn de fángjiān liáo le liǎnggè duō xiǎoshí.
The three talked in the back room for over two hours.
tf.why: Xu Zhiwei told them everything.

q: 王梅为什么握紧了江阳的手？
Wáng Méi wèishénme wòjǐn le Jiāng Yáng de shǒu?
Why did Wang Mei grip Jiang Yang's hand?
o: Yīnwèi tā pà Jiāng Yáng pǎochūqù
Because she was afraid he'd run off
因为她想起了儿子天天，好像还牵着他
Yīnwèi tā xiǎngqǐ le érzi Tiāntiān, hǎoxiàng hái qiān zhe tā
Because she thought of her son Tiantian, as if still holding his hand
mc.why: The shop took her back to the happiest time of her life.

q: 王梅以前和富文是什么关系？
Wáng Méi yǐqián hé Fùwén shì shénme guānxì?
What was Wang Mei's relationship with Fuwen before?
o: 她们不太熟，王梅家访时见过富文几次
Tāmen bútàishú, Wáng Méi jiāfǎng shíjiàn guò Fùwén jǐcì
They didn't know each other well; Wang Mei met her a few times on home visits
Fùwén shì Wáng Méi de lǎoshī
mc.why: They weren't close.

q: 王梅听徐志伟讲完以后，为什么伤心？
Wáng Méi tīng Xú Zhìwěi jiǎngwán yǐhòu, wèishénme shāngxīn?
Why was Wang Mei sad after hearing Xu Zhiwei's story?
o: Yīnwèi Xú Zhìwěi wàng le tā
因为她不知道学生经历了这些，也没有在他最难的时候安慰他
Yīnwèi tā bù zhīdào xuéshēng jīnglì le zhèxiē, yě méiyǒu zài tā zuìnán de shíhòu ānwèi tā
Because she never knew what her pupil went through and didn't comfort him at his hardest time
Because the shop will be demolished
mc.why: She was also moved that he grew up so responsible.

q: 江阳为什么一直要找那个电话亭？说两个原因。
Jiāng Yáng wèishénme yìzhí yào zhǎo nàge diànhuàtíng? Shuō liǎnggè yuányīn.
Why does Jiang Yang keep looking for the booth? Give two reasons.
ans: 他的性格是什么事都要搞明白；他也想用这件事转移注意力，不那么想父母。
Tā de xìnggé shì shénme shì dōu yào gǎo míngbái; tā yě xiǎng yòng zhèjiàn shì zhuǎnyí zhùyìlì, bú nàme xiǎng fùmǔ.
It's his nature to get to the bottom of things, and he wants to take his mind off missing his parents.

q: 为什么说这次见面“也许是上苍指引”？
Wèishénme shuō zhècì jiànmiàn "yěxǔ shì shàngcāng zhǐyǐn"?
Why does the narrator say heaven may have guided this meeting?
ans: 因为他们都是因为刘大鹏的电话，才回到了二十五年前出事的地方，在这里重逢了。
Yīnwèi tāmen dōu shìyīnwèi Liú Dàpéng de diànhuà, cái huídào le èrshíwǔnián qián chūshì de dìfāng, zài zhèlǐ chóngféng le.
Because Liu Dapeng's phone calls brought all of them back to where it happened 25 years ago, and they met again there.

q: 王梅以前的学生徐志伟和刘达阳是什么样的孩子？
Wáng Méi yǐqián de xuéshēng Xú Zhìwěi hé Liú Dáyáng shì shénmeyàng de háizi?
What kind of boys were Xu Zhiwei and Liu Dayang?
ans: 他们乖巧懂事，学习成绩好，又英俊又阳光。
Tāmen guāiqiǎo dǒngshì, xuéxíchéngjì hǎo, yòu yīngjùn yòu yángguāng.
Well-behaved and sensible, good at school, good-looking and sunny.

011.title: Chapter 11 · The God of Darkness

blocks.label: 章
lines: 第十一章 黑暗之神
Dìshíyīzhāng Hēi'àn zhī Shén
Chapter 11: The God of Darkness
徐阳阳在书店里找到一个人少的角落，从背包里拿出一个垫子，放在地上，然后坐在垫子上开始阅读。
Xú Yángyáng zài shūdiàn lǐ zhǎodào yígè rénshǎo de jiǎoluò, cóng bēibāo lǐ náchū yígè diànzi, fàngzài dìshàng, ránhòu zuòzài diànzi shàng kāishǐ yuèdú.
Xu Yangyang found a quiet corner of the shop, took a cushion out of his backpack, put it on the floor and sat on it to read.
江阳也看了一会儿书，但他心里想着电话亭的事，根本无法集中注意力看书。
Jiāng Yáng yě kàn le yíhuì'er shū, dàn tā xīnlǐ xiǎngzhe diànhuàtíng de shì, gēnběnwúfǎ jízhōng zhùyìlì kànshū.
Jiang Yang read for a while too, but he kept thinking about the phone booth and couldn't concentrate at all.
他慢慢地向书店门口移动，想在书店的店主不注意的时候跑出去。
Tā mànmàn dìxiàng shūdiàn ménkǒu yídòng, xiǎng zài shūdiàn de diànzhǔ bú zhùyì de shíhòu pǎochūqù.
He edged slowly towards the door, hoping to slip out when the shopkeeper wasn't looking.
他每次走到店门口，都会被富文的儿子发现，吆喝他不准出去。
Tā měicì zǒu dào diànménkǒu, dōu huì bèi Fùwén de érzi fāxiàn, yāohē tā bùzhǔn chūqù.
But every time he got to the door, Fuwen's son spotted him and shouted at him not to go out.
后来，富文的儿子索性拿了把椅子，坐在书店门口，堵住了江阳的去路。
Hòulái, Fùwén de érzi suǒxìng ná le bǎ yǐzi, zuòzài shūdiàn ménkǒu, dǔzhù le Jiāng Yáng de qùlù.
In the end, Fuwen's son simply brought a chair and sat in the doorway, blocking his way.
江阳急得像热锅上的蚂蚁，在书店里晃来晃去。
Jiāng Yáng jídé xiàng règuōshàngdemǎyǐ, zài shūdiàn lǐ huǎngláihuǎngqù.
Jiang Yang was like an ant on a hot pan, pacing round and round the shop.
看自己实在无法出去，他只好放弃，转身想要和徐阳阳搭话。
Kàn zìjǐ shízài wúfǎ chūqù, tā zhǐhǎo fàngqì, zhuǎnshēn xiǎngyào hé Xú Yángyáng dāhuà.
Seeing there was no way out, he gave up and turned to strike up a conversation with Xu Yangyang.
“你上几年级啊？”
"Nǐ shàng jǐniánjí a?"
"What year are you in?"
徐阳阳抬头看了他一眼，说：“五年级。”
Xú Yángyáng táitóu kàn le tā yìyǎn, shuō: "wǔniánjí."
Xu Yangyang glanced up and said, "Year five."
然后又低头看书，完全没有继续聊天的意思。
Ránhòu yòu dītóu kànshū, wánquán méiyǒu jìxù liáotiān de yìsi.
Then he looked down at his book again, with no intention of chatting.
“真是好时候啊。上了初中可就累了。”江阳故作深沉地说。
"Zhēnshì hǎo shíhòu a. Shàng le chūzhōng kě jiù lèi le." Jiāng Yáng gùzuò shēnchén dìshuō.
"Lucky you. Once you start secondary school it gets tiring," Jiang Yang said, trying to sound wise.
不过，并没有引起徐阳阳的好奇心。
Búguò, bìng méiyǒu yǐnqǐ Xú Yángyáng de hàoqíxīn.
But it didn't spark Xu Yangyang's curiosity.
徐阳阳没有接话。
Xú Yángyáng méiyǒu jiē huà.
He didn't reply.
江阳就这么试了几次，都没成功和徐阳阳搭上话。
Jiāng Yáng jiù zhème shì le jǐcì, dōu méi chénggōng hé Xú Yángyáng dāshàng huà.
Jiang Yang tried a few more times without getting a conversation going.
他百无聊赖地坐在地上，看着外面的电话亭，嘴里念叨着：“黑暗之神……”
Tā bǎiwúliáolài de zuòzài dìshàng, kànzhe wàimiàn de diànhuàtíng, zuǐlǐ niàndāo zhe: "Hēi'àn zhī Shén……"
Bored stiff, he sat on the floor, looking out at the phone booth and muttering, "The God of Darkness..."
徐阳阳猛地抬头，放下手里的书，盯着江阳问道：“你说什么？”
Xú Yángyáng měngdì táitóu, fàngxià shǒulǐ de shū, dīng zhe Jiāng Yáng wèndào: "nǐ shuō shénme?"
Xu Yangyang's head shot up. He put down his book, stared at Jiang Yang and asked, "What did you say?"
“啊，没什么。”江阳故意卖关子，做出一副没有什么了不起的样子，继续说：
"A, méishénme." Jiāng Yáng gùyì màiguānzi, zuòchū yífù méiyǒu shénme liǎobùqǐ de yàngzi, jìxù shuō:
"Oh, nothing." Jiang Yang deliberately kept him in suspense, acting as if it were no big deal, then went on:
“我之前在对面的电话亭里接过一个神秘的来电。电话那边的人说……”
"Wǒ zhīqián zài duìmiàn de diànhuàtíng lǐ jiēguò yígè shénmì de láidiàn. Diànhuà nàbiān de rén shuō……"
"I once got a mysterious call in that phone booth across the road. The person on the other end said..."
“‘我是黑暗之神，可以实现你一个愿望。说吧，你的愿望是什么？’”江阳和徐阳阳异口同声地说。
"" wǒ shì Hēi'àn zhī Shén, kěyǐ shíxiàn nǐ yígè yuànwàng. Shuō ba, nǐ de yuànwàng shì shénme? "" Jiāng Yáng hé Xú Yángyáng yìkǒutóngshēng dìshuō.
"'I am the God of Darkness. I can grant you one wish. Speak: what is your wish?'" Jiang Yang and Xu Yangyang said together.
江阳惊呆了。
Jiāng Yáng jīngdāi le.
Jiang Yang was stunned.
他抓住徐阳阳的胳膊，难以置信地问：“你也接到过那个电话？”
Tā zhuāzhù Xú Yángyáng de gēbó, nányǐzhìxìn dìwèn: "nǐ yě jiēdào guò nàge diànhuà?"
He grabbed Xu Yangyang's arm and asked in disbelief, "You got that call too?"
“你也是？天哪！你知道吗？我跟我同学讲这件事，他们都说我在吹牛。”
"Nǐ yě shì? Tiān nǎ! Nǐ zhīdào ma? Wǒ gēn wǒ tóngxué jiǎng zhèjiàn shì, tāmen dōu shuō wǒ zài chuīniú."
"You too? Wow! You know what? When I told my classmates, they all said I was making it up."
徐阳阳也很激动：“我也是，没人相信我的话。”
Xú Yángyáng yě hěn jīdòng: "wǒ yě shì, méi rén xiāngxìn wǒ dehuà."
Xu Yangyang was excited too. "Same here. Nobody believes me."
“对了，那你许愿了吗？我是说，你许那个坏的愿望了吗？”
"Duì le, nà nǐ xǔyuàn le ma? Wǒ shì shuō, nǐxǔ nàge huài de yuànwàng le ma?"
"Hey, did you make a wish? I mean, did you make one of those bad wishes?"
“没有。我仔细想了想，都没有坏的愿望，我就挂电话了。你呢？”
"Méiyǒu. Wǒ zǐxìxiǎng le xiǎng, dōu méiyǒu huài de yuànwàng, wǒ jiù guà diànhuà le. Nǐ ne?"
"No. I thought hard, but I didn't have any bad wishes, so I hung up. What about you?"
江阳撒了个谎，说：“啊，我也没有。谁那么幼稚啊，对吧？”
Jiāng Yáng sā le gè huǎng, shuō: "a, wǒ yě méiyǒu. Shuí nàme yòuzhì a, duì ba?"
Jiang Yang told a lie: "Oh, me neither. Who'd be that childish, right?"
“我爸说，这个世界上没有神。那人说的话是一个游戏谜题的指令，是用来寻宝的。线索就在不远处。所以我在读这本书，看能不能找到答案。”

"Wǒbà shuō, zhège shìjiè shàng méiyǒu shén. Nàrén shuō dehuà shì yígè yóuxì mítí de zhǐlìng, shì yònglái xúnbǎo de. Xiànsuǒ jiù zài bùyuǎnchù. Suǒyǐ wǒ zàidú zhè běnshū, kànnéng bùnéng zhǎodào dá'àn."

"My dad says there are no gods in this world. What that person said is an instruction in a puzzle game, a treasure hunt. The clue is nearby. That's why I'm reading this book, to see if I can find the answer."
说着，他举了举手里的书。
Shuō zhe, tājǔ le jǔshǒu lǐ de shū.
He held up the book.
书名是《500个脑筋急转弯》。
Shūmíng shì "500 gè nǎojīn jízhuǎnwān".
It was called 500 Brain-Teasers.
江阳摇了摇头：“这有什么用啊？你是觉得黑暗之神的那些话是脑筋急转弯？我看不是。
Jiāng Yáng yáo le yáotóu: "zhèyǒu shénme yòng a? Nǐ shì juéde Hēi'àn zhī Shén de nàxiē huà shì nǎojīn jízhuǎnwān? Wǒ kàn búshì.
Jiang Yang shook his head. "What use is that? You think what the God of Darkness said is a brain-teaser? I don't think so.
你爸爸说，线索就在不远处，说明我们应该搜查一下，看有没有和黑暗之神相关的书，或者纸条之类的。”
Nǐ bàbà shuō, xiànsuǒ jiù zài bùyuǎnchù, shuōmíng wǒmen yīnggāi sōuchá yíxià, kàn yǒuméiyǒu hé Hēi'àn zhī Shén xiāngguān de shū, huòzhě zhǐtiáo zhīlèi de. "
Your dad says the clue is nearby, so we should search, to see if there's a book or a note or something about the God of Darkness."
“好啊。那我们俩一起找，看谁先找到线索。”
"Hǎo a. Nà wǒmen liǎ yìqǐ zhǎo, kàn shuí xiān zhǎodào xiànsuǒ."
"OK. Let's look together and see who finds the clue first."
徐阳阳开心地合上了书，和江阳一起在书架上寻找线索。
Xú Yángyáng kāixīn dìhé shàng le shū, hé Jiāng Yáng yìqǐ zài shūjiàshàng xúnzhǎo xiànsuǒ.
Xu Yangyang happily closed his book and joined Jiang Yang searching the shelves.
找了半个小时，还是一无所获。
Zhǎo le bàngè xiǎoshí, háishì yìwúsuǒhuò.
After half an hour they still had nothing.
徐阳阳有些泄气：“是不是不在书店里？会不会在电话亭里？”
Xú Yángyáng yǒuxiē xièqì: "shìbúshì bú zài shūdiàn lǐ? Huì búhuì zài diànhuàtíng lǐ?"
Xu Yangyang was losing heart. "Maybe it's not in the shop? Could it be in the phone booth?"
江阳想了想说：“我们再仔细找一遍。尤其是看到两本厚的书挨在一起的时候，很可能把线索挤到后面了。”
Jiāng Yáng xiǎng le xiǎng shuō: "wǒmen zài zǐxì zhǎo yíbiàn. Yóuqí shì kàndào liǎngběn hòu de shū āi zài yìqǐ de shíhòu, hěn kěnéng bǎ xiànsuǒ jǐ dào hòumiàn le."
Jiang Yang thought for a moment. "Let's search carefully once more. Especially where two thick books are next to each other: they might have pushed the clue to the back."
两个人开始把每本书都拿出来看一下。
Liǎnggè rén kāishǐ bǎ měi běnshū dōu náchū láikàn yíxià.
The two started taking out every single book.
在翻到离收银台最近的书架时，江阳拿出最底下的一本厚厚的字典，
Zài fāndào lí shōuyíntái zuìjìn de shūjià shí, Jiāng Yáng náchū zuì dǐxià de yìběn hòuhòude zìdiǎn,
At the shelf nearest the till, Jiang Yang pulled out a thick dictionary from the bottom row,
同时拉出来的还有一个小小的笔记本。
Tóngshí lā chūlái de háiyǒu yígè xiǎoxiǎode bǐjìběn.
and a small notebook came out with it.
笔记本的侧面和正面都写着四个大字：黑暗之神。
Bǐjìběn de cèmiàn hé zhèngmiàn dōu xiě zhe sìgè dàzì: Hēi'àn zhī Shén.
On its spine and cover were four big characters: 黑暗之神, the God of Darkness.
这个笔记本原来是和旁边的字典一起摆在书架上，“黑暗之神”这几个字是暴露在外面的。
Zhège bǐjìběn yuánlái shì hé pángbiān de zìdiǎn yìqǐ bǎizài shūjiàshàng, "Hēi'àn zhī Shén" zhè jǐgè zì shì bàolù zài wàimiàn de.
The notebook had originally stood on the shelf next to the dictionary, with the words "God of Darkness" showing.
但是后来有人把字典拿出来看，在放回去的时候，由于字典太重太厚，把这个笔记本挤到了后面。
Dànshì hòulái yǒurén bǎ zìdiǎn náchū láikàn, zài fàng huíqù de shíhòu, yóuyú zìdiǎn tàizhòng tàihòu, bǎ zhège bǐjìběn jǐdào le hòumiàn.
But later someone took out the dictionary to look at it, and when they put it back, being so heavy and thick it pushed the notebook to the back.
所以他们找了很久，都没看到这几个字。
Suǒyǐ tāmen zhǎo le hěn jiǔ, dōu méi kàndào zhè jǐgè zì.
That's why they searched so long without seeing the words.
“找到了！”江阳大声地喊着，吓到了旁边一个拍照的女孩。
"Zhǎodào le!" Jiāng Yáng dàshēng dìhǎn zhe, xià dào le pángbiān yígè pāizhào de nǚhái.
"Found it!" Jiang Yang shouted, startling a girl taking photos nearby.
江阳连忙道歉，然后和徐阳阳躲在收银台后面，一起翻看那个本子。
Jiāng Yáng liánmáng dàoqiàn, ránhòu hé Xú Yángyáng duǒ zài shōuyíntái hòumiàn, yìqǐ fānkàn nàge běnzi.
He quickly apologised, then hid behind the till with Xu Yangyang to look through the notebook.
本子里有人用记号笔抄写了十首诗歌，有古代诗歌，也有现代诗歌，都是描写夜晚和黑暗的。
Běnzi lǐ yǒurén yòng jìhàobǐ chāoxiě le shíshǒu shīgē, yǒu gǔdài shīgē, yě yǒu xiàndàishīgē, dōu shì miáoxiě yèwǎn hé hēi'àn de.
In it, someone had copied out ten poems in marker pen, old and modern, all about night and darkness.
其中一些是学校课本里学过的，还有一些他们没有读过。
Qízhōng yìxiē shì xuéxiào kèběn lǐ xuéguò de, háiyǒu yìxiē tāmen méiyǒu dúguò.
Some they had studied in their school textbooks; others they had never read.
但即便没有读过，他们也能看懂大概的意思。
Dàn jíbiàn méiyǒu dúguò, tāmen yě néngkàndǒng dàgài de yìsi.
But even those they could roughly understand.
只有一首现代诗比较奇怪，看不懂到底想表达什么。
Zhǐyǒu yìshǒu xiàndàishī bǐjiào qíguài, kànbùdǒng dàodǐ xiǎng biǎodá shénme.
Only one modern poem was strange: they couldn't work out what it was trying to say.
诗的名字是《暗语》。
Shī de míngzì shì "ànyǔ".
It was called "Secret Words".
暗处的风，带着昨日的回忆，
Ànchù de fēng, dài zhe zuórì de huíyì,
The wind in the dark carries yesterday's memories,
号令并未传来，只有心跳，
Hàolìng bìngwèi chuánlái, zhǐyǒu xīntiào,
no order comes, only a heartbeat,
在这个无名的夜里。
Zài zhège wúmíng de yèlǐ.
in this nameless night.
杂乱的心绪，被风吹向另一个世界。
Záluàn de xīnxù, bèi fēngchuī xiàng lìng yígè shìjiè.
Tangled thoughts are blown by the wind to another world.
物影斜斜，想要说些什么？
Wùyǐng xié xié, xiǎngyào shuōxiē shénme?
Shadows of things lean slantwise: what do they want to say?
间影浮动，谁的眼睛在注视着我？
Jiānyǐng fúdòng, shuí de yǎnjīng zài zhùshì zhe wǒ?
Shapes drift between them: whose eyes are watching me?
窗前无人，抑或这一切都只是幻觉。
Chuāngqián wúrén, yìhuò zhè yíqiè dōu zhǐshì huànjué.
No one at the window, or perhaps it is all an illusion.
台灯下有一片黑，刚好容下一个人。
Táidēng xià yǒu yípiàn hēi, gānghǎo róng xià yígè rén.
Under the lamp there is a patch of darkness, just big enough for one person.
他们两个把笔记本翻了十几遍，再也没找到别的有用线索。
Tāmen liǎnggè bǎ bǐjìběn fān le shíjǐbiàn, zàiyě méi zhǎodào biéde yǒuyòng xiànsuǒ.
They leafed through the notebook more than ten times without finding any other useful clue.
只有这首诗最奇怪，但是他们看了很久，也没看出门道来。
Zhǐyǒu zhèshǒu shī zuì qíguài, dànshì tāmen kàn le hěn jiǔ, yě méi kànchū méndào lái.
Only this poem was strange, but however long they looked, they couldn't make sense of it.
江阳挠挠头，无语地说：“这是什么意思？你看懂了吗？”
Jiāng Yáng náo náotóu, wúyǔ de shuō: "zhèshì shénme yìsi? Nǐ kàn dǒng le ma?"
Jiang Yang scratched his head, at a loss. "What does it mean? Do you get it?"
徐阳阳摇了摇头，表示看不懂，并提出了一种假设：
Xú Yángyáng yáo le yáotóu, biǎoshì kànbùdǒng, bìng tíchū le yìzhǒng jiǎshè:
Xu Yangyang shook his head; he didn't. Then he came up with an idea:
“你说这会不会和那个电话一样？后面说的话都不重要，而是要找到‘黑暗之神’四个字。”
"Nǐ shuō zhèhuì búhuì hé nàge diànhuà yíyàng? Hòumiàn shuō dehuà dōu bú zhòngyào, érshì yào zhǎodào" Hēi'àn zhī Shén "sìgè zì."
"Could it be like the phone call? What comes after doesn't matter; the point was to find the words 'God of Darkness'."
“你的意思是，我们需要找写着‘暗语’两个字的书或者笔记本？两道不一样的题，但是用同一种解题技巧，那也太没意思了吧。”江阳不太同意这个想法。

"Nǐ de yìsi shì, wǒmen xūyào zhǎo xiě zhe" ànyǔ "liǎnggè zì de shū huòzhě bǐjìběn? Liǎngdào bù yíyàng de tí, dànshì yòngtóng yìzhǒng jiětíjìqiǎo, nà yě tài méiyìsi le ba." Jiāng Yáng bútài tóngyì zhège xiǎngfǎ.
"You mean we need to find a book or notebook with 'Secret Words' on it? Two different puzzles solved the same way? That'd be boring." Jiang Yang didn't really agree.
“说的也是。但是所有的诗歌里面，就这首不对劲儿，对吧？暗语不就是暗号的意思吗？说明这首诗就是一个暗号。会不会让我们把整首诗背下来？”

"Shuō de yě shì. Dànshì suǒyǒu de shīgē lǐmiàn, jiù zhèshǒu bú duìjìn'ér, duì ba? Ànyǔ bú jiùshì ànhào de yìsi ma? Shuōmíng zhèshǒu shī jiùshì yígè ànhào. Huì búhuì ràng wǒmen bǎ zhěngshǒu shī bèixiàlái?"
"True. But of all the poems, only this one is odd, right? 'Secret words' means a code, doesn't it? So the poem is a code. Maybe we have to learn the whole poem by heart?"
“那也太长了吧。”
"Nà yě tàizhǎng le ba."
"That's way too long."
江阳听徐阳阳说到“暗号”两个字，他发现，这首诗的第一行的第一个字是“暗”，第二行的第一个字是“号”。
Jiāng Yáng tīng Xú Yángyáng shuō dào "ànhào" liǎnggè zì, tā fāxiàn, zhèshǒu shī de dìyīxíng de dìyígè zì shì "àn", dì'èrxíng de dìyígè zì shì "hào".
Hearing Xu Yangyang say "code", Jiang Yang noticed that the first character of the first line was 暗, and the first of the second line was 号.
他的手指顺着往下滑动，徐阳阳的视线也跟着他的手指移动。
Tā de shǒuzhǐ shùnzhe wǎng xià huádòng, Xú Yángyáng de shìxiàn yě gēnzhe tā de shǒuzhǐ yídòng.
His finger slid down the page, and Xu Yangyang's eyes followed it.
这是一首藏头诗。
Zhèshì yìshǒu cángtóushī.
It was an acrostic poem.
把每一行的第一个字组合起来，他们就得到了一句话。
Bǎ měi yìxíng de dìyígè zì zǔhé qǐlái, tāmen jiù dédào le yíjù huà.
Putting together the first character of each line, they got a sentence.
二人一起出声地读了出来：“暗号在杂物间窗台。”
Èrrén yìqǐ chūshēng dìdú le chūlái: "ànhào zài záwùjiān chuāngtái."
They read it out together: "The code is on the storeroom windowsill."

q: 徐阳阳坐在垫子上看书。
Xú Yángyáng zuòzài diànzi shàng kànshū.
Xu Yangyang sat on a cushion to read.
tf.why: He brought it in his backpack.

q: 江阳偷偷跑出了书店，去了电话亭。
Jiāng Yáng tōutōu pǎo chū le shūdiàn, qù le diànhuàtíng.
Jiang Yang sneaked out of the shop to the phone booth.
tf.why: Fuwen's son sat in the doorway and blocked him.

q: 徐阳阳上五年级。
Xú Yángyáng shàng wǔniánjí.
Xu Yangyang is in year five.
tf.why: He says so, then goes back to his book.

q: 一开始徐阳阳很想和江阳聊天。
Yī kāishǐ Xú Yángyáng hěn xiǎng hé Jiāng Yáng liáotiān.
At first Xu Yangyang was keen to chat with Jiang Yang.
tf.why: He kept reading and didn't reply.

q: 两个男孩都接到过黑暗之神的电话。
Liǎnggè nánhái dōu jiēdào guò Hēi'àn zhī Shén de diànhuà.
Both boys had received the God of Darkness's call.
tf.why: They said the words together.

q: 江阳告诉徐阳阳，他许了一个坏愿望。
Jiāng Yáng gàosù Xú Yángyáng, tāxǔ le yígè huài yuànwàng.
Jiang Yang told Xu Yangyang he had made a bad wish.
tf.why: He lied and said he hadn't.

q: 徐阳阳的同学相信他接到了神秘电话。
Xú Yángyáng de tóngxué xiāngxìn tā jiēdào le shénmìdiànhuà.
Xu Yangyang's classmates believed his story about the call.
tf.why: Nobody believed him.

q: 徐阳阳的爸爸说，那是一个寻宝游戏的指令。
Xú Yángyáng de bàbà shuō, nà shì yígè xúnbǎo yóuxì de zhǐlìng.
Xu Yangyang's dad said it was an instruction in a treasure-hunt game.
tf.why: And that the clue was nearby.

q: 笔记本夹在一本厚厚的字典里面。
Bǐjìběn jiā zài yìběn hòuhòude zìdiǎn lǐmiàn.
The notebook was inside a thick dictionary.
tf.why: It was pushed behind the dictionary on the shelf.

q: 笔记本里的诗都是写夜晚和黑暗的。
Bǐjìběn lǐ de shī dōu shì xiě yèwǎn hé hēi'àn de.
The poems in the notebook are all about night and darkness.
tf.why: Old and modern poems.

q: 笔记本是刘大鹏写的。
Bǐjìběn shì Liú Dàpéng xiě de.
The notebook was written by Liu Dapeng.
tf.why: We only know "someone" copied the poems; the writer isn't named.

q: 那首奇怪的诗叫《黑暗之神》。
Nàshǒu qíguài de shī jiào "Hēi'àn zhī Shén".
The strange poem is called "The God of Darkness".
tf.why: It's called "Secret Words" (暗语).

q: 每一行诗的第一个字连起来是一句话。
Měi yìxíng shī de dìyígè zì lián qǐlái shì yíjù huà.
The first characters of the lines form a sentence.
tf.why: It's an acrostic.

q: 江阳为什么一直想出去？
Jiāng Yáng wèishénme yìzhí xiǎng chūqù?
Why did Jiang Yang keep trying to get out?
o: He wanted to go to the phone booth
He wanted to find Teacher Wang
mc.why: He couldn't stop thinking about the booth.

q: 为什么他们找了很久才找到笔记本？
Wèishénme tāmen zhǎo le hěn jiǔ cái zhǎodào bǐjìběn?
Why did it take them so long to find the notebook?
o: 因为笔记本在电话亭里
Because it was in the booth
因为富文把它藏起来了
Yīnwèi Fùwén bǎ tā cáng qǐlái le
因为字典把笔记本挤到了后面，看不到字
Yīnwèi zìdiǎn bǎ bǐjìběn jǐdào le hòumiàn, kànbúdào zì
Because the dictionary had pushed it to the back where the words couldn't be seen
mc.why: Someone put the heavy dictionary back and pushed the notebook out of sight.

q: 藏头诗告诉了他们什么？
Cángtóushī gàosù le tāmen shénme?
What did the acrostic poem tell them?
o: The code is in the phone booth
The code is on the storeroom windowsill
The code is in the dictionary
mc.why: 暗·号·在·杂·物·间·窗·台

q: 江阳是怎么发现那首诗的秘密的？
Jiāng Yáng shì zěnme fāxiàn nàshǒu shī de mìmì de?
How did Jiang Yang discover the poem's secret?
ans: 徐阳阳说到“暗号”，他发现第一行第一个字是“暗”，第二行第一个字是“号”，原来是藏头诗。
Xú Yángyáng shuō dào "ànhào", tā fāxiàn dìyīxíng dìyígè zì shì "àn", dì'èrxíng dìyígè zì shì "hào", yuánlái shì cángtóushī.
When Xu Yangyang said "code", he noticed the first line began with 暗 and the second with 号: it was an acrostic.

q: “像热锅上的蚂蚁”是什么意思？江阳为什么这样？
"Xiàng règuōshàngdemǎyǐ" shì shénme yìsi? Jiāng Yáng wèishénme zhèyàng?
What does "like an ant on a hot pan" mean? Why was Jiang Yang like that?
ans: 意思是非常着急、坐立不安。江阳想去电话亭，可是出不去。
Yìsi shì fēicháng zháojí, zuòlìbù'ān. Jiāng Yáng xiǎng qù diànhuàtíng, kěshì chūbúqù.
It means extremely anxious and restless. Jiang Yang wanted to get to the booth but couldn't get out.

q: 江阳为什么撒谎说自己没有许愿？
Jiāng Yáng wèishénme sāhuǎng shuō zìjǐ méiyǒu xǔyuàn?
Why did Jiang Yang lie about making a wish?
ans: 因为他许了让王老师生病的坏愿望，他觉得不好意思，也很后悔。
Yīnwèi tāxǔ le ràng wánglǎoshī shēngbìng de huài yuànwàng, tā juéde bùhǎoyìsī, yě hěn hòuhuǐ.
Because he had wished for Teacher Wang to get ill; he was embarrassed and regretted it.

012.title: Chapter 12 · Half a Lifetime of Waiting

blocks.label: 章
lines: 第十二章 半生的等待
Dìshí'èrzhāng bànshēng de děngdài
Chapter 12: Half a Lifetime of Waiting
刘达阳很喜欢看《名侦探柯南》。
Liú Dáyáng hěn xǐhuān kàn "míng zhēntàn kēnán".
Liu Dayang loved watching Detective Conan.
他幻想着自己也能像柯南一样，可以通过推理来解答各种谜题。
Tā huànxiǎng zhe zìjǐ yě néng xiàng kēnán yíyàng, kěyǐ tōngguò tuīlǐ lái jiědá gèzhǒng mítí.
He dreamt that he too, like Conan, could solve all kinds of mysteries by deduction.
他经常求父亲刘大鹏给他出推理题。
Tā jīngcháng qiú fùqīn Liú Dàpéng gěi tā chū tuīlǐtí.
He often begged his father, Liu Dapeng, to set him reasoning puzzles.
刘大鹏为了满足儿子的愿望，翻遍了楼下书店的脑筋急转弯之类的书，设计了各种类型的谜题游戏。
Liú Dàpéng wèile mǎnzú érzi de yuànwàng, fānbiàn le lóuxià shūdiàn de nǎojīn jízhuǎnwān zhīlèi de shū, shèjì le gèzhǒnglèixíng de mítí yóuxì.
To please his son, Liu Dapeng went through all the brain-teaser books in the shop downstairs and designed all sorts of puzzle games.
2000年的时候，《名侦探柯南》还只是在电视上放映，没有引进中文翻译的书。
2000 nián de shíhòu, "míng zhēntàn kēnán" hái zhǐshì zài diànshì shàng fàngyìng, méiyǒu yǐnjìn zhōngwénfānyì de shū.
In 2000, Detective Conan was only shown on television; the books hadn't yet come out in Chinese.
刘大鹏请求一个从日本回来的朋友，买了《名侦探柯南》的日文原版。
Liú Dàpéng qǐngqiú yígè cóng rìběn huílái de péngyǒu, mǎi le "míng zhēntàn kēnán" de rìwén yuánbǎn.
Liu Dapeng asked a friend returning from Japan to buy the original Japanese edition.
他把这本书和《福尔摩斯探案集》，还有《尼罗河上的惨案》这两本推理小说放在一个盒子里，准备当成生日礼物送给刘达阳。
Tā bǎ zhè běnshū hé "fú'ěrmósī tàn'ànjí", háiyǒu "níluóhé shàng de cǎn'àn" zhè liǎngběn tuīlǐxiǎoshuō fàngzài yígè hézi lǐ, zhǔnbèi dàngchéng shēngrìlǐwù sònggěi Liú Dáyáng.
He put it in a box with two detective novels, The Adventures of Sherlock Holmes and Death on the Nile, as a birthday present for Liu Dayang.
为了让这份礼物更有惊喜感，他请求楼下书店的富大姐，允许他在书店设计一下，把书店也变成游戏谜题的任务场景。
Wèile ràng zhèfèn lǐwù gèng yǒu jīngxǐ gǎn, tā qǐngqiú lóuxià shūdiàn de Fù dàjiě, yǔnxǔ tā zài shūdiàn shèjì yíxià, bǎ shūdiàn yě biànchéng yóuxì mítí de rènwù chǎngjǐng.
To make the present more of a surprise, he asked Sister Fu in the shop downstairs to let him set things up there, turning the bookshop into part of the puzzle game.
那天放学后，刘达阳和徐志伟一起走进书店。
Nàtiān fàngxué hòu, Liú Dáyáng hé Xú Zhìwěi yìqǐ zǒujìn shūdiàn.
That day after school, Liu Dayang and Xu Zhiwei went into the shop together.
富文递给他们一张纸，上面写着：
Fùwén dìgěi tāmen yìzhāng zhǐ, shàngmiàn xiě zhe:
Fuwen handed them a sheet of paper that said:
“寻宝游戏现在开始了。第一关：考考你的眼力。在书店这么多书中找到一本书名里带有‘宝’字的书，第二关的线索就在那里。”
"Xúnbǎo yóuxì xiànzài kāishǐ le. Dìyīguān: kǎokǎonǐ de yǎnlì. Zài shūdiàn zhème duōshūzhōng zhǎodào yìběn shūmíng lǐ dàiyǒu" bǎo "zì de shū, dì'èr guān de xiànsuǒ jiù zài nàlǐ."
"The treasure hunt begins now. Level one: test your eyes. Among all the books in this shop, find one with the character 宝 (treasure) in its title. The clue to level two is there."
刘达阳很快就找到了，因为他记得之前读过一本叫《宝葫芦的秘密》的书。
Liú Dáyáng hěnkuài jiù zhǎodào le, yīnwèi tā jìde zhīqián dúguò yìběn jiào "bǎo húlú de mìmì" de shū.
Liu Dayang found it quickly, because he remembered reading a book called The Secret of the Magic Gourd.
刘达阳打开书，里面夹着一张纸条，上面写着：“走进电话亭，十秒钟后，黑暗之神就会降临。”
Liú Dáyáng dǎkāi shū, lǐmiàn jiā zhe yìzhāng zhǐtiáo, shàngmiàn xiě zhe: "zǒujìn diànhuàtíng, shímiǎozhōng hòu, Hēi'àn zhī Shén jiù huì jiànglín."
Inside the book was a slip of paper: "Step into the phone booth. In ten seconds, the God of Darkness will come."
刘达阳开心地跑进电话亭。
Liú Dáyáng kāixīn de pǎo jìn diànhuàtíng.
Liu Dayang ran happily into the booth.
而刘大鹏就在二楼的窗口等待着。
Ér Liú Dàpéng jiù zài èrlóu de chuāngkǒu děngdài zhe.
And Liu Dapeng was waiting at the first-floor window.
当他看到儿子走进电话亭，就给电话亭打了电话，说出了他提前准备好的、带有十足的神秘感的指令。
Dāng tā kàndào érzi zǒujìn diànhuàtíng, jiù gěi diànhuàtíng dǎ le diànhuà, shuōchū le tā tíqiánzhǔnbèi hǎo de, dàiyǒu shízú de shénmìgǎn de zhǐlìng.
When he saw his son go in, he phoned the booth and spoke the instructions he had prepared, full of mystery.
刘达阳从电话亭出来后，意外就发生了。
Liú Dáyáng cóng diànhuàtíng chūlái hòu, yìwài jiù fāshēng le.
When Liu Dayang came out of the booth, the accident happened.
目睹这场血腥车祸的人，不只是徐志伟，还有刘大鹏。
Mùdǔ zhèchǎng xuèxīng chēhuò de rén, bù zhǐshì Xú Zhìwěi, háiyǒu Liú Dàpéng.
Xu Zhiwei wasn't the only one who saw the bloody accident. So did Liu Dapeng.
他眼看着儿子被车撞飞，死于他设计的游戏中。
Tā yǎnkàn zhe érzi bèichēzhuàng fēi, sǐyú tā shèjì de yóuxì zhōng.
He watched his son hit by the car and killed in the game he had designed.
刘大鹏的妻子刚经历了父母离世之痛，又送走了自己亲爱的儿子。
Liú Dàpéng de qīzǐ gāng jīnglì le fùmǔ líshì zhītòng, yòu sòngzǒu le zìjǐ qīn'ài de érzi.
Liu Dapeng's wife had just been through the death of her parents, and now she had lost her beloved son.
她万念俱灰，也追随儿子而去。
Tā wànniànjùhuī, yě zhuīsuí érzi ér qù.
She lost all hope and followed her son.
刘大鹏的精神也彻底崩溃。
Liú Dàpéng de jīngshén yě chèdǐ bēngkuì.
Liu Dapeng's mind broke completely.
他的人生被困在了车祸事故发生的那一天。
Tā de rénshēng bèikùn zài le chēhuò shìgù fāshēng de nà yìtiān.
His life was trapped in the day of the accident.
每天早上起来，他便坐在窗前等待儿子放学，

Nàme, zhège shénmì láidiàn shì shuí dǎlái de ne?
So who makes the mysterious call?
这就是一个秘密了。
Zhè jiùshì yígè mìmì le.
That's a secret.
也许有一天，你碰见了这个电话亭，才有可能找到答案。
Yěxǔ yǒu yìtiān, nǐ pèngjiàn le zhège diànhuàtíng, cái yǒu kěnéng zhǎodào dá'àn.
Maybe one day, if you come across this phone booth, you'll find the answer.

q: 刘达阳喜欢像柯南一样推理。
Liú Dáyáng xǐhuān xiàng kēnán yíyàng tuīlǐ.
Liu Dayang liked solving mysteries by deduction, like Conan.
tf.why: He often begged his father for reasoning puzzles.

q: 2000年，中国的书店里有很多中文版的《名侦探柯南》。
2000 nián, zhōngguó de shūdiàn lǐ yǒu hěnduō zhōngwénbǎn de "míng zhēntàn kēnán".
In 2000 Chinese bookshops had plenty of Detective Conan in Chinese.
tf.why: It was only on TV; there were no Chinese books yet.

q: 刘大鹏的礼物是一盒推理书。
Liú Dàpéng de lǐwù shì yìhé tuīlǐ shū.
Liu Dapeng's present was a box of detective books.
tf.why: Japanese Conan plus Sherlock Holmes and Death on the Nile.

q: 第一关是找一本书名里有“宝”字的书。
Dìyīguān shì zhǎo yìběn shūmíng lǐ yǒu "bǎo" zì de shū.
Level one was to find a book with 宝 in its title.
tf.why: Dayang remembered The Secret of the Magic Gourd.

q: 刘大鹏在电话亭旁边等儿子。
Liú Dàpéng zài diànhuàtíng pángbiān děng érzi.
Liu Dapeng waited for his son beside the booth.
tf.why: He waited at his first-floor window and phoned the booth.

q: 刘大鹏看到了车祸。
Liú Dàpéng kàndào le chēhuò.
Liu Dapeng saw the accident.
tf.why: He watched his son die in the game he'd designed.

q: 二十多年来，有很多孩子玩完了这个游戏。
Èrshíduōnián lái, yǒu hěnduō háizi wánwán le zhège yóuxì.
Over twenty years many children finished the game.
tf.why: Nobody ever finished it until 2025.

q: 暗号写在窗台的石头上面。
Ànhào xiě zài chuāngtái de shítou shàngmiàn.
The code was written on top of the stone windowsill.
tf.why: It was in a plastic bag under the loose stone.

q: 纸条上的字是用钢笔写的。
Zhǐtiáo shàng de zì shì yòng gāngbǐ xiě de.
The note was written in fountain pen.
tf.why: The ink had faded badly.

q: 暗号是“真相只有一个”。
Ànhào shì "zhēnxiàng zhǐyǒu yígè".
The code was "There is only one truth".
tf.why: Conan's catchphrase.

q: 徐阳阳的名字是徐志伟的妻子起的。
Xú Yángyáng de míngzì shì Xú Zhìwěi de qīzǐ qǐ de.
Xu Yangyang was named by Xu Zhiwei's wife.
tf.why: Xu Zhiwei named him, from unconscious longing for Liu Dayang.

q: 刘大鹏后来又活了很多年。
Liú Dàpéng hòulái yòu huó le hěnduōnián.
Liu Dapeng lived for many more years.
tf.why: He died in his sleep a few days later.

q: 李良成了富文书店的新店主。
Lǐ Liáng chéng le Fùwén Shūdiàn de xīn diànzhǔ.
Li Liang became the bookshop's new owner.
tf.why: And turned the flat upstairs into a teahouse.

q: 现在打神秘电话的人是李良。
Xiànzài dǎ shénmìdiànhuà de rén shì Lǐ Liáng.
Now the person making the mysterious calls is Li Liang.
tf.why: The story says it's a secret.

q: “黑暗之神”的电话最早是谁打的？
"Hēi'àn zhī Shén" de diànhuà zuìzǎo shì shuí dǎ de?
Who first made the "God of Darkness" calls?
mc.why: He phoned the booth from his window as part of his son's treasure hunt.

q: 刘大鹏的妻子后来怎么了？
Liú Dàpéng de qīzǐ hòulái zěnme le?
What happened to Liu Dapeng's wife?
o: 她万念俱灰，也追随儿子而去
Tā wànniànjùhuī, yě zhuīsuí érzi ér qù
She lost all hope and followed her son in death
Tā hé Liú Dàpéng líhūn le
mc.why: She had also just lost her parents.

q: 两年后，电话亭有什么新服务？
Liǎngnián hòu, diànhuàtíng yǒu shénme xīn fúwù?
What new service does the booth have two years later?
o: 扫码付十元，接一个神秘来电，找到线索就能免费喝茶
Sǎomǎ fù shíyuán, jiē yígè shénmì láidiàn, zhǎodào xiànsuǒ jiù néng miǎnfèi hēchá
Pay 10 yuan by QR code for a mysterious call; find the clue and get free tea
mc.why: Find the clue in the bookshop and get a free cup of tea upstairs.

q: 为什么两个孩子都回答了刘大鹏？
Wèishénme liǎnggè háizi dōu huídá le Liú Dàpéng?
Why did both children answer Liu Dapeng?
ans: 因为他们的小名都叫阳阳，刘大鹏叫的是“阳阳”。
Yīnwèi tāmen de xiǎomíng dōu jiào Yángyáng, Liú Dàpéng jiào de shì "Yángyáng".
Because both their nicknames were Yangyang, and that's the name he called.

q: 刘大鹏为什么二十多年来一直坐在窗前？
Liú Dàpéng wèishénme èrshíduōnián lái yìzhí zuòzài chuāngqián?
Why did Liu Dapeng sit by the window for over twenty years?
ans: 他的人生被困在了车祸那一天，他在等儿子解完谜题回家，好送出生日礼物。
Tā de rénshēng bèikùn zài le chēhuò nà yìtiān, tā zài děng érzi jiěwán mítí huíjiā, hǎo sòng chū shēngrìlǐwù.
His life was stuck on the day of the accident; he was waiting for his son to solve the puzzle and come home so he could give him his birthday present.

q: 故事的最后，老街区有什么变化？说两点。
Gùshì de zuìhòu, lǎojiēqū yǒu shénme biànhuà? Shuō liǎngdiǎn.
How has the old neighbourhood changed at the end? Give two things.
ans: 老街变成了复古风的步行街，富文书店由李良经营，楼上开了茶馆，电话亭也重修了。
Lǎojiē biànchéng le fùgǔfēng de bùxíngjiē, Fùwén Shūdiàn yóu Lǐ Liáng jīngyíng, lóushàng kāi le cháguǎn, diànhuàtíng yě chóngxiū le.
It became a retro pedestrian street; Li Liang runs the Fuwen Bookshop with a teahouse upstairs; the phone booth was restored.
